prs.title: fix(core): keep sed anchors inside groups and alternations
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The simulated `sed -i` substitution now keeps `^` and `$` as anchors at group and alternation boundaries in basic regex, the same as GNU sed. `^` stays an anchor right after `\(` or `\|`, and `$` stays an anchor right before `\)` or `\|`. Everywhere else they are still escaped as literal characters, including after an even run of backslashes (`\\(^` is a literal backslash, not a group).

## Why it's needed

The converter from sed basic regex to a JavaScript pattern escaped every `^` that was not the first character and every `$` that was not the last one. GNU sed also treats them as anchors inside a group or next to `\|`. So an edit like `sed -i 's/\(^foo\)/Z/' f.txt` searched for the literal text `^foo`, matched nothing, and the file was written back unchanged, while real sed replaces the line that starts with `foo`. The same miss happened for `s/\(foo$\)/Z/`, `s/\(^foo$\)/Z/`, `s/foo\|^bar/Z/` and `s/foo$\|bar/Z/`. Extended regex (`-E`) was already passed through unchanged and was not affected.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run src/utils/sedEditParser.test.ts` in `packages/core`. The new case `anchors BRE ^ and $ at group and alternation boundaries` applies the patterns above and compares the result with GNU sed's output. For reference, `printf 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' | sed 's/\(^foo\)/Z/'` prints `xxfoo` and `Z`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `applySedSubstitution("xxfoo\nfoo\n", parseSedEditCommand('sed -i "s/\(^foo\)/Z/" f.txt'))` returns `"xxfoo\nfoo\n"` (no change), and the new test fails with `expected 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' to be 'xxfoo\nZ\n'`.

After: it returns `"xxfoo\nZ\n"`, matching GNU sed, and the file passes (39 tests). Prettier and ESLint are clean on the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only)

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: low. Only `^` directly after `\(`/`\|` and `$` directly before `\)`/`\|` change from literal to anchor, which is what GNU sed does; all other positions keep the current escaping.
- Not validated / out of scope: other BRE differences between sed and JavaScript regex.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

模拟执行的 `sed -i` 替换现在在基本正则（BRE）里，会把分组和 `\|` 边界处的 `^`、`$` 当作锚点，和 GNU sed 一致：`^` 紧跟在 `\(` 或 `\|` 后面时是锚点，`$` 紧挨在 `\)` 或 `\|` 前面时是锚点。其它位置仍按普通字符转义，包括前面是偶数个反斜杠的情况（`\\(^` 是字面反斜杠，不是分组）。

## 为什么需要

把 sed 基本正则转换成 JavaScript 正则时，原来的逻辑会转义所有不在开头的 `^` 和所有不在结尾的 `$`。但 GNU sed 在分组内或 `\|` 旁边也把它们当锚点。所以 `sed -i 's/\(^foo\)/Z/' f.txt` 这样的编辑会去找字面文本 `^foo`，什么都匹配不到，文件原样写回；而真实的 sed 会替换以 `foo` 开头的那一行。`s/\(foo$\)/Z/`、`s/\(^foo$\)/Z/`、`s/foo\|^bar/Z/`、`s/foo$\|bar/Z/` 也有同样的问题。扩展正则（`-E`）本来就原样透传，不受影响。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/core` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/utils/sedEditParser.test.ts`。新用例 `anchors BRE ^ and $ at group and alternation boundaries` 会执行上面这些模式，并和 GNU sed 的输出对比。参考：`printf 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' | sed 's/\(^foo\)/Z/'` 输出 `xxfoo` 和 `Z`。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：`applySedSubstitution("xxfoo\nfoo\n", parseSedEditCommand('sed -i "s/\(^foo\)/Z/" f.txt'))` 返回 `"xxfoo\nfoo\n"`（没有变化），新测试失败：`expected 'xxfoo\nfoo\n' to be 'xxfoo\nZ\n'`。

修改后：返回 `"xxfoo\nZ\n"`，与 GNU sed 一致，该文件全部通过（39 个测试）。改动文件的 Prettier 和 ESLint 检查通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

不适用（仅单元测试）

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：低。只有紧跟 `\(`/`\|` 的 `^` 和紧挨 `\)`/`\|` 的 `$` 从普通字符变为锚点，这正是 GNU sed 的行为；其它位置的转义不变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：sed 与 JavaScript 正则之间其它的 BRE 差异。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(ci): gate Managed Agent changes on a full SDK Java run before merge
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a "Managed Agent gate" workflow that runs the SDK Java suite at the points where it can still stop a bad merge, without running it on every push of every PR.

- A PR or main push that touches the Managed Agent Java modules, or the harness surfaces they drive (`serve`, the managed runtime, the Hosted integration helpers, and the scripts the suite runs), gets a fast tier: the Flyway guard, the real-daemon E2E and the Linux Java 21 leg, about 25 minutes.
- The first approval of the current head runs the full suite (all 11 lanes). A later approval of the same head skips it once an earlier approval run passed or is still running; after a failure, the next approval or "Re-run failed jobs" retries it.
- A gate job always reports. A PR that touches the paths reports the `Managed Agent gate` check only from a full run, so until then the check shows as expected. Untouched PRs report a pass within seconds. This makes `Managed Agent gate` usable as a required check, including in a merge queue, and it needs no write token, so fork PRs work too.
- The SDK Java workflow gains a `tier` input; the nightly, manual and release runs pass none and still run everything.
- Approving a fork PR raises a review event, which the runner routing used to send to the self-hosted pool. Untrusted fork code now stays on hosted runners for that event as well.
- The gate's own tier-selection and report jobs use the same trust routing, with the shared pre-checkout hygiene steps. Their first run sat in a hosted queue holding 123 runs, and a would-be required check must not wait on that.
- The SDK Java concurrency group now includes the event and commit, so a fast run and a full run on the same PR no longer displace each other.
- Main-push failures file the usual autofix issue, and the triage finalizer watches the new workflow in place of SDK Java, which lost its PR trigger in #14205.

This PR makes nothing required; branch protection stays a maintainer decision.

## Why it's needed

Since #14205 the SDK Java suite runs only nightly. On 2026-10-16 two independently green PRs together broke compilation of the Managed Agent test sources on main, and nothing reported it until the nightly run. Managed Agent is now a protected product line, so changes to it and to the harness must pass the full suite before merging. Running the full suite (about 330 machine minutes per run) on every push is not affordable, and the first approval of a head is the earliest point that is still after its last push, because stale approvals are dismissed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Read the design doc for the event and check-name tables.
- Locally, the new workflow test evaluates the path matcher, the check-name and concurrency expressions and the fast-tier matrix, and runs the tier-selection and report scripts against a stub `gh`. Two mutations, dropping the approval-event filter from the deduplication and letting a non-full PR run report the required name, both turn it red.
- After merge, on a PR that touches `packages/managed-agent-server/`: a push shows "Managed Agent fast tier" and leaves "Managed Agent gate" expected, and the first approval shows "Managed Agent gate" from a full run. On a docs-only PR, "Managed Agent gate" passes within a minute.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI configuration). Local results:
- New gate test: 49/49.
- Affected SDK Java, Hosted, failure-issue, finalize, broker and E2E workflow tests: 234/234.
- Runner-routing node tests: 45/45, with a new lane asserting that fork approvals stay hosted.
- Workflow sweep tests: 616/616, 1 skipped.
- actionlint clean on the new workflow; size gate passes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ meta-tests |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The full Hosted gate is flaky today. `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` (#14361) fails in about 41% of runs, and an fg8f timing assertion fails intermittently. Required now, the gate would block many Java PRs on noise, so the design recommends keeping it advisory until #14361 is fixed.
  - Merging waits for the full run after the first approval, up to about two hours.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - No live run of the new workflow, since it only triggers from this PR on.
  - Not done here: required-check, merge-queue and code-owner settings, and further cost levers (sharing the CLI build, splitting the Hosted job, nightly-only Java 17).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing callers. Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.md) | [中文](docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #14392, #14381, #14361

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增 "Managed Agent gate" 工作流，在还能拦住错误合入的时间点运行 SDK Java 套件，而不是每个 PR 的每次 push 都跑。

- 改到 Managed Agent Java 模块或其驱动的 harness 部分（`serve`、managed runtime、Hosted 集成测试 helper，以及套件运行的脚本）的 PR push 或 main push，跑快闸：Flyway 检查、真实 daemon E2E、Linux Java 21，约 25 分钟。
- 当前 head 的第一个 approve 跑全量（全部 11 项）。同一 head 之后的 approve，如果更早的 approve 运行已通过或仍在运行就跳过；失败后，下一个 approve 或 "Re-run failed jobs" 会重试。
- gate job 总会报告。改到路径的 PR，只有全量运行才会报告 `Managed Agent gate`，在那之前它显示为 Expected；未改到的 PR 几秒内报告通过。因此 `Managed Agent gate` 可以作为必需检查（包括 merge queue）使用，而且不需要写权限 token，fork PR 也适用。
- SDK Java 工作流新增 `tier` 输入；夜间、手动和发布运行不传，仍然全跑。
- approve 一个 fork PR 会产生 review 事件，以前的 runner 路由会把它送到自托管池；现在这类事件下不受信任的 fork 代码也留在托管 runner。
- 门禁自己的层级选择和结果报告 job 也用同样的信任路由，并带上共享的 checkout 前清理步骤。它们第一次运行就卡在了有 123 个运行排队的托管队列里，将来的必需检查不能等这个队列。
- SDK Java 的并发组现在包含事件和 commit，同一 PR 的快闸与全量运行不再互相顶替。
- main push 失败照常开 autofix issue；triage finalizer 用新工作流替换了 SDK Java（后者自 #14205 起已没有 PR 触发）。

本 PR 不把任何检查设为必需；分支保护仍由维护者决定。

## 为什么需要

自 #14205 起 SDK Java 套件只在夜间运行。2026-10-16，两个各自全绿的 PR 合在一起让 main 上 Managed Agent 的测试源码编译失败，直到夜间运行才被发现。Managed Agent 现在是重点保障的产品线，它和 harness 的改动必须在合入前通过全量套件。每次 push 都跑全量（每次约 330 机器分钟）负担不起；而由于过期的 approve 会被作废，head 的第一个 approve 是"晚于最后一次 push"的最早时间点。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 阅读设计文档中的事件表和检查名表。
- 本地新增的工作流测试会求值路径匹配、检查名与并发组表达式以及快闸矩阵，并用桩 `gh` 运行层级选择和结果报告脚本。两个变异——去掉去重里的 approve 事件过滤、让非全量的 PR 运行报告必需检查名——都会让它变红。
- 合入后，在改到 `packages/managed-agent-server/` 的 PR 上：push 后显示 "Managed Agent fast tier"，"Managed Agent gate" 保持 Expected；首个 approve 后由全量运行显示 "Managed Agent gate"。纯文档 PR 上，"Managed Agent gate" 一分钟内通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（CI 配置）。本地结果：
- 新门禁测试 49/49。
- 受影响的 SDK Java、Hosted、失败上报、finalize、broker 与 E2E 工作流测试 234/234。
- runner 路由 node 测试 45/45，新增一条断言 fork 的 approve 仍留在托管 runner。
- 工作流全量扫测 616/616（1 个跳过）。
- 新工作流 actionlint 无问题，体积门禁通过。

### 测试平台

macOS 上跑了元测试；Windows 不适用；Linux 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：
  - 全量 Hosted 门禁目前不稳定。`HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT`（#14361）约 41% 的运行失败，fg8f 时序断言也会间歇失败。如果现在设为必需，会因噪声卡住大量 Java PR，所以设计建议在 #14361 修复前保持非必需。
  - 首个 approve 后要等全量跑完才能合入，最长约两小时。
- 未验证 / 范围外：
  - 新工作流还没有实际运行过，它要从这个 PR 起才会触发。
  - 这里没做：必需检查、merge queue、code-owner 设置，以及进一步的降本手段（共享 CLI 构建、拆分 Hosted job、Java 17 只在夜间跑）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：现有调用方无变化。设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.md) | [中文](docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14392, #14381, #14361

</details>

prs.title: test(sdk-java): read the heartbeat scheduler queue on its own thread
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Two Hosted Harness client tests prove that a retired attachment also cancels its periodic heartbeat task by waiting for the client's scheduler queue to become empty. This PR makes that check read the queue on the scheduler's own (single) thread instead of from the test thread. The change is test-only.

## Why it's needed

`ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor` takes a periodic task off its queue while the task runs and puts it back afterwards, so a read from another thread can see an empty queue while the heartbeat task is still alive. The drain check stopped at the first empty read and then read the queue a second time for its assertion. If the task had been put back between the two reads, the test failed. That happened on the ECS ubuntu / Java 17 leg of run 38994148847: `aSessionNotFoundHeartbeatRetiresTheAttachment` failed with "the scheduler queue never drained" after 0.072 s, far short of the check's 5 s budget, on a head that changed no SDK code.

Locally, a probe with a live attachment (heartbeats answered 503, so nothing retires it) polled the queue from the test thread for 2 s and saw it empty 169,277 times across 164 heartbeats. The old check could therefore pass or fail depending on timing. A task submitted to the scheduler runs on its only thread, so while it runs no heartbeat task can be running, and a live heartbeat task must be sitting in the queue. The check also asserts on the same reading it stopped on.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `HostedHarnessClientTest` passes, including the two tests that use the drain check.
- With a temporary live-attachment probe (heartbeats answered 503), the new check reports "the scheduler queue never drained" after its 5 s budget instead of stopping early.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (test-only). Before: run 38994148847, ubuntu-latest / Java 17, `aSessionNotFoundHeartbeatRetiresTheAttachment` failed after 0.072 s. After, locally: both affected tests passed 300 repetitions each, the live-attachment probe failed as expected, and the full class passed (215 tests).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Maven 3.9 / JDK 21; Linux and Java 11/17 are covered by CI only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none for production code. The check now runs one tiny task on the client's scheduler per poll.
- Not validated / out of scope: the failure could not be reproduced by brute force locally (0 of 400 runs, with and without CPU saturation), because it needs both reads to fall around a run that lasts microseconds. The evidence is the CI failure, the probe, and the executor's documented behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14392

prs.title: feat(web-shell): delete selected message groups from session history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds grouped message deletion to Web Shell. The message action row keeps Copy and an overflow menu; Delete selects the current prompt and its complete reply group, with linked checkboxes and optional non-contiguous earlier groups. Reply selection stays beside the Processed header when present, including after expanding thoughts or tools.

Deletion removes the selected original records from JSONL and retained raw compression context, refreshes live model context and connected clients, and preserves every existing summary unchanged. Slash-command display groups can be removed without undoing command effects or files; frontend-only commands retain their position and identity across reloads and recovery.

## Why it's needed

Web Shell cannot currently remove arbitrary conversation groups. Rewind removes a suffix and retains abandoned history, so it does not satisfy physical deletion of selected turns. Users also need consistent behavior when deleting the only group, working around compression checkpoints, or recovering from stale snapshots and partially completed requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In an idle local daemon session, open a user message's overflow menu and choose Delete messages. The current prompt/reply group should be selected; toggling either checkbox must toggle the group. Select an earlier group while leaving a middle group unselected, confirm, and verify only the chosen groups disappear after reload and in other connected clients.
2. Expand thoughts/tools and verify a reply group still has one checkbox beside Processed, or beside its first reply when no status header exists. Run a local display command between turns; deleting another group must preserve the command's order and identity. Repeat at narrow viewport width and with keyboard/touch menu interaction.
3. Delete the only/all groups and continue the same session. Inspect persisted history and reopen the session: selected originals and paired tool records must remain absent, while files and command effects remain unchanged.
4. Compress a conversation, then delete groups before and after compression. Existing summaries must remain identical; only selected retained raw context should change later model input. A full compression followed by fast compression must retain the summary boundary and allow safe deletion.
5. Change history from another client while a selection is open. A conflict must clear stale selection and explain re-selection without automatically resubmitting deletion. A busy session must refuse deletion. If persistence succeeds but context installation fails, deleted identities must still reach the originator, its UI must reconcile, and further prompts must explicitly require reopening. Failed reloads must retain unselected local commands.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: there is no grouped physical-deletion action. After: the captured states below show the overflow action, linked non-contiguous selection, and the retained middle group after deletion.

**All screenshots use a simulated daemon HTTP/SSE backend and were visually inspected. They demonstrate UI behavior; actual JSONL/model-context verification was performed separately against a real daemon and ACP process with a deterministic local model.** Images are stored only in an independent fork asset branch and pinned to commit `70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8`.

UI screenshots refreshed after merging main `87dcc4a7` and applying review fixes; these captures still use simulated daemon responses.

Overflow menu:

![Web Shell message action menu (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/menu.png)

Linked non-contiguous group selection:

![Linked group selection (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/selection.png)

After deleting the first and third groups, the middle group remains:

![Unselected middle group retained (simulated daemon)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/after-deletion.png)

[Narrow viewport selection screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/mobile-selection.png) · [Bilingual evidence notes](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/README.md)

Review recovery evidence (simulated daemon):

![Unsupported saved-history deletion explanation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/unsupported.png)

[Disabled confirmation during a peer turn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/busy-confirm.png) · [Selection cleared after peer deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/peer-selection.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node.js 22; build, bundle, typecheck, focused unit tests and browser/backend E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local worktree development and bundled runtime; Chromium Playwright with simulated daemon responses for UI/error recovery, and isolated real daemon/ACP/JSONL with a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible model for persistence and model-context checks. The latest deletion browser suite passed 24/24 cases, including the review regressions. A separate E2E report comment records the validation layers and results.

## Risk & Scope

- Physical deletion is irreversible. Existing summaries may still contain information from deleted originals by design; summary text is never regenerated or edited.
- Scope is ordinary local daemon sessions. Managed authoritative storage, SSH workspaces and the hosted harness profile do not support this operation. Ambiguous legacy compression identities fail closed.
- Busy sessions are rejected. A failure after persistence keeps prompt admission closed until the session is reopened; it cannot continue with stale model context.
- This feature touches transcript persistence and cross-package session contracts; maintainer review is requested. It introduces no dependency or history migration and preserves normal append/resume behavior.
- Local verification did not cover Windows, Linux or live external model providers.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/dc0ac1223d80b56d40ef11329e7a8a45f9f466d0/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/dc0ac1223d80b56d40ef11329e7a8a45f9f466d0/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.zh-CN.md). Both versions include matching decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 Web Shell 添加整组消息删除。消息操作栏保留复制和更多操作菜单；删除会默认选择当前提问及完整回复组，checkbox 联动，并允许非连续选择更早的组。有「已处理」栏时，回复选择框放在其左侧，展开思考或工具后仍保持一个。

删除会从 JSONL 和压缩检查点保留的原文上下文中移除所选原始记录，刷新当前模型上下文和连接客户端，全部已有摘要保持不变。斜杠命令展示组可以删除，但不回滚命令效果或文件；仅存在前端的命令在重新加载及失败恢复期间保留原有位置和身份。

## 为什么需要

Web Shell 目前不能移除任意对话组。回退会删除后缀并保留废弃历史，无法满足所选轮次的物理删除。删除唯一组、跨压缩检查点删除，以及从过期快照和部分完成的请求中恢复，也需要一致的行为。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 在空闲的本地 daemon 会话中，打开用户消息的更多操作菜单并选择删除消息。当前提问与回复组应默认选中；切换任一 checkbox 都必须联动整组。另选一个更早的组，保留中间组，确认后验证仅所选组消失，重新加载和其他连接客户端中也保持一致。
2. 展开思考与工具，验证每个回复组仍只有一个 checkbox，位于「已处理」旁；没有状态栏时位于首条回复旁。在两轮之间执行前端展示命令，删除其他组后命令顺序与身份必须保留。再验证窄视口及键盘、触屏菜单交互。
3. 删除唯一组或全部组，再继续当前会话。检查持久化历史并重新打开会话：所选原文和配对工具记录仍应不存在，文件及命令效果保持不变。
4. 压缩会话后，分别删除压缩前后的组。已有摘要必须完全相同；只有所选、仍保留的原文上下文会改变后续模型输入。正常压缩后再快速压缩，仍必须保留摘要边界并允许安全删除。
5. 选择期间由另一客户端改变历史。冲突必须清除旧选择并提示重新选择，不能自动重发删除。会话忙碌时必须拒绝删除。若持久化成功而上下文安装失败，已删除身份仍必须返回发起方，界面必须对账，后续发送明确要求重新打开会话。重新加载失败时必须保留未选本地命令。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前没有整组物理删除入口。修改后的截图展示更多操作入口、联动的非连续选择，以及删除后保留的中间组。

**所有截图使用模拟 daemon HTTP/SSE 后端，并经过目视检查，只证明 UI 行为；真实 JSONL 和模型上下文验证另行使用真实 daemon、ACP 进程及确定性的本地模型完成。** 图片仅存于 fork 的独立素材分支，链接固定到 commit `70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8`。

已在合并 main `87dcc4a7` 并修复 review 问题后重新捕获并目视检查以下 UI 截图，仍使用模拟 daemon 响应。

对应截图：[更多操作菜单](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/menu.png)、[联动的非连续整组选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/selection.png)、[删除第一与第三组后保留中间组](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/after-deletion.png)、[窄视口选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/mobile-selection.png)。[中英文证据说明](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/README.md)。

本轮恢复证据（模拟 daemon）：[不支持删除的明确提示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/unsupported.png)、[他端轮次期间禁用确认](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/busy-confirm.png)、[他端删除后清空选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/70e43196eb4a2014ba2fd6b7217572a9004f98e8/peer-selection.png)。

### 验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node.js 22；build、bundle、typecheck、定向单测及浏览器/后端 E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 本地未验证 |

### 验证环境

本地 worktree 开发和打包运行时；UI 与错误恢复使用 Chromium Playwright 和模拟 daemon 响应；持久化与模型上下文使用隔离的真实 daemon/ACP/JSONL 以及确定性的本地 OpenAI 兼容模型。最新删除浏览器用例 24/24 通过，包含本轮 review 回归。独立 E2E 报告评论记录了验证层级与结果。

## 风险与范围

- 物理删除不可撤销。按照设计，已有摘要可能仍包含已删除原文的信息；不会重新生成或修改摘要文字。
- 仅支持普通本地 daemon 会话。Managed 权威存储、SSH 工作区和 hosted harness profile 不支持该操作；旧压缩记录归属不明确时安全拒绝。
- 会话忙碌时拒绝删除。持久化后失败时保持发送门禁关闭，直至重新打开会话，不能继续使用旧模型上下文。
- 该功能涉及转录持久化和跨包会话契约，请维护者审阅。不新增依赖或历史迁移，保留正常追加与恢复行为。
- 本地未验证 Windows、Linux 或真实外部模型供应商。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/dc0ac1223d80b56d40ef11329e7a8a45f9f466d0/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/dc0ac1223d80b56d40ef11329e7a8a45f9f466d0/docs/design/2026-10-15-web-shell-message-group-deletion.zh-CN.md)。两份文档的设计决策、约束和验收标准保持一致。

无。

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
8. The worktree and workflow-steering notices reproduce the same way through their own one-shot latches (`--worktree`, or a prompt containing the workflow keyword with the feature enabled); both should now render only the user's words while keeping their info line and footer indicator.

Automated:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx \
  src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/utils/historyUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
# 554 passed
npx tsc --noEmit            # clean
npx eslint <changed files>  # clean
npx prettier --check <changed files>  # clean
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

No terminal recording for this one — evidence is at the unit level, and I'm flagging that explicitly rather than implying a TUI capture was done.

- After: two new cases pin the live path (model request keeps the envelope while the transcript and the recall log carry only the user's words; stacked envelopes strip, mid-message and unterminated ones do not) and two pin the resume path (an envelope-only record restores as the bare prompt; a pasted envelope survives).
- Before: three pre-existing cancel-path expectations pinned the old text — they asserted the envelope inside the value that is both compared for identity and written back into the composer. Those three had to be updated, which is the direct before/after evidence for the cancel-restore path.
- Not run locally to completion: the full `packages/cli` suite. Every test file that mentions the reminder tag was run individually and passes, no snapshot contains it, and CI covers the rest.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts` fails 8 tests with `this.config.setCurrentSessionScheduledTaskCreator is not a function`. Verified identical on the base commit `0ef35351e9` with this branch's changes absent — the test's mocked config lacks a method the ACP session now calls. Not touched here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, lint and format on the changed files. No manual TUI run and no Windows/Linux run — the change is string handling with no platform-specific branch, but the manual steps above are the ones worth walking on a real terminal.

Fixes #11553

prs.title: fix(cli): stop re-submitting a peer message after every failed model call
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A cross-session message that has been admitted into a session's input queue no longer gets re-submitted after a failed model call. The submission callbacks now carry a failure reason, and the queued-submission drain uses it to decide what a failed turn means for a peer envelope: an interrupted turn still puts the envelope back, a turn that ended on a model error does not, and an admission failure keeps the single restore it already had. When the turn is given up, the sender's `delivered` receipt is corrected to `expired` so the message is not left looking read.

## Why it's needed

A delivered envelope is queued as a peer entry, destructively popped when it is submitted, and put back by `onDeliveryFailed`. Because the drain wired `onAdmissionFailed` and `onDeliveryFailed` to the same restore, a turn that ended on a terminal model error returned the envelope to the head of the queue, and the failed turn's settle then released the admission guard that was supposed to hold it. The drain submitted it again, the model call failed again, and the cycle repeated with no attempt counter, no backoff and nothing on screen — while the sender already held a `delivered` receipt. #14409 measured 1444 submissions of one message in 90 seconds against a keyless provider.

A typed prompt in the same session does not behave that way: it ends on one error and offers "Press Ctrl+Y to retry", leaving the retry to the user. The peer path turned the identical terminal error into an unbounded automatic retry. Restoring on *admission* failure is correct and stays; restoring on a *terminal* failure is what this PR removes.

The same wiring also queued one envelope twice: `use-llm-stream` fires both callbacks when a submission never starts (busy session, a mod that failed to load, an empty steer drain), and both restored it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression is visible in the drain's own unit test. Reproduce the old behavior by reverting just the peer `onDeliveryFailed` handler in `packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.tsx` to its previous unconditional restore, then run:

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx -t "settles a peer turn"
```

Observed before the change: the restored entry is re-popped and re-submitted, and `settleFailedPeerTurn` is never called. After the change the same test passes: one failed model call costs one submission, the entry stays gone, and the delivery is settled once.

The two neighboring tests pin the behavior that must not regress: `restores a peer entry whose in-flight turn is cancelled` (Esc still re-queues the envelope, and it drains again once the cancelled turn settles) and `restores a peer envelope once when admission and delivery both fail`.

Full runs used for this PR, on Windows:

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx        → 216 passed
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx → 298 passed
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/useMessageQueue.test.ts →  58 passed
npx eslint  <the five changed files>                             → clean
npx prettier --check <the five changed files>                    → clean
```

The added `peer-messaging.test.ts` cases are under the file's existing `describe.skipIf(isWindows)` guard (they need a real Unix socket), so they did not run here; see Risk & Scope.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not a TUI change: the loop was silent by design, which is why it was only observable from the sender's side. The evidence is the unit test above plus its mutation check (revert the handler → red, keep it → green).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

`npx vitest run <file>` from the repo root. The unit-test prerequisite guard needs `packages/acp-bridge` and `packages/channels/email` built; the latter could not be built in this checkout because its dependencies (`imapflow`, `nodemailer`, `mailparser`, `html-to-text`) are not installed and `npm install` fails here, so a local `dist/index.js` stub was used to let the guard pass. That stub is gitignored and is not part of this PR.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a peer message whose turn dies on a model error is now dropped instead of retried. That is deliberate — the alternative is the unbounded loop — and the sender is told via the `expired` receipt, but it does mean a message that would have succeeded on a second attempt is lost. Retrying is still available to the sender, and a *cancelled* turn still restores the envelope automatically.
- Not validated / out of scope: the two added `peer-messaging.test.ts` cases are skipped on Windows, so they are unverified locally; they mirror the existing `drops a queued envelope whose pin the session outgrew at drain` case, which asserts the same receipt path. `npm run test:ci` for the whole workspace was not run. The `expired` receipt is reused rather than introducing a dedicated `failed` status: `peer-send.ts` treats `expired` as a legal follow-up to `delivered`, and the exit scrub already uses it for "accepted, never consumed". A distinct status would be a cleaner sender-facing story but is a wider change to the status union and its transition map.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `onDeliveryFailed` gains a parameter; every existing callback still type-checks and ignores it.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14409

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

一条已被接收入会话输入队列的跨会话消息，在模型调用失败后不会再被反复重新提交。提交回调现在会带上失败原因，队列排空逻辑据此判断失败的一轮对 peer 信封意味着什么：被用户中断的一轮仍然把信封放回队列，因模型错误结束的一轮不放回，准入失败则保留它原本就有的一次恢复。放弃这一轮时，发送方手里的 `delivered` 回执会被更正为 `expired`，消息不会看起来像已被读取。

## 为什么需要

投递到的信封会作为 peer 条目入队，提交时被破坏性弹出，失败时由 `onDeliveryFailed` 放回。由于排空逻辑把 `onAdmissionFailed` 和 `onDeliveryFailed` 接到了同一个恢复函数，一轮因终局模型错误而结束时，信封会被放回队列头部；而这一轮的 settle 又会释放本应拦住它的准入护栏。于是排空逻辑再次提交、模型再次失败，如此循环 —— 没有尝试计数、没有退避、屏幕上也没有任何痕迹，而发送方早已拿到 `delivered` 回执。#14409 在无密钥的 provider 上测到一条消息在 90 秒内被提交 1444 次。

同一会话里用户手动输入的 prompt 不会这样：它只报一次错，并提供 "Press Ctrl+Y to retry"，是否重试由用户决定。peer 路径把完全相同的终局错误变成了无上限的自动重试。在*准入*失败时恢复是正确且保留的；在*终局*失败时恢复正是本 PR 去掉的行为。

同一处接线还会把同一个信封排两次：提交根本没开始时（会话忙、某个 mod 加载失败、steer drain 没有内容可发），`use-llm-stream` 会同时触发两个回调，而两个回调都会恢复它。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

回归在排空逻辑自身的单元测试里就能看到。把 `packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.tsx` 里 peer 的 `onDeliveryFailed` 处理函数改回原来无条件的恢复，然后运行：

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx -t "settles a peer turn"
```

改动前的表现：被恢复的条目会被重新弹出并重新提交，`settleFailedPeerTurn` 从未被调用。改动后同一测试通过：一次失败的模型调用只对应一次提交，条目保持消失，投递只被结算一次。

相邻的两个测试固定住不能回归的行为：`restores a peer entry whose in-flight turn is cancelled`（按 Esc 仍然把信封放回，且在被取消的一轮 settle 后再次排空）与 `restores a peer envelope once when admission and delivery both fail`。

本 PR 在 Windows 上的完整运行结果：

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx        → 216 passed
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx → 298 passed
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/useMessageQueue.test.ts →  58 passed
npx eslint  <五个改动文件>                                        → clean
npx prettier --check <五个改动文件>                               → clean
```

新增的 `peer-messaging.test.ts` 用例位于该文件已有的 `describe.skipIf(isWindows)` 守卫内（需要真实的 Unix socket），因此本地未运行，见「风险与范围」。

### 证据（改动前后）

这不是 TUI 改动：这个循环在设计上就是静默的，因此只能从发送方一侧观察到。证据是上面的单元测试及其变异验证（回退处理函数 → 失败，保留 → 通过）。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

在仓库根目录执行 `npx vitest run <文件>`。单元测试的前置检查需要先构建 `packages/acp-bridge` 与 `packages/channels/email`；后者在当前 checkout 无法构建（依赖 `imapflow`、`nodemailer`、`mailparser`、`html-to-text` 未安装，且此处 `npm install` 失败），因此用了一个本地 `dist/index.js` 桩让检查通过。该桩被 gitignore，不属于本 PR。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：因模型错误而结束的 peer 消息现在会被丢弃而不是重试。这是有意的 —— 另一种选择就是无上限循环 —— 并且会通过 `expired` 回执告知发送方；但这确实意味着一条本可在第二次尝试成功的消息会丢失。发送方仍可自行重发，而被*取消*的一轮仍会自动把信封放回。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：新增的两个 `peer-messaging.test.ts` 用例在 Windows 上被跳过，因此本地未验证；它们与既有的 `drops a queued envelope whose pin the session outgrew at drain` 用例同构，断言的是同一条回执路径。未运行整个 workspace 的 `npm run test:ci`。这里复用了 `expired` 回执，而没有新增专门的 `failed` 状态：`peer-send.ts` 把 `expired` 视为 `delivered` 的合法后继状态，且退出清理逻辑已经用它表示「已接收但从未消费」。独立的状态对发送方更清晰，但需要改动状态联合类型及其转移表，范围更大。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`onDeliveryFailed` 增加了一个参数；所有现有回调仍然通过类型检查并忽略它。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #14409

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a regression test pinning the HTML escaping on the webview's `lang` attribute.

## Why it's needed

This PR originally carried the one-line production fix as well, stamping `vscode.env.language` into the template instead of the hardcoded `lang="en"`. That part is already on `main` — `WebViewContent.ts` now does `const language = escapeHtml(vscode.env.language || 'en')` and interpolates it — so the only thing left here is the test coverage that did not land with it.

`main` has tests for the `zh-cn` value and for the empty-string fallback to `en`, but nothing exercises a value that actually needs escaping. The `escapeHtml` call on that line is therefore unpinned: dropping it leaves the whole suite green, so a later refactor could silently remove the escaping on an attribute that is interpolated straight into the document.

The added case sets the language to `"><script>alert(1)</script>` and asserts the entity-escaped output, matching `escapeHtml`'s entity set in `webviewUtils.ts`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
packages/vscode-ide-companion
  npx vitest run src/webview/providers/WebViewContent.test.ts   -> 14 passed
  npx eslint   src/webview/providers/WebViewContent.test.ts     -> clean
  npx prettier --check …                                        -> clean
```

Mutation check — remove `escapeHtml(...)` from the `const language = …` line in `WebViewContent.ts`:

```
× WebViewContent > escapes the language value in the html lang attribute
Tests  1 failed | 13 passed (14)
```

That is the only test that reds, which is the point: nothing else currently covers it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-visual internal change, verified by unit test)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: None. Test-only; no production file is touched.
- Not validated / out of scope: The `remoteName` handling `main` added to the same mock is left exactly as it is.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None

## Linked Issues

Refs #10373. The production change that issue asked for is already on `main`, so this no longer closes it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 现仅新增一个回归测试，用于固定 webview `lang` 属性上的 HTML 转义。

原先附带的一行生产代码改动（用 `vscode.env.language` 替换硬编码的 `lang="en"`）已经在 `main` 上：`WebViewContent.ts` 现为 `const language = escapeHtml(vscode.env.language || 'en')`。但随之而来的测试覆盖并未一起落地。

`main` 上已有 `zh-cn` 与空值回退 `en` 的用例，却没有任何用例使用需要转义的值，因此该行的 `escapeHtml` 没有被任何测试固定——移除它后整个套件仍然全绿，后续重构可能在无人察觉的情况下移除该属性的转义。

新增用例将语言设为 `"><script>alert(1)</script>` 并断言转义后的输出。变异验证：移除 `escapeHtml(...)` 后，仅该用例变红（1 failed | 13 passed）。

prs.title: fix(ci): start the reference distribution MySQL without native AIO
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The reference distribution job no longer declares MySQL as a service container. It starts the same `mysql:8.4` image as an explicit step with `--innodb-use-native-aio=0`, waits until the server accepts connections, publishes it on a random loopback port, exports that port to the following steps, and removes the container in an `always()` step.

## Why it's needed

#14416 traced the job's pool failures to two independent causes. The stale `RUNNER_TEMP/extracted` directory is already fixed (#14421). The other one is host-level: the ECS pool runs several jobs per host, `fs.aio-nr` is shared across all of them, and a mysqld with native AIO reserves AIO contexts at startup. When the budget runs out the container dies during init with `io_setup() failed with EAGAIN`, before any step runs — and a service container cannot take a command, so the job had no way to opt out.

Disabling native AIO makes InnoDB fall back to simulated AIO, which reserves no `io_setup()` contexts, so the job stops competing for a host-wide limit it does not control. The container is started explicitly rather than as a service because that is the only place the command line can be set.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the "Managed Agent Reference Distribution" run attached to this PR. It should land on the ECS pool (same-repo branch), start MySQL, grant the Flyway probe, build both Java modules, package the archive, boot the packaged server against the container, and upload the assets. The start step's log should end with a `MYSQL_PORT=` line, and the last step should remove the container.

Before this change the same job failed before its first step on most pool hosts; after it, the job's result no longer depends on which host picks it up.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, from the issue: 22 attempts between 2026-10-16 22:49Z and 00:10Z, only one passed; 17 of them died at `Failed to initialize container mysql:8.4`.

After: the dry run on this PR (linked from the checks tab once it finishes).

Locally, `mysql:8.4` started with the exact command line reports `innodb_use_native_aio=OFF`, and the start/cleanup step scripts run as written.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS: Docker 27.4.0, the image boots with native AIO off and the step scripts run end to end. Linux: the ECS dry run attached to this PR. Windows is not applicable, the job is Linux-only.

### Environment (optional)

Local Docker 27.4.0 for the container and script checks; the ECS pool run for the job itself.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: readiness and teardown are now the job's responsibility instead of the runner's. The start step blocks on `mysqladmin ping` before anything consumes the database, an `always()` step removes the container, and the container name carries the run id so concurrent jobs on one host cannot collide.
- Not validated / out of scope: `sdk-java.yml` also runs a database service container on the pool, and the issue notes it may be exposed to the same host-wide limit. This PR does not touch it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The packaged archive and the published assets are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14416

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

reference distribution 这个 job 不再把 MySQL 声明成 service container。它改为用一个显式步骤启动同一个 `mysql:8.4` 镜像，并传入 `--innodb-use-native-aio=0`，等数据库可以接受连接后，把它发布到 127.0.0.1 上的随机端口，把端口导出给后续步骤，最后用 `always()` 步骤删掉容器。

## 为什么需要

#14416 把该 job 在池子上的失败拆成了两个互相独立的原因。`RUNNER_TEMP/extracted` 残留目录的问题已经由 #14421 修掉；另一个原因在宿主机层面：ECS 池子一台机器上会同时跑多个 job，`fs.aio-nr` 是所有 job 共享的，而启用 native AIO 的 mysqld 在启动时就会占用 AIO 上下文。名额耗尽后，容器在任何步骤开始之前就死在初始化阶段，报 `io_setup() failed with EAGAIN`；而 service container 无法传命令参数，这个 job 没有退出的办法。

关掉 native AIO 后 InnoDB 改用模拟 AIO，不再申请 `io_setup()` 上下文，这个 job 也就不再和宿主机上其他 job 抢一个它控制不了的全局上限。改成显式启动容器，是因为只有那里才能设置命令行参数。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 怎么验证

打开这个 PR 触发的 "Managed Agent Reference Distribution" 运行。它应该落到 ECS 池子（同仓库分支），启动 MySQL、写入 Flyway 探针授权、编译两个 Java 模块、打包归档、用打包产物连上容器启动服务，并上传产物。启动步骤的日志末尾应有一行 `MYSQL_PORT=`，最后一个步骤应删除容器。

改动之前，这个 job 在大多数池子机器上第一个步骤都跑不到就失败；改动之后，job 的结果不再取决于被哪台机器接走。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（来自 issue）：2026-10-16 22:49Z 到 00:10Z 之间 22 次尝试只有 1 次通过，其中 17 次死在 `Failed to initialize container mysql:8.4`。

After：本 PR 的 dry run（跑完后见 checks 页签）。

本地用完全相同的命令行启动 `mysql:8.4`，`innodb_use_native_aio` 为 `OFF`，启动步骤和清理步骤的脚本也按原样跑通。

### 测试环境

macOS：Docker 27.4.0，镜像在关闭 native AIO 的情况下正常启动，步骤脚本端到端跑通。Linux：本 PR 的 ECS dry run。Windows 不适用，该 job 只在 Linux 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：就绪和清理从 runner 转由这个 job 自己负责。启动步骤会阻塞在 `mysqladmin ping` 上，直到数据库可用才继续；`always()` 步骤负责删除容器；容器名带 run id，同一台机器上的并发 job 不会撞名。
- 未验证/不在范围内：`sdk-java.yml` 也在池子上跑数据库 service container，issue 里提到它可能受同一个全局上限影响，这个 PR 没有改动它。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：没有。打包归档和发布产物都不变。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #14416

</details>

prs.body:
I work at You.com.

## What this PR does

Adds You.com to "Supported MCP Web Search Services" in `docs/developers/tools/web-search.md`, in the same format as the Firecrawl and SerpApi entries: description, Documentation/Cost/Get API Key/Best for bullets, Available Tools, and setup (CLI, `settings.json` without a key, `settings.json` with a key). One new section appended after SerpApi; nothing else on the page changes. Links use bare URLs (no UTM parameters) to match every other entry on the page.

## Why it's needed

The built-in `web_search` only turns on for a verified DashScope Responses host with a direct key. Everyone else (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, ModelScope, local models) is sent to the MCP list. The You.com free profile works with one command: 100 searches a day per IP, no key, no account.

For parity with the Firecrawl entry, as asked in #13987:

1. Data: the entry says search queries are sent to You.com, and with a key, so are the URLs you ask it to read.
2. Cost: free profile is 100 searches a day per IP with no API key. A key gives higher, per-account limits and adds `you-contents`.
3. Tools: lists only what registers on `?profile=free` (`you-search`, `you-discover`), then a separate "With an API key, the server also offers..." line.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run Method 1, then `qwen mcp list`. Output from a local build of this branch on a clean config:

```
$ qwen --version
0.25.1

$ qwen mcp add you -t http "https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free"
MCP server "you" added to user settings. (http)

$ qwen mcp list
Configured MCP servers:
✓ you: https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free (http) - Connected
```

I also ran a direct MCP `tools/list` against `https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free` with no API key (no `qwen` involved, just the HTTP endpoint) to confirm the keyless claims independently:

```
$ # initialize + tools/list over the Streamable HTTP transport, no key
event: message
data: {"result":{"tools":[{"name":"you-search","title":"Web Search",...},{"name":"you-discover","title":"Agent Discovery",...}]}}
```

`tools/list` returns exactly `you-search` (Web Search) and `you-discover` (Agent Discovery), two tools, no key. For contrast, the keyed endpoint `https://api.you.com/mcp` (no `?profile=free`) without a key returns `401 Unauthorized: OAuth authentication required`, which confirms the keyed/keyless split the entry describes.

- `prettier --check` passes on `docs/developers/tools/web-search.md` (ran locally).
- Full `npm run preflight` / `Qwen Code CI` not run on this head: this is a first-time fork contribution, so the workflow needs maintainer approval before it runs.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: docs-only change, no user-visible or TUI behavior to capture before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |        |
| 🪟 Windows |        |
|  🐧 Linux  | tested |

### Environment

Qwen Code 0.25.1 built from this branch, Node 22.23.3, Linux.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: it adds a third-party service to the docs list, the same way the others are listed. I work at You.com.
- Not validated: a model-driven search through a non-DashScope provider (no free model key on hand). Full `npm run preflight` not run, since this is docs only.
- Breaking changes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13987.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): give FG8d Sessions a 10 s writer lease so drain-release gets a capture slot
prs.body:
## What this PR does

FG8d Sessions now use a 10 s writer lease instead of the 60 s default, the same length FG8c's crash Sessions already use. With that change, FG8d's last case, `drain-release`, gets a capture slot and runs. The FG8a/FG8b/FG8d design doc explains the lease and the reason in both languages. Only test code and docs change.

## Why it's needed

On current `main`, FG8d fails at its sixth case, `drain-release`, after a 120 s timeout. This happens on any host fast enough to finish the earlier cases inside a minute.

- The six FG8d cases share one tenant, and the fixture admits four active captures (`active-captures=4`).
- A capture a case leaves OPEN keeps the expiry its last grant renewal set. That expiry is the earlier of the writer lease and the activation. Grant renewals stop once the tool call that launched the run returns. Under a 60 s lease, the capture therefore holds its slot for up to a minute after its case.
- When `drain-release` reserves its capture, cases 2–5 still hold all four slots. The store refuses the reservation with "Publication capacity exhausted" (`ToolPublicationStore.applyLocked:493`), which the Harness logs as `The request is invalid.` and then `recovery blocked`. The run is settled as never started.

#14398's runs were on a slower aarch64 rig, where the earlier captures expired in time. FG8c hit the same limit with seven cases under a 60 s lease and avoids it with its 10 s lease. Under a 10 s lease, a capture stops counting within ten seconds of its last renewal.

Two things that could break under the shorter lease were checked:
- FG8d's one store arm, `dropNextStopRevision`, matches a single stop-revision commit, so the extra writer and activation renewals cannot trip it.
- Background shell output is published through the Session's writer-token path (`ResourceToolResultSegmentStore` → `publishToolResult`), not through the grant, so the shorter grant expiry does not cut it off. Every capture row of every letter shows `capture_used_bytes = 0`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On Linux with a delegated cgroup v2 root (the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane sets one up), build core, bundle the CLI, and run `HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8d*` against a fresh MySQL 8.4. Expected: one test, no failures, and the driver log ends with six `FG8_CASE_OK` lines and `FG8_CANCEL_DRAIN_OK`.
2. To see the failure, run the same thing on `main`. Expected: `FG8 failed at drain-release Error: Timed out after 120000ms`, and four rows in `ma_output_capture` for the tenant with `state = 'OPEN'`.
3. Optionally, dispatch `sdk-java.yml` on this branch to get the same verdict from the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Lane-equivalent runs on Linux x86_64 with cgroup v2, MySQL 8.4.6 in Docker, JDK 21, and a CLI bundled from the tree under test:

| Run | `main` at `f597df5a60` | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FG8d alone, fresh DB | ❌ `drain-release` timed out (197.4 s), 4 OPEN captures in the tenant | ✅ 6/6 cases, 81.7 s, 2 OPEN captures at the end |
| Whole class, fresh DB | — | ✅ 7/7 tests (FG8a–FG8g), 434.9 s |

The same FG8d failure reproduced earlier on `main` + #14398 without #14407 and with the previous launcher (199.5 s), so it predates #14407. `prettier`, `eslint` and `tsc` are clean on the changed files.

Before committing, I ran three rounds of paired audits: an undirected reader given only the diff, and a reverse auditor given the claims above.
- Rounds 1 and 2 found only wording issues in the comment and the doc, all fixed: the expiry anchor, the error text the Harness actually logs, the single store arm, and the paragraph's placement.
- Round 3 found no Critical issue. Its one Suggestion was that grant expiry would starve background output. Probing the code and the database refuted it: the output path above, and `capture_used_bytes = 0` everywhere.
- Round 3's remaining Lows are deferred, listed below.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A (the gates need a Linux cgroup v2 root) |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64 with a delegated cgroup v2 root, `mysql:8.4.6` in Docker, JDK 21, Maven 3.9, Node 22, and the bundled `dist/cli.js`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: while a case runs, FG8d's writer and activation renewals keep about 5 s of slack instead of about 30 s. FG8c has already run green on the lane with the same trade.
- Not validated / out of scope: the lane itself. A dispatch of `sdk-java.yml` on this branch will show the `hosted-harness-mysql` result. Deferred round-3 Lows, none of which change behavior:
  - Strictly, renewals stop when the tool batch returns, not the tool call; FG8d has one call per batch.
  - The text does not mention that only captures whose producer is OPEN or FINISHING count.
  - The code comment and the doc paragraph overlap.
  - During `cancel-before-start`'s 30 s `:start` hold, the grant can lapse between renewals. The held `:start` is never forwarded, and FG8c has the same exposure.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-10-15-monitor-run-fault-gates-abd.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-15-monitor-run-fault-gates-abd.zh-CN.md); both gain the same paragraph in the driver design section.

## Linked Issues

- Follow-up to #14398, which grounded FG8a/FG8b/FG8d on Linux; this fixes the one FG8d case that still times out on a fast host.
- See #14163 (FG8 for `monitor_run` and the background Shell kind), #14407 (FG8c and its 10 s crash lease), #14054 (Stage F umbrella).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

FG8d 的 Session 改用 10 s writer lease，不再用默认的 60 s，与 FG8c 崩溃 Session 已在用的长度相同。改动之后，FG8d 的最后一个 case `drain-release` 能拿到 capture 名额并正常运行。FG8a/FG8b/FG8d 设计文档用中英两种语言说明了这个 lease 及其原因。只改了测试代码和文档。

## 为什么需要

在当前 `main` 上，FG8d 会在第六个 case `drain-release` 失败，等待 120 s 后超时。只要机器快到能在一分钟内跑完前面的 case，就会出现。

- FG8d 的六个 case 共用一个 tenant，夹具只允许四个活跃 capture（`active-captures=4`）。
- 一个 case 留下的 OPEN capture，其过期时间由最后一次 grant 续约设定，取 writer lease 与 activation 中先到期的那个。发起该 run 的工具调用一返回，grant 续约就停止。所以 60 s lease 下，case 结束后这个 capture 最长还会占着名额约一分钟。
- `drain-release` 申请 capture 时，case 2–5 仍占着全部四个名额。store 拒绝这次 reservation，报 "Publication capacity exhausted"（`ToolPublicationStore.applyLocked:493`），Harness 日志里先是 `The request is invalid.`，然后是 `recovery blocked`。run 被结算为从未启动。

#14398 的验证跑在较慢的 aarch64 机器上，前面的 capture 来得及过期。FG8c 当初在 60 s lease 下连续跑七个 case 时撞过同一个上限，靠 10 s lease 避开。10 s lease 下，capture 在最后一次续约后十秒以内就不再计入名额。

缩短 lease 可能带来的两个问题都核对过：
- FG8d 唯一的 store 臂 `dropNextStopRevision` 只匹配一条 stop revision 提交，多出来的 writer 与 activation 续约不会误触发它。
- 后台 shell 输出经由 Session 的 writer token 路径发布（`ResourceToolResultSegmentStore` → `publishToolResult`），不经过 grant，所以 grant 更早过期不会截断输出。所有字母的所有 capture 行都显示 `capture_used_bytes = 0`。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在已委托 cgroup v2 根的 Linux 上（`hosted-harness-mysql` 车道会配置），构建 core、打包 CLI，然后在全新的 MySQL 8.4 上运行 `HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8d*`。期望：一个测试、零失败，driver 日志以六行 `FG8_CASE_OK` 和 `FG8_CANCEL_DRAIN_OK` 结尾。
2. 想看到失败，就在 `main` 上做同样的事。期望：`FG8 failed at drain-release Error: Timed out after 120000ms`，且该 tenant 在 `ma_output_capture` 里有四行 `state = 'OPEN'`。
3. 可选：在本分支上手动触发 `sdk-java.yml`，从 `hosted-harness-mysql` 车道拿到同样的结论。

### 证据（前后对比）

UI 方面 N/A。以下是与车道等价的运行：Linux x86_64，cgroup v2，Docker 中的 MySQL 8.4.6，JDK 21，CLI 由被测树打包：

| 运行 | `main`（`f597df5a60`） | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 单独跑 FG8d，全新数据库 | ❌ `drain-release` 超时（197.4 s），该 tenant 有 4 个 OPEN capture | ✅ 6/6 个 case，81.7 s，结束时 2 个 OPEN capture |
| 整个类，全新数据库 | — | ✅ 7/7 个测试（FG8a–FG8g），434.9 s |

此前在不含 #14407、使用旧 launcher 的 `main` + #14398 上，同样的 FG8d 失败也复现过（199.5 s），所以这个问题早于 #14407。改动文件的 `prettier`、`eslint`、`tsc` 都通过。

提交前做了三轮成对审计：一个无方向审计只拿到 diff，一个反向审计拿到上面列出的主张。
- 第 1、2 轮只发现注释和文档的措辞问题，均已修正：过期时间的起点、Harness 实际记录的报错文本、只有一个 store 臂、以及这一段在文档里的位置。
- 第 3 轮没有 Critical。唯一一条 Suggestion 认为 grant 过期会掐断后台输出，经代码与数据库核实不成立：输出路径见上文，且所有 capture 都是 `capture_used_bytes = 0`。
- 第 3 轮剩下的 Low 记为延后项，见下文。

### 实测平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A（门禁需要 Linux cgroup v2 根） |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux x86_64，已委托 cgroup v2 根；Docker 中的 `mysql:8.4.6`；JDK 21、Maven 3.9、Node 22；打包产物 `dist/cli.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：case 运行期间，FG8d 的 writer 与 activation 续约余量从约 30 s 降到约 5 s。FG8c 在同样的取舍下已在车道上跑绿。
- 未验证/不在范围：车道本身。在本分支上手动触发 `sdk-java.yml` 可以看到 `hosted-harness-mysql` 的结果。延后处理的第 3 轮 Low，都不影响行为：
  - 严格说，续约是在工具批次返回时停止，而不是工具调用；FG8d 每个批次只有一次调用。
  - 文中没写只有 producer 处于 OPEN 或 FINISHING 的 capture 才计入名额。
  - 代码注释与文档段落内容重复。
  - `cancel-before-start` 挂起 `:start` 的 30 s 里，grant 可能在两次续约之间过期。被挂起的 `:start` 从未转发，FG8c 也有同样的情况。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。
- 设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-15-monitor-run-fault-gates-abd.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-15-monitor-run-fault-gates-abd.zh-CN.md)；两版都在 driver 设计一节加了同样的一段。

## 关联 Issue

- 是 #14398 的后续：#14398 把 FG8a/FG8b/FG8d 落实到 Linux，本 PR 修复其中在快机器上仍会超时的那个 FG8d case。
- 另见 #14163（`monitor_run` 与后台 Shell 的 FG8）、#14407（FG8c 及其 10 s 崩溃 lease）、#14054（Stage F 伞形 issue）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): account tool result sizes from producer to injection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Tool results carry raw, processed and final submitted size estimates across existing output-reduction boundaries. Injection is recorded once per newly executed call after final budgeting and media handling; retries, inherited fork history and replay do not recount it. Restored raw sizes remain unknown. New size records exclude output bodies, arguments, local paths and digests, and internal provenance never enters provider JSON.

Oversized results retain complete recoverable originals. Bounded JSON samples preserve original keys and disclose omissions; metadata stays outside the payload namespace. Web extraction retains its existing processing input while the complete outward envelope follows ordinary limits. Configured media estimates and actual reduction budgets are carried through persistence, batch and injection. Cancellation or hook replacements cannot claim producer savings.

## Why it's needed

A late preview length cannot explain original result size, where it was reduced or what was submitted. The same pipeline must also preserve recovery pointers and prevent sample corruption, repeated accounting and misleading budget attribution.

Design: [English](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Produce oversized text or valid JSON; confirm complete originals remain recoverable, the preview fits its budget and original sample keys/values survive.
- Continue with inherited history or retry; confirm prior calls are not counted again, and an unchanged tiny sibling has no aggregate truncation claim.
- Return an image with a configured estimate, or reject webpage extraction; confirm actual submitted size reflects retained media and the final outward limit, while extraction still receives a distant needle.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Local macOS native CLI, stdio MCP, production file logs/metrics and matched120x40 tmux runs are recorded in the [closeout report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13652#issuecomment-6080274673). Baseline sample corruption, media-config mismatch, repeated inherited injection and102699-character web envelope were reproduced. Controlled candidate runs preserve originals and correct accounting; the long web result is2621 characters. Exact source hashes, final getter-order delta reuse, all26 attempts and screenshot boundaries are stated in the report.

Core/CLI build and typecheck, changed-file lint/format pass. Core1888 related tests are covered by passing results and595 affected reruns;98 logger and1188 ACP tests pass. Two independent source/ponytail passes found no remaining confirmed owned Critical.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ controlled native CLI/tmux plus unit checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

## Risk & Scope

- Main tradeoff: additional per-call numeric telemetry and in-memory provenance; this measures internal submitted estimates, not provider billing or delivery acknowledgement.
- Outside scope: representative real-model quality, complete cost/P95, telemetry-backend deployment and optional histogram/registry/no-op-layer tuning. Ordinary25k/1000, independent200k aggregate and MCP500k policies remain unchanged; MCP default convergence requires a separate product decision. Pressure-aware budgeting stays in #13599.
- Migration: no new setting, dependency or persisted transcript format.

## Linked Issues

Addresses #11536 size accounting and oversized-output recovery. The separate MCP default-policy decision is not closed by this PR. Split from #13599.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

工具结果在现有缩减边界上携带原始、处理后和最终提交的大小估算。注入事件在最终预算和媒体处理之后，按新执行调用记一次；重试、fork继承历史和重放不会重复计数。恢复结果的原始大小保持未知。新的大小记录不含结果正文、参数、本地路径或摘要；内部来源信息不会进入provider JSON。

超大结果保留可恢复的完整原文。受限JSON样本保留原始键并说明省略，元数据不覆盖载荷键。网页提取保留原有处理输入，完整外层返回遵守普通额度。配置化媒体估算及实际缩减预算贯穿落盘、批量和注入；取消或hook替换不会冒报生产者节省。

## 为什么需要

只有最终预览长度，无法说明原文多大、哪里缩减、最终提交多少。同一流程还要保留恢复指针，避免样本损坏、重复计数及错误预算归属。设计文档：[English](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/tool-result-size-accounting.zh-CN.md)。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 产生超大文本或合法JSON，确认原文完整可恢复，预览符合预算，样本的原始键和值没有被改写。
- 继承历史继续调用或重试，确认旧调用不重复计数，未改变的小结果不会冒报批量裁剪。
- 返回配置化估算的图片，或让网页提取失败，确认实际提交计量包含保留的媒体并遵守最终外层上限，内部处理仍能读到较远的针值。

### 前后证据

本地macOS原生CLI、stdio MCP、生产文件日志/指标和120x40配对tmux记录见[收尾报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13652#issuecomment-6080274673)。已复现旧样本损坏、媒体配置不生效、继承注入重复统计及102699字符网页外层越界；受控候选保留原文并修正计量，长网页最终为2621字符。报告明确列出源码指纹、最终getter顺序修复的增量复用、全部26次尝试及截图能证明的范围。

core/CLI构建、类型检查和定向lint/格式检查通过。相关core1888项由通过结果及595项受影响复测覆盖，98项日志及1188项ACP测试通过。两份独立源码/ponytail审查未发现剩余已确认的自有Critical。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 受控原生CLI/tmux及单测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：增加逐调用数值遥测和内存来源信息；这些是内部提交估算，不是provider账单或送达确认。
- 不在范围内：代表性真实模型质量、完整成本/P95、遥测后端部署及可选直方图/词汇表/无变化层调优。普通25k/1000、独立200k聚合和MCP500k策略保留；MCP默认值统一另需产品决定。随上下文压力调整的预算仍在#13599。
- 迁移：没有新增设置、依赖或持久化记录格式。

## 关联 Issue

处理#11536的大小计量和超大输出恢复；独立MCP默认策略决定不由本PR关闭。从#13599拆出。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): wrap long lines in tool-card diff instead of per-line scrollbars
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Long lines in the Web Shell tool-card diff (WriteFile / Edit) now wrap inside the diff line instead of rendering each as its own horizontally scrollable strip, so a diff with long comment lines or paths reads top-to-bottom without per-line scrollbars.

## Why it's needed

The diff content was rendered with `white-space: pre` and `overflow-x: auto`, which kept every line on one line and gave each one its own horizontal scroller. Any line longer than the card width was clipped and only readable by scrolling that specific line. Switching to wrapping preserves intra-line spacing and indentation while letting the block-level vertical scroll (`.lines { max-height: 400px }`) remain the only scroll surface. A `min-width: 0` is added so the flex item can actually shrink and wrap; `overflow-wrap: anywhere` covers unbreakable tokens such as long paths and URLs.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run Qwen Code in Web Shell mode (`qwen serve` or Qwen Code Desktop) and trigger a WriteFile or Edit tool call whose added content includes lines longer than the card width (e.g. a script with ~150-character comment lines). Confirm the long lines wrap and no per-line horizontal scrollbars appear; line numbers and +/- markers stay in place, and the diff still scrolls vertically past 400px.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: each long line is a clipped horizontal strip with its own scrollbar. After: lines wrap within the content column.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |        |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅    |
|  🐧 Linux  |        |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (CSS-only change; verified by reading the rendered diff view).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: long lines now wrap, which increases the visual height of the diff; the existing max-height vertical scroll bounds this.
- Not validated / out of scope: TUI (terminal) diff rendering, which uses a different surface.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13248

## 为什么需要

diff 内容此前使用 `white-space: pre` 与 `overflow-x: auto` 渲染，导致每行保持单行且各自拥有独立的水平滚动条。任何超出卡片宽度的行都会被截断，只能通过单独滚动该行来阅读。改为自动换行后，仍保留行内空格与缩进，并让原有的块级垂直滚动（`.lines { max-height: 400px }`）成为唯一的滚动面。新增 `min-width: 0` 使 flex 子项能够真正收缩并换行；`overflow-wrap: anywhere` 覆盖长路径、URL 等不可断开的片段。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 Web Shell 模式下运行 Qwen Code（`qwen serve` 或 Qwen Code Desktop），触发一次 WriteFile 或 Edit 工具调用，使新增内容包含超过卡片宽度的行（例如含有约 150 个字符注释行的脚本）。确认长行发生换行、不再出现逐行水平滚动条；行号与 +/- 标记保持原位；超过 400px 高度的 diff 仍可垂直滚动。

prs.title: fix(runtime-broker): support credential key rotation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allow the Managed Runtime Broker to rotate its AES-256-GCM credential key without losing access to existing bindings. One active key encrypts every new Runtime seed and credential, while a configured previous-key map decrypts older ciphertext by its persisted key ID. Unknown key IDs, malformed keys, wrong key lengths, and duplicate active/previous IDs continue to fail closed.

The existing single-key configuration remains valid. Rotation does not rewrite stored ciphertext during reads and does not require a schema migration.

## Why it's needed

The database already stores the encryption key ID with every protected credential, but the server currently configures only one key. Replacing that key therefore makes all rows written under the previous key unreadable and can orphan persisted Runtime bindings. Operators need a bounded key-ring transition so they can add a new active key, retain the old key for reads, and remove it only after no persisted row references it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create a secret with `reference-v1`, then configure `reference-v2` as the active key and `reference-v1` under `previous-credential-keys`. The rotated protector should decrypt the existing secret, while every new secret records `reference-v2`. Removing `reference-v1` should restore the existing fail-closed `Runtime credential key is unavailable` result for old ciphertext. Duplicate IDs, malformed Base64, and values that do not decode to exactly 32 bytes should fail during protector construction/server startup. A deployment with only the existing active pair should behave unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — configuration and encrypted-storage behavior; no UI change. Exact-head CI evidence will be added after the workflows finish.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ implementation review, bilingual contract review, and `git diff --check`; local build/tests intentionally not run |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

No local runtime was started. Compilation and focused Java tests are delegated to CI for the exact PR head.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: previous keys remain sensitive deployment material until database evidence proves no persisted credential references them; removing a referenced key intentionally makes those rows unreadable.
- Not validated / out of scope: automatic re-encryption, key generation or expiry, secret-manager integration, and standalone maintenance-entry key-ring configuration.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The ciphertext format, persisted key-ID fields, AES-GCM context binding, and existing active-key settings are unchanged.

Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/a75db26ac0776ddf8417364b5e850b3972fa4f88/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/a75db26ac0776ddf8417364b5e850b3972fa4f88/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13202

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的修改

让 Managed Runtime Broker 可以轮换 AES-256-GCM 凭据密钥，同时继续读取既有 binding。一把 active key 负责加密所有新的 Runtime seed 和 credential；配置的 previous-key map 根据持久化 key ID 解密旧密文。未知 key ID、格式错误、长度错误以及 active/previous ID 重复仍会安全失败。

现有单密钥配置继续有效。轮换不会在读取时改写持久化密文，也不需要数据库迁移。

## 修改原因

数据库已经在每条受保护凭据旁保存加密 key ID，但服务器目前只能配置一把密钥。直接替换密钥会让此前写入的所有记录不可读，并可能使持久化 Runtime binding 失去可恢复性。运维需要一个有边界的 key-ring 过渡：加入新的 active key，保留旧密钥用于读取，并且只在没有持久化记录继续引用它之后再删除。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

先使用 `reference-v1` 创建 secret，再把 `reference-v2` 配置为 active key，并把 `reference-v1` 放入 `previous-credential-keys`。轮换后的 protector 应能解密既有 secret，所有新 secret 则记录 `reference-v2`。删除 `reference-v1` 后，旧密文应恢复既有的 fail-closed 结果 `Runtime credential key is unavailable`。重复 ID、错误 Base64 以及解码后不是正好 32 字节的配置，应在 protector 构造或服务器启动阶段失败。只配置现有 active pair 的部署应保持原有行为。

### 前后证据

N/A——这是配置和加密存储行为变更，没有 UI 变化。工作流完成后会补充精确 PR head 的 CI 证据。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 已完成实现审查、双语契约审查和 `git diff --check`；按要求未在本地运行 build/tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

未启动本地运行时。编译与聚焦 Java 测试交由精确 PR head 的 CI 执行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：previous key 在数据库证据证明没有持久化凭据继续引用它之前，仍属于敏感部署材料；删除仍被引用的 key 会按设计使这些记录不可读。
- 未验证及范围外：自动重加密、密钥生成或过期、密钥管理服务集成，以及独立 maintenance entry 的 key-ring 配置。
- 破坏性变化及迁移：无。密文格式、持久化 key-ID 字段、AES-GCM context binding 和既有 active-key 设置均不变。

设计：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/a75db26ac0776ddf8417364b5e850b3972fa4f88/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/a75db26ac0776ddf8417364b5e850b3972fa4f88/docs/design/2026-10-15-runtime-credential-key-rotation.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13202
