prs.title: test(managed-agent): add the FG10a workflow child_run digest-integrity fault gate (#14165)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements the FG10a slice of [#14165](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/14165): the Stage F fault gate for the `workflow` `child_run` kind's digest integrity. Four multi-process cases now prove the launch pin under fault — a tampered launch envelope is refused by the child Turn's re-verification before any model spend, a byte-length-equal substitution with a syntactically valid runnable script is refused on the digest alone, and a fractional-`args` launch crosses the daemon/SDK admission digest with its values provably reaching the execution end instead of wedging. The shape follows FG7/FG8 exactly: a real packaged Harness, a per-case TypeScript driver, an in-JVM Spring control plane against a real MySQL, and JDBC ground truth. The change touches no production code.

The four cases: `tampered-script-refused` (the probe rewrites the pinned envelope's script bytes, byte-length preserving, after the record committed and before the relay reads it), `same-length-substitution-refused` (a complete, syntactically valid, runnable script of identical byte length — the refusal is attributable to the digest alone, never a parse error), `fractional-args-admitted` (args carry `0.1` and `5e-324` across the real daemon/SDK boundary), and `substitute-script-baseline` (an honest launch of the substitute script itself, proving it runs to completion under a matching digest). Each fault case first proves its injection fired — the tamper is re-read from the store, and the refusal is asserted to name the two digests, not a generic admission error. The positive case reads the child Turn's final content and compares the echoed args value-exactly — the wire rendering varies by hop (the server-side store renders the subnormal `4.9E-324`, the sandbox echoes `5e-324`, the canonical substrate sorts the keys) but every hop parses to the identical double, so a relay that dropped or normalised args before the payload digest would turn the gate red.

Two scope decisions the design document records honestly: the assertions sit at the child Turn rather than the record's terminal settlement, because the digest refusal fires inside the Turn and runs independently of the relay's later bind/deliver walk — which a driver-held parent cannot drive to completion without a coordinator-owned attach (a Linux-only topology here). And FG10d (process crash) is deferred: its gate caught the recovery re-driving an unsettled workflow Turn after a Harness kill, which is a genuine finding tracked by [#14387](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/14387) and outside this test-only slice.

## Why it's needed

The workflow kind is the newest of the three enabled `child_run` kinds and the only one whose execution is deterministic and digest-pinned. Its distinctive failure is quiet: a wedged Turn produces no crash, no lost reply, no storage error. The digest re-verification is the only thing standing between a pinned definition and a substituted one, and it fails silently by design — it refuses, it does not crash. Until this gate, the pin was proved only by functional tests; the fractional-`args` wedge that #13858 fixed was found by implementation, not by a test that would have caught the next such mismatch.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Build the packaged CLI first: `npm run build && npm run bundle` (the gate drives the packaged harness via `qwen serve --profile hosted-harness` on the bundled entrypoint).
2. Start a throw-away MySQL/MariaDB and run the letter: `cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn -Phosted-workflow-gates failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dmysql.url=jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:13306/fg10a -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=root -Dnode.executable="$(which node)"`.
3. Expected vs observed: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0`. All four cases print `FG10_CASE_OK` and the letter prints `FG10_DIGEST_GATE_OK`. Measured locally at ~16 s for the letter on macOS.
4. The mutation check (documented in the design doc): neutralizing the digest comparison in `hosted-workflow-turn.ts` turns both refusal cases red (the tampered script executes and the child Turn completes instead of refusing); restoring it returns the gate green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this PR adds integration-test infrastructure; it changes no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ (CI lane)   |

### Environment (optional)

Local: `npm run build && npm run bundle`, a throw-away `mysql:8.4.6` Docker container, `mvn -Phosted-workflow-gates`. The workflow kind owns no OS processes, so the gates need no cgroup delegation (unlike FG8).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the gate's assertions sit at the child Turn, not the record's terminal settlement — the driver-held parent cannot drive the relay's bind/deliver walk to completion on macOS (it needs a coordinator-owned attach, a Linux-only topology). The Turn-level assertions are exactly the digest property this letter owes; the record's relay-driven settlement is FG10b/c's machinery.
- Not validated / out of scope: FG10b/c/e/f (kind-agnostic mechanisms) and FG10d (process crash) — FG10d's gate caught the recovery re-driving an unsettled workflow Turn after a Harness kill, tracked by [#14387](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/14387). The CI fork timeout did not move: the class adds one 600 s-ceiling letter, and the shared fork's healthy-runtime ledger now counts the letter's measured 15.9–16.2 s at 2× (`hostedForkHealthySeconds` 2930 → 2963; `600 + 2963 = 3563 ≤ 3600`), per the ledger discipline from #14333.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design doc (both languages, synchronized): [`2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.md`](../blob/test/14165-fg10a-workflow-digest-gates/docs/design/2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.md) · [`zh-CN`](../blob/test/14165-fg10a-workflow-digest-gates/docs/design/2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

References #14165 (the FG10 tracker; FG10a is this PR, FG10d follows #14387).
References #14387 (the FG10d process-crash finding this PR defers).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

实现 [#14165](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/14165) 的 FG10a 切片:`workflow` `child_run` kind 摘要完整性的 Stage F 故障门禁。四个多进程 case 现在在故障下证明 launch 的 pin——被篡改的 launch envelope 在任何 model 花费之前被 child Turn 的重验拒绝;一份语法合法、可运行的等长替换脚本只被摘要拒绝;携带 fractional `args` 的 launch 跨 daemon/SDK 准入摘要、且这些值被证明确实到达执行端,绝不楔死。形态完全沿用 FG7/FG8:真实打包 Harness、每 case 一个 TypeScript 驱动器、in-JVM Spring 控制面接真实 MySQL、JDBC 地面真相。不改任何生产代码。

四个 case:`tampered-script-refused`(probe 在记录提交之后、relay 读取之前,按字节长度不变地改写被 pin 的 envelope 脚本字节)、`same-length-substitution-refused`(一份完整、语法合法、可运行、字节长度相同的不同脚本——拒绝只归因于摘要,绝非解析错误)、`fractional-args-admitted`(`args` 携带 `0.1` 与 `5e-324` 跨真实 daemon/SDK 边界)、`substitute-script-baseline`(对替换脚本本身做诚实 launch,证明它在匹配摘要下跑完)。每个故障 case 都先证明注入确实发生——篡改从存储里重读出来,拒绝被断言点名两个摘要而非泛化准入错误。正向 case 读取 child Turn 的最终内容并对回显的 args 做值级精确比较——线上渲染因跳而异(server 端存储把 subnormal 渲染为 `4.9E-324`、sandbox 回显 `5e-324`、canonical 底座把键排序)但每一跳都解析为同一个 double——因此若 relay 在算 payload digest 前丢弃或归一化参数,门禁会变红。

设计文档如实记录的两个范围决定:断言落在 child Turn 而非记录的终态结算——摘要拒绝发生在 Turn 内部,独立于 relay 后续的 bind/deliver 链运行,而 driver 直挂的 parent 在没有 coordinator 持有的 attach 时(这里是仅 Linux 的拓扑)无法把那条链驱动到底。以及 FG10d(进程崩溃)延后:它的门禁抓到恢复机制在 Harness 被杀后重新驱动了一个未结算的 workflow Turn,这是由 [#14387](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/14387) 跟踪的真实发现,越出了本测试切片之外。

## 为什么需要

workflow kind 是三个已启用 `child_run` kind 里最新的,也是唯一执行既确定性又受摘要 pin 约束的。它特有的失效很安静:被楔死的 Turn 不产生崩溃、不产生丢失的应答、不产生存储错误。摘要重验是「一份被 pin 的定义」与「一份被替换的定义」之间唯一的东西,而它在设计上静默失效——拒绝而非崩溃。在这道门禁之前,这个 pin 只有功能测试证明;#13858 修掉的 fractional-`args` 楔死是被实现过程发现的,不是被一道本可以抓到下一次同类不匹配的测试发现的。

## 验证方式

1. 先构建打包 CLI:`npm run build && npm run bundle`。
2. 起一个一次性 MySQL/MariaDB,跑该 letter:`cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn -Phosted-workflow-gates failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dmysql.url=... -Dmysql.user=root -Dnode.executable="$(which node)"`。
3. 期望:`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0`,四个 case 都打印 `FG10_CASE_OK`,letter 打印 `FG10_DIGEST_GATE_OK`。本地实测该 letter 在 macOS 上约 16 s。
4. mutation 检验:中和 `hosted-workflow-turn.ts` 的摘要比对会让两个拒绝用例变红;还原后转绿。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡:断言落在 child Turn 而非记录的终态结算(理由见上)。
- 不在范围内:FG10b/c/e/f 与 FG10d(后者抓到的重执行发现由 #14387 跟踪)。CI fork 超时未动:本类加一个 600 s 上限的 letter,共享 fork 的健康时长账本现已按 #14333 的记账纪律计入该 letter 实测 15.9–16.2 s 的 2×(`hostedForkHealthySeconds` 2930 → 2963;`600 + 2963 = 3563 ≤ 3600`)。
- 无破坏性变更。

设计文档(双语同步):`docs/design/2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.md` 与 `2026-10-16-workflow-fault-gates-ad.zh-CN.md`。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: test(managed-agent): add the FG10a workflow child_run digest-integrity fault gate (#14165) (#14390)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* test(managed-agent): add the FG10a workflow child_run digest-integrity fault gate (#14165)

Stage F round FG10 (umbrella #14054), the workflow child_run kind enabled by
#13858. This slice lands FG10a — the digest-integrity gate — following the
FG7/FG8 shape: a real packaged Harness, a per-case TypeScript driver, an
in-JVM Spring control plane against a real MySQL, and JDBC ground truth.
No production code changes.

Three cases prove the launch pin under fault: a tampered envelope (bytes
rewritten after the record committed, before the relay reads it) is refused
by the child Turn's re-verification naming both digests, before any model
spend; a same-length substitution is refused the same way; and a launch
whose args carry fractional and subnormal values (0.1, 5e-324) crosses the
daemon/SDK admission digest byte-identically, never wedging on
invalid_hosted_prompt. The mutation check (neutralizing the re-verification)
turns the refusal cases red, and the gate is green again once restored.

The gate's assertions sit at the child Turn, not the record's terminal
settlement: the digest refusal fires inside the Turn and runs independently
of the relay's later bind/deliver walk, which a driver-held parent cannot
drive to completion without a coordinator-owned attach (a Linux-only
topology). FG10d (process crash) is deferred to #14387: its gate caught the
recovery re-driving an unsettled workflow Turn after a Harness kill, which
violates 'never re-executed on reopen' and needs adjudication outside this
test-only slice.

* test(managed-agent): prove FG10a's substitution is digest-attributable and args reach the child

Review feedback on #14390 found the gate could not prove what it
claimed: the same-length substitution rewrote the script into text the
real compiler rejects with a SyntaxError, so removing the digest check
would have failed on a parse error rather than executing the substitute;
and the fractional-args case passed without the special values ever
being observed at the execution end.

The substitution now swaps in a driver-authored script that is
syntactically valid, byte-length equal, and proven runnable by a new
substitute-script-baseline case, so the refusal is attributable to the
digest alone. The positive case reads the child Turn's final content
through a new probe endpoint and compares the echoed args value-exactly
— the wire rendering varies by hop (the store renders the subnormal
4.9E-324, the sandbox echoes 5e-324, keys arrive sorted) but every hop
parses to the identical double.

Verified: FG10a 4 cases green; with the digest check neutralised, both
refusal cases turn red with the tampered/substitute script executing to
COMPLETED; checkstyle, relay-headers and hosted-process-ci pins green.

---------

prs.title: test(serve): widen the Hosted Harness idle wait on loaded runners
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR widens the idle-status wait in the Hosted Harness model-selection test from the `vi.waitFor` default 1s window to 10s, the same budget two neighbouring cases in that suite already carry.

## Why it's needed

The `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` job on main went red on a84dbff2 at the idle poll — `AssertionError: expected true to be false` — on all three attempts of `--retry=2`, after the case had already spent 15863ms. The next push (20ddb526) ran the identical test against identical serve code and passed it in 391ms, so the red main was a timing budget, not a behavior regression from the push.

Two things point at the budget rather than the code. The runner reported load averages of 15–19 while the file ran, and the settle path this poll waits on crosses fsync-backed journal commits before the active flag clears — the exact reason two other tests in this suite were already moved off the default 1s window with a 10s budget (#14101, #13219). The queue emptied after the failed case, so the collateral `ENOTEMPTY` from the cleanup `rm` is downstream of the failure, not a second problem.

Before: the poll gave the settle 1s and flaked on a loaded runner. After: it gives it 10s, matching the rest of the suite.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Hosted Harness model-selection case on a loaded machine and watch the idle poll. Expected: it passes, as it does in the green run on the next main commit. Observed before this change on a loaded runner: the poll sees `hasActivePrompt: true` for longer than 1s, the assertion fires, and the suite retries the case to the same result.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Failing run ([38908932988](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38908932988/job/117002760526)) on a84dbff2:

```
FAIL  src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts > Hosted Harness no-tool session > persists model selection and refuses changed resident and cold prompt replays
AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
    1319|         expect(result.body.hasActivePrompt).toBe(false);
```

Green run of the same test and the same serve code on 20ddb526 ([38915124451](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38915124451/job/117020647917)):

```
✓ src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts (551 tests) 188999ms
  ✓ Hosted Harness no-tool session > persists model selection and refuses changed resident and cold prompt replays  391ms
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS covers the case itself (10 runs green, three of them with the widened budget); Windows and Linux are left to CI.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit test only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuine hang in this case now takes 10s to surface instead of 1s; the neighbouring cases already accept that budget for the same poll.
- Not validated / out of scope: no source behavior is touched, so runtimes other than macOS are only covered by CI. Close-out of the flake across the sibling test added by the same PR (#14316) is deliberately left out.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

No tracking issue. Reference: failing main run [38908932988](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38908932988/job/117002760526).

## 为什么需要

N/A —— 仅单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：该用例若真的卡死，现在需要 10s 才暴露，而不是 1s；相邻用例的同一轮询已经接受这个预算。
- 未验证 / 范围外：没有改动任何源码行为，因此 macOS 之外的运行时只由 CI 覆盖。同一个 PR（#14316）引入的兄弟用例的同类 flake 收尾，刻意留到后续处理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

没有跟踪 issue。参考：main 上的失败运行 [38908932988](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38908932988/job/117002760526)。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): keep the harness daemon log in Hosted shell lifecycle evidence
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a Hosted shell lifecycle recovery case finishes, its evidence copy now walks the whole case directory, so `runtime/debug/daemon/daemon.log` (and any other nested log) reaches the uploaded `hosted-harness-mysql-reports` artifact with its relative path kept. Until now only root-level files were copied.

## Why it's needed

#14361's failures show the harness turn being refused by the session store with a bare `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`. Neither side records which route or check refused it. #14391 adds the store-side WARN. The harness-side detail lives in the daemon log, which the report never kept. With both in place, the next intermittent failure names its route instead of needing another reproduction attempt.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On the next run of the Hosted process fault gates that fails a `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` case, the artifact's `l4-shell-lifecycle/<case>/` directory should contain `runtime/debug/daemon/daemon.log` alongside the existing `harness.log` and `spring-*.log`. The path comes from the harness's own startup line, e.g. `daemon log → /tmp/junit-…/settle-ack/runtime/debug/daemon/daemon.log` in run 38838205142.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the `settle-ack` and `detach-ack` folders of run 38838205142 hold only `harness.log` and `spring-1.log`. After: not yet observed. The class needs Linux, MySQL 8.4 and a delegated cgroup, so it was not run locally. The test sources compile and Checkstyle reports no errors.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ compile + Checkstyle |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the copy now includes every `.log` below the case directory, so the artifact grows by whatever the daemon and broker wrote for that case.
- Not validated / out of scope: the root cause of #14361 itself. This only keeps the evidence.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14361, #14391

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Hosted shell 生命周期恢复用例结束时，证据复制现在会遍历整个用例目录，`runtime/debug/daemon/daemon.log`（以及其他嵌套的日志）会保留相对路径进入上传的 `hosted-harness-mysql-reports` artifact。此前只复制根目录下的文件。

## 为什么需要

#14361 的失败显示 harness 的 turn 被 session store 拒绝，只留下一句 `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`，两边都没记下是哪个接口、哪项检查拒绝的。#14391 补上 store 端的 WARN；harness 端的细节在 daemon 日志里，而报告一直没保留它。两者都到位后，下一次间歇失败就能直接指明接口，而不必再尝试复现。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

下一次 Hosted 进程故障门禁里有 `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` 用例失败时，artifact 的 `l4-shell-lifecycle/<用例>/` 目录应在原有的 `harness.log` 和 `spring-*.log` 旁边包含 `runtime/debug/daemon/daemon.log`。路径取自 harness 自己的启动日志，例如 run 38838205142 中的 `daemon log → /tmp/junit-…/settle-ack/runtime/debug/daemon/daemon.log`。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：run 38838205142 的 `settle-ack` 和 `detach-ack` 目录只有 `harness.log` 和 `spring-1.log`。之后：尚未观察到。该测试类需要 Linux、MySQL 8.4 和委派的 cgroup，本地没有运行；测试源码编译通过，Checkstyle 无错误。

### 测试平台

macOS 上编译并跑了 Checkstyle；Windows 不适用；Linux 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：复制现在包含用例目录下所有 `.log`，artifact 会随该用例中 daemon 和 broker 写出的内容变大。
- 未验证 / 范围外：#14361 本身的根因；本 PR 只负责保住证据。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14361, #14391

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): keep the setup-java Maven cache on hosted runners
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Every `actions/setup-java` step in the SDK Java checks and in the Managed Agent reference distribution release now enables its Maven cache only on GitHub-hosted runners. On self-hosted ECS runners the cache is off; those hosts already keep `~/.m2` between jobs, and the job-local Maven repository seeding and write-back stay exactly as they were. A workflow meta-test pins all seven sites to the hosted-only expression and fails if a new `setup-java` step is added without it.

## Why it's needed

On an ECS host, setup-java's post-job step tars the entire shared `~/.m2` repository before it tries to reserve the cache key. Parallel jobs on the same pom key race for that reservation, so all but one job spend 14 to 37 minutes building an archive and then discard it ("Unable to reserve cache … another job may be creating this cache"), as seen across the 2026-10-16 SDK Java runs. The wasted time is roughly 95 machine minutes per full SDK Java run, close to 30% of it, and it lengthens the release lane added in #14336 the same way. Hosted runners start with an empty home, so they keep the cache.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the SDK Java workflow (dispatch on this branch) and confirm that the self-hosted jobs no longer show a long "Post Set up Java" step or a cache reservation warning, while hosted jobs (macOS, Windows, the Hosted gate) still restore and save their Maven cache. Locally, the workflow meta-tests cover the seven sites; reverting any one site to `cache: 'maven'` makes the new test fail (checked).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI configuration). Local results: SDK Java workflow tests 68/68, the related Java workflow suites 106/106, the reference-package and runner-routing node tests 49/49, and the workflow size gate passes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ meta-tests |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an ECS host with an empty `~/.m2` (new or wiped) resolves dependencies through the egress proxy on its first job instead of from a cache archive; later jobs reuse the host's repository.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live dispatch on this branch; the tiered Managed Agent gate (#14392) is a separate change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14392, #14336

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

SDK Java 检查和 Managed Agent 参考发行版发布流程里的每个 `actions/setup-java` 步骤，现在只在 GitHub 托管 runner 上启用 Maven 缓存。自托管 ECS runner 上关闭缓存：这些机器本来就在 job 之间保留 `~/.m2`，job 私有 Maven 仓库的预填与回写保持原样。新增的工作流元测试把 7 处都钉成"仅托管"表达式，以后新增 `setup-java` 步骤没带它就会失败。

## 为什么需要

在 ECS 机器上，setup-java 的 post-job 步骤会先把整个共享 `~/.m2` 打成 tar 包，再尝试预留缓存 key。同一 pom key 的并行 job 争抢这次预留，除一个外都白花 14 到 37 分钟打包然后丢弃（"Unable to reserve cache … another job may be creating this cache"），2026-10-16 的 SDK Java 运行里都能看到。每次全量 SDK Java 运行约浪费 95 机器分钟，接近三成；#14336 新增的发布流程也一样被拖长。托管 runner 每次都是空的 home，所以保留缓存。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

在本分支上手动触发 SDK Java 工作流，确认自托管 job 不再出现很长的 "Post Set up Java" 步骤或缓存预留警告，而托管 job（macOS、Windows、Hosted 门禁）仍会恢复并保存 Maven 缓存。本地由工作流元测试覆盖 7 处；把任意一处改回 `cache: 'maven'`，新测试就会失败（已验证）。

prs.title: docs(troubleshooting): add workaround for TUI flicker in web-based terminals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a troubleshooting entry for TUI flickering/tearing in web-based terminals (for example Alibaba Cloud Workbench), documenting the confirmed cause and the verified workaround (`ui.useTerminalBuffer: false`, optionally `ui.mouseTracking: false`). Docs only — no code changes.

## Why it's needed

Issue #8659 reports continuous flicker/tearing when Qwen Code runs in browser-based terminals. @doudouOUC confirmed the cause in the thread: `shouldUseVirtualViewport()` cannot distinguish web terminals (`TERM=xterm` on a TTY, no `COLORTERM`, no `TERM_PROGRAM`), so Virtualized History activates by default and its full-screen ANSI repaints overwhelm high-latency web terminals. The fix direction agreed in the thread is "docs + startup hint first, auto-detection later". This PR delivers the docs half so affected users can find the workaround today; the startup hint and auto-detection need a detection-heuristic design discussion (missing `COLORTERM` + `TERM_PROGRAM` alone false-positives on ordinary SSH xterm sessions) and are proposed as a follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Docs-only change. Confirm the new entry renders correctly in `docs/users/support/troubleshooting.md` (placed next to the other terminal-behavior entries: tmux trackpad, right-click/mouse tracking). The workaround itself was verified by the reporter in #8659: setting `ui.useTerminalBuffer: false` switches rendering to the append-only Static path and resolves the flicker in Alibaba Cloud Workbench.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — docs change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Alibaba Cloud Workbench (browser-based terminal), TERM=xterm, no COLORTERM/TERM_PROGRAM — the environment from the original report.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none identified; documentation only, workaround wording follows the maintainer's confirmed analysis in #8659.
- Not validated / out of scope: the startup hint and web-terminal auto-detection/fallback (needs design discussion on reliable detection signals; offered as follow-up).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Part of #8659

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

为「基于 Web 的终端（如阿里云 Workbench）中 TUI 闪烁/撕裂」问题新增一条 troubleshooting 文档，记录已确认的原因和已验证的解决方案（`ui.useTerminalBuffer: false`，可选 `ui.mouseTracking: false`）。纯文档改动，无代码变更。

## 为什么需要

Issue #8659 报告在浏览器终端中运行时 Qwen Code 持续闪屏/撕裂。@doudouOUC 在讨论中确认了原因：`shouldUseVirtualViewport()` 无法识别 web 终端（TTY 上 `TERM=xterm`、无 `COLORTERM`、无 `TERM_PROGRAM`），导致 Virtualized History 默认启用，其全屏 ANSI 重绘超出高延迟 web 终端的处理能力。讨论中商定的修复方向是「先文档 + 启动提示，自动检测后续再做」。本 PR 先交付文档部分，让受影响用户今天就能找到解决方案；启动提示与自动检测需要先讨论检测启发式（仅凭缺少 `COLORTERM` + `TERM_PROGRAM` 会在普通 SSH xterm 会话上误报），建议作为后续 PR。

prs.title: feat(ci): compile the Java modules on pull requests and on pushes to main
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a `Java Compile Gate` workflow that compiles, test-compiles and checkstyles the Java modules — first the SDK install the server resolves from the local repository, then the managed agent server, then both checkstyle configurations — on every pull request that touches `packages/managed-agent-server/**` or `packages/sdk-java/**` (or this workflow itself), and on every push of such a change to `main`. A failure on the push arm rides the existing main-failure issue and autofix route, so a merge that leaves `main` uncompilable files its own issue instead of waiting for the daily Java batch or for an unrelated pull request to trip over the tree. Runs on `main` are never cancelled — the policy `ci.yml` and `e2e.yml` document — so a push-arm verdict always lands, while a pull request still supersedes its own older run. The heavy Java lanes stay exactly where #14205 put them: the MariaDB/MySQL integration lanes, RocketMQ gates, daemon E2E and hosted fault gates keep running on `sdk-java.yml`'s daily schedule and manual dispatch, and this gate does not run the Java 11/17 matrix.

## Why it's needed

Nothing compiled the Java sources on a push to `main`. `sdk-java.yml` — the only suite that builds them — fires on `schedule` (47 19 UTC), `workflow_dispatch` and `workflow_call`; the one PR-time Java build, in the reference-distribution workflow, sits behind pull-request path filters and never runs post-merge.

That is how #14370 merged green on 2026-10-16 after renaming the object store's configuration check without the inline test fixture #13918 had added 35 minutes earlier: `main`'s test sources stopped compiling at 11:46Z, the repair only landed at 13:21Z carried by an unrelated PR, and in between every reference-distribution run on a pull request whose tree merged that `main` went red — nine runs, including #14336, whose diff shares nothing with the failure. The first signal a maintainer gets is a red check on somebody else's pull request, or the 03:47 Asia/Shanghai batch. Issue #14381 records the incident and this proposal.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Trigger shape: a pull request touching `packages/managed-agent-server/**`, `packages/sdk-java/**` or the workflow file runs `Java Compile Gate`; a docs-only or web-shell pull request does not. The push arm is `main`-only and path-filtered the same way.
- This PR exercises the gate on itself: the workflow file is on its own path list, so the run attached to this PR is the end-to-end healthy-tree evidence. Expect `Install the Java SDK`, `Compile the Managed Agent Server` and both checkstyle steps to pass.
- Confirm a red push run reaches the issue route: `Java Compile Gate` is now in the watched list of the main-failure workflow, and its failure on a push to `main` opens or updates a deduplicated `type/bug` issue with autofix routing, like a red `Qwen Code CI` push run.
- The expensive lanes must not move: `sdk-java.yml`'s triggers, jobs and matrix are untouched by this diff, and the CI budget ledger records the one new PR-stage job.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI gate, no user-visible surface). The behavioral before/after is already on record: the two commands this gate runs are the ones that failed on the broken tree — #14336's [run 38905186683](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38905186683) failed its Java build at testCompile on `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT.java:367` and `:378` — and this PR's own gate run is the healthy-tree counterpart.

Local verification (macOS, Temurin JDK 21, Maven 3.10.0), run through the exact step commands:

- SDK checkstyle: `You have 0 Checkstyle violations.` / `BUILD SUCCESS` in 3.8s.
- Server checkstyle, both configurations: `You have 0 Checkstyle violations.` twice / `BUILD SUCCESS` in 17.7s. This one is worth calling out, because `sdk-java.yml` runs the SDK's checkstyle on its JDK 11 leg only — that JDK 21 works was an assumption until measured, and a red-on-healthy-tree gate would have been worse than no gate.

Workflow and ledger checks: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/java-compile-gate-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` → 259 passed, 1 skipped; `node .github/scripts/check-ci-budget.mjs` → `PR-stage CI budget holds`; `node scripts/lint.js --actionlint` with the pinned actionlint 1.7.12, `--yamllint`, `--eslint` and `prettier --check` clean over the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Worktree install of the repository's dependencies, Temurin JDK 21 at `/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21`, Maven 3.10.0. No runtime, no database; the gate itself runs on `ubuntu-latest`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a Java pull request now waits on a compile-and-checkstyle job that the daily cadence deliberately moved off pull requests. The job runs on `ubuntu-latest` rather than the ECS pool — matching the reference-distribution Java build, and keeping the shared pool for the heavy lanes — and the Maven cache keeps a warm run at a few minutes; if hosted queue time becomes the bottleneck, the same job can be routed to ECS later. It runs no tests, so this is the cheap half of the suite, not the ten-check fan-out #14205 removed.
- Not validated / out of scope: the `push` arm has not fired yet (it first runs once this merges); a scratch-branch negative control did confirm the gate goes red on the #14370 shape ([run 38918852721](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38918852721), commented below); local Windows/Linux runs are N/A; `merge_group` is not wired because the queue is not enabled, so a queued merge would validate at the pull request rather than in the queue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `sdk-java.yml` keeps its schedule/dispatch/workflow_call triggers and its full matrix.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14381

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增 `Java Compile Gate` 工作流：对触及 `packages/managed-agent-server/**` 或 `packages/sdk-java/**`（以及该工作流自身）的 pull request，以及这类改动推到 `main` 时，执行编译、测试源码编译与 checkstyle —— 先安装 server 从本地仓库解析的 SDK，再打包 managed agent server，最后跑两套 checkstyle。推送分支上的失败接入既有的 main 失败建单与 autofix 路由，因此一次让 `main` 编译不过的合并会自己建单，而不是等每日 Java 批跑或等到无关 PR 撞上这棵树。`main` 上的运行永不被取消——即 `ci.yml` 与 `e2e.yml` 已记录的策略——所以推送分支的结论一定落地，而 pull request 仍会顶掉自己更早的那次运行。重型 Java 车道保持 #14205 的安排不变：MariaDB/MySQL 集成、RocketMQ 门禁、daemon E2E 与 hosted fault gates 仍在 `sdk-java.yml` 的每日计划与手动触发上跑，本门禁也不跑 Java 11/17 矩阵。

## 为什么需要

推到 `main` 时没有任何东西编译这些 Java 源码。`sdk-java.yml` 是唯一会构建它们的套件，但只在 `schedule`（47 19 UTC）、`workflow_dispatch` 和 `workflow_call` 上触发；PR 阶段唯一会构建 Java 的 reference distribution 工作流挂在 pull request 路径过滤上，合并后根本不会跑。

2026-10-16 的 #14370 就是这样绿着合并的：它改了对象存储的配置检查方法名，却没有改 #13918 在 35 分钟前刚加入的内联测试夹具。`main` 的测试源码从 11:46Z 起编译不过，直到 13:21Z 才由另一个无关 PR 顺手修复；这期间凡是合并了这棵坏 `main` 的 pull request，其 reference distribution 全红——共九次，包括与失败毫无关系的 #14336。维护者拿到的第一个信号，是别人 PR 上的红叉，或者北京时间 03:47 的批跑。Issue #14381 记录了这个事故与本方案。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 触发形态：触及 `packages/managed-agent-server/**`、`packages/sdk-java/**` 或本工作流文件的 PR 会跑 `Java Compile Gate`；纯文档或 web-shell 的 PR 不会。推送分支只限 `main`，路径过滤与 PR 侧一致。
- 本 PR 会自己验证这个门禁：工作流文件在它自己的路径列表里，所以挂在本 PR 上的 run 就是健康树上的端到端证据。预期 `Install the Java SDK`、`Compile the Managed Agent Server` 与两条 checkstyle 步骤通过。
- 确认推送分支上的红会进入建单路由：`Java Compile Gate` 已加入 main 失败工作流的监听列表，它在推到 `main` 时的失败会像 `Qwen Code CI` 的推送失败一样，开启或更新一条去重的 `type/bug` autofix issue。
- 重型车道不得移动：本 diff 不改 `sdk-java.yml` 的触发器、job 和矩阵，CI 预算账本记录了新增的这一个 PR 阶段 job。

### 修改前后证据

N/A（CI 门禁，没有用户可见界面）。行为上的前后对照已有记录：本门禁执行的正是当年在坏树上失败的那两条命令——#14336 的 [run 38905186683](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38905186683) 在 testCompile 上失败于 `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT.java:367` 与 `:378`；而本 PR 自己的门禁 run 就是健康树上的对照。

本地验证（macOS、Temurin JDK 21、Maven 3.10.0），按步骤里的原始命令执行：

- SDK checkstyle：`You have 0 Checkstyle violations.` / `BUILD SUCCESS`，3.8s。
- Server checkstyle 两套配置：两次 `You have 0 Checkstyle violations.` / `BUILD SUCCESS`，17.7s。这条值得单说：`sdk-java.yml` 只在 JDK 11 那条腿上跑 SDK 的 checkstyle，JDK 21 能否通过此前只是假设；一个在健康树上误红的门禁比没有门禁更糟。

工作流与账本检查：`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/java-compile-gate-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` → 259 通过、1 跳过；`node .github/scripts/check-ci-budget.mjs` → `PR-stage CI budget holds`；固定版本 actionlint 1.7.12 的 `node scripts/lint.js --actionlint`、`--yamllint`、`--eslint` 与 `prettier --check` 在改动文件上全部干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A  |

### 环境（可选）

worktree 内安装的仓库依赖、Temurin JDK 21（`/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21`）、Maven 3.10.0。不涉及运行时与数据库；门禁本身跑在 `ubuntu-latest`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：触及 Java 的 PR 现在要多等一个编译加 checkstyle 的 job，而这正是每日节奏当初从 PR 上挪走的成本。该 job 跑在 `ubuntu-latest` 而不是 ECS 池（与 reference distribution 的 Java 构建一致，把共享池留给重型车道），Maven 缓存让热跑只需几分钟；若托管队列成为瓶颈，同一个 job 之后可以改走 ECS。它不跑任何测试，所以这是套件的廉价一半，而不是 #14205 移除的十项扇出。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：`push` 分支尚未触发（本 PR 合并后才会第一次运行）；已用临时分支做反向对照，确认门禁会在 #14370 那种坏法上变红（[run 38918852721](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38918852721)，评论见下）；本地 Windows/Linux 为 N/A；因为没有启用合并队列，未接 `merge_group`，排队合并会在 PR 阶段而非队列内验证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`sdk-java.yml` 保持 schedule/dispatch/workflow_call 触发器与完整矩阵。

prs.title: feat(channels/dingtalk): add mediaStorage option so image attachments can be stored to disk
prs.body:
## Problem

The DingTalk channel downloads inbound media but handles images and non-image
files differently:

- non-image files are written to disk under `tmpdir()/channel-files/<uuid>/`
  and exposed to the agent as an attachment with `filePath`
- images are kept in memory only (`data: base64`) so they can be used as vision
  input

As a result, when a user sends a photo, there is no file on disk. Any workflow
that needs the original image (asset registration, hashing, editing based on
the source image) cannot work.

Source: `packages/channels/dingtalk/src/DingtalkAdapter.ts`, the
`if (mediaType === 'image')` branch.

## Change

Add an optional channel option `mediaStorage` with values `'inline' | 'file'`,
defaulting to `'inline'` so existing behaviour is unchanged.

When set to `'file'`, images take the same path as other media: stored under
the temp channel store and delivered as an attachment with `filePath`.

The change is a single condition, plus the option declaration and validation:

    if (mediaType === 'image' && this.mediaStorage !== 'file') {

`GENERATED_MEDIA_EXT` already maps image MIME types to extensions, so the
existing filename fallback works for images without further changes, and image
storage inherits the existing error handling (ENOSPC, over-long names,
non-string file names, partial-store cleanup, graceful text-only degradation).

## Compatibility

No behaviour change unless the option is explicitly set to `'file'`.

## Relation to docs/design/2026-07-30-omni-managed-media-storage.md

That design assumes inbound user media already exists on disk — it keeps user
files in place and records their identity as `localPath + sha256`, and only
puts bytes Qwen Code itself generates or downloads into `objects/`.

DingTalk image attachments currently have no on-disk copy at all: they are
decoded into an in-memory base64 attachment and never persisted. This change is
therefore a prerequisite for that design rather than a competing mechanism — it
gives inbound images a real path so they can be treated like any other local
file.

The option is deliberately off by default and does not overlap with
`omni.storage`, which governs retention, capacity and quarantine policy rather
than whether a message attachment is written to disk.

If the maintainers prefer inbound images to be localised through the Omni
identification path instead, I am happy to withdraw this and align with that
direction — closing it in favour of the Omni work is a fine outcome for me.

## Docs

I could not locate the channel configuration doc page for DingTalk. Happy to
update it if you can point me to the right file.

## Tests

I was unable to run the test suite locally (no Node toolchain available on the
machine I used). I have verified the code paths by reading the upstream source.
Please advise whether a test is required for the `'file'` branch, and I will add
it.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): Improve workspace selection and tool progress
prs.body:
## What this PR does Managed New workspace can select an existing project directory on the Linux execution host. The picker browses an authorized root owned by the actor, creates a logical Workspace over its verified storage, and preserves the selected working directory across creation retries, reselect and reload. Empty Workspace creation remains available. If a directory is refused, users can explicitly abandon the saved local confirmation and choose another directory or an empty Workspace, including after reload. Exact-key retry remains available for uncertain requests; abandonment does not delete any Workspace that may already exist. The local directory flow and the current main SSH registration flow keep separate request types, browser drafts and dialogs; remote SSH/CSI storage cannot become a local browsing root. Hosted tool calls expose safe lifecycle metadata using their original model-call identities, so a silent command shows a running tool and elapsed time, terminal states survive transcript reload, and tools separate consecutive assistant commentary. The model loop follows the existing `model.maxSessionTurns` setting instead of a separate hardcoded 16-round ceiling. Java persistence and saved model/approval continuation validation accept the same late rounds, so a valid request can be saved and restored before inference. Managed chat reuses the daemon WebShell presentation and compact status row, including correct total duration after replay. ## Why it's needed Local Managed debugging previously required starting in an empty directory. A reported Turn executed 18 tools, including a silent 300-second download that timed out, but published no tool progress; it eventually failed at the private 16-round ceiling with a generic error. Users could not distinguish an active command from a stalled agent. Directory selection and visible tool state make existing projects usable and long-running work diagnosable. A refused directory previously left creation frozen across reloads with no way to correct it; explicit local abandonment restores editing without treating every refusal as proof that no server operation exists. A long task could also stop after 16 completed reads because persistence rejected its next model request, leaving the page running with no model request in flight. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. On a configured Linux deployment, open Managed → New workspace → Choose existing directory, select a project below an ACTIVE ROOT Workspace you own, and create a named Workspace. Its saved relative directory should survive refresh and reselect; a real file read should run in that project while preserving the selected model and draft. 2. Retry an uncertain creation using the same key and selection. It should return one Workspace; a changed request should conflict. Refuse a nonexistent directory, reopen or reload the draft, then explicitly abandon local confirmation: choosing a valid directory or creating an empty Workspace must use a new key. A dropped success response must still replay the same Workspace on exact-key retry; failed browser-storage removal must keep the original request frozen. Another actor or tenant, insufficient grants, changed source generation, traversal, symlinks and reserved directories must be refused without directory disclosure. An existing-directory selection retains the source storage's shared access and lease scope. Confirm that remote Workspaces are absent from local directory candidates and that SSH registration still selects its returned working directory. Exactly 100 selectable subdirectories plus filtered entries should not indicate truncation; 101 selectable directories or exceeding the 1024-entry raw scan budget should. 3. Run a short silent Shell and then read a fixture file in a disposable Session. Confirm that a running tool appears before output, elapsed time advances, success/failure is visible, and commentary is separated by tool steps. Refresh after completion: tool identities, terminal state, final answer and total elapsed time should remain stable. Reuse a pre-restart disposable Session to confirm a surviving worker can continue. 4. Run a twenty-file dependent-read prompt in a fresh disposable Session and let the real verifier check its generated proof. It should persist model requests beyond round 15, complete late Shell approvals, handle a verifier failure and finish without a restart or another user message. Refresh should preserve the result and tool steps. Controlled model-loop and replacement-owner tests also cover positive configured caps, saved model/approval round counting and Hook-stop precedence. Raw arguments and results must continue through the existing publication policy. ### Evidence (Before & After) | Scenario | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Existing project | New workspace accepted only a name and created an empty directory. | The selected Linux project becomes the persistent default directory and a real model reads its existing marker file. | | Correcting a directory | A refused path left the name disabled and picker hidden, even after reopening or reload. | Real-component jsdom plus isolated Java HTTP tests verify explicit abandonment, valid-directory and empty fallbacks, remount persistence, lost-response same-key replay and storage-failure retention. This is a test-script fallback, not new browser-screenshot evidence. | | Directory page limit | Exactly 100 eligible directories followed by a regular file or reserved directory incorrectly reported truncation. | The same Linux fixture returns all 100 directories without truncation; 101 eligible directories still report truncation. | | Tool progress | 18 settled executions produced zero public tool lifecycle events; a 312-second gap looked stuck. | A disposable real-model run produced seven lifecycle updates for three distinct tool Items, including failure, silent execution and a file read. | | Transcript and appearance | Assistant commentary was concatenated, the footer used a separate large card, and completed snapshot timing could show 3s for a much longer Turn. | Shared daemon message/tool presentation, compact status, ordered commentary and a refreshed total of 4m36s. | | Long task continuation | The next request was rejected after 16 reads; the page stayed running without model activity. | A fresh real-model Turn persisted rounds 0–24, completed 24 tools and late approvals, and retained Completed with 51s after refresh. The original blocked test Turn also recovered and completed. | ![Selected Linux project directory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/directory-selected.png) ![Silent tool running with compact status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/progress-running.png) ![Completed transcript after refresh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/progress-completed.png) The following screenshots are separate Sessions: the first blocked task and a fresh task after the repair. ![Complete prompt before the persistence fix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/complete-prompt-blocked.png) ![Fresh complete prompt after repair and reload](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/complete-prompt-completed.png) ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested: build, types, unit checks and browser | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested: Lima deployment, real model/tools, MySQL and surviving-worker continuation | ### Environment (optional) macOS host with Node.js 22.22.3, JDK 21 and Maven; Lima Linux with Node.js 22.22.1, OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 and MySQL 8.4.11. Deployed acceptance used the existing `DeepSeek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` model configuration and one-time approvals for the disposable Shell calls. Exact check results and their revision boundaries are recorded in the separate E2E report comment. Complete-prompt acceptance completed thirteen Turns across six isolated Sessions with independent file/test checks: diagnosis without edits, a rounding fix, incremental requirements, recovery and fresh uninterrupted long chains. Eleven Turns ran before main integration. After merging main b4614845, a new chain persisted rounds 0–23, completed 23 tool calls in 42s and passed the exact CHAIN_OK 20/90 oracle; a fifth Turn in the existing incremental Session retained all earlier inputs, recalled its original token and reran nine tests without changing files. Shell commands were reviewed and approved once; model instruction deviations, an initial refused read and verifier-driven self-correction are recorded separately. Earlier review follow-up at `8d3b066afd9c57633ca93b0625fc0880aae8eae3` passed complete Maven verification: 4,359 tests reported, zero failures/errors and 16 skipped; Checkstyle and SpotBugs both reported zero violations. All 15 focused directory-selection MySQL tests passed. The same isolated Linux physical fixture verified the 100/101-directory boundary and eight stable unsafe-path refusal contracts before and after the Java-only repair. The earlier thirteen real-model Turns were not rerun for that metadata/test change. Directory-correction follow-up at `3af25ce450814c39f366585bc82a2761c82d1a03`, after merging main `7834280810`, passed root build/typecheck/bundle, 496 Web tests, 155 Core tests and 570 CLI tests. Complete Maven verify reported 4,376 tests, zero failures/errors and 16 skipped, with zero Checkstyle and SpotBugs findings. Build/typecheck were repeated after repairing a test-only wake-worker gate race exposed by a controlled 25ms scheduling probe. Independent real-component jsdom plus isolated Java HTTP verification passed four correction/persistence scenarios with three accepted Workspaces read back; this is a test-script fallback, not new browser-screenshot evidence. The repaired test also passed independent 0/25/100ms scheduling checks. MySQL/Hosted/fault profiles and the earlier thirteen real-model Turns were not rerun for this UI/contract-metadata follow-up; those earlier revision boundaries remain as stated above. Latest-main integration at `53913075cdf29195d9e9fe51240b9205e60ae356` preserves main `809792a198` and advances the directory contract to 1.56.0 after main took 1.54.0 for H3 task cancellation and 1.55.0 for child-task Session links. All 70 routes and 173 schemas match the semantic merge of both parents, and independently regenerated consumer types are byte-identical. Root build/typecheck/bundle, 483 Web tests, 11 Core launcher tests, 527 focused Java tests and 139 workflow/packaging checks passed; full Maven verify reported 4393 tests, zero failures/errors and 16 skipped, with zero Checkstyle and SpotBugs findings. The Core and workflow checks reuse the prior integration's results because their complete source inputs are unchanged. Incoming main logic is retained unchanged; the conflict resolution changes contract metadata, generated types and the two design-version references. Additional MySQL/Hosted/fault profiles and real-model Turns were not rerun for this integration, and earlier deployment evidence retains its original revision boundary. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: directory selection shares the authorized storage root's existing filesystem access and physical-owner lease; it is not subdirectory isolation. Creation receipts pin the source generation and recheck access before publication. Explicit abandonment removes only browser confirmation state; a previously committed Workspace can remain, and starting again uses a new key. The existing unlimited model-round default may run longer than the former cap; configured limits, cancellation and deadlines still apply. Java Managed admission always supplies a validated positive Turn deadline, defaulting to 30 minutes; a positive model-round setting and cancellation remain independent controls. - Not validated / out of scope: Windows, arbitrary host-path import, Mac directory selection, new transports, production rollout, real publication-storage acceptance and another full large-PR review. Live tests cover local Linux metadata and tools; output publication policy is unchanged. The original failed user Turn was not resubmitted or rewritten. The existing legacy Runtime-result recovery route does not emit fresh main-model request metadata; positive quota preservation and repeated crashes across that route were not validated. Continuous late-round persistence is independently demonstrated by the fresh long-chain Session. Tool progress still scans the retained committed event prefix per tool event, so very long sessions can incur quadratic aggregate lookup cost; a bounded history lookup is deferred to a separate performance change. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no additional database migration or new setting beyond current main, including its SSH V7 baseline. The WebShell contract is additive and advances to 1.56.0 above main's 1.55.0 with regenerated consumer types; legacy creation remains compatible. Configured round exhaustion gains the safe `hosted_turn_limit_exceeded` error code. See the synchronized [directory design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53913075cdf29195d9e9fe51240b9205e60ae356/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-workspace-directory-selection.md), [目录设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53913075cdf29195d9e9fe51240b9205e60ae356/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-workspace-directory-selection.zh-CN.md), [progress design (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53913075cdf29195d9e9fe51240b9205e60ae356/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-webshell-progress.md) and [进度设计（中文）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53913075cdf29195d9e9fe51240b9205e60ae356/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-webshell-progress.zh-CN.md). ## Linked Issues N/A — reproduced from local debugging reports; no issue is auto-closed.
中文说明 ## 此 PR 做了什么 Managed 的 New workspace 支持选择 Linux 执行机器上的已有项目目录。选择器浏览当前 actor 拥有的授权根目录，基于已验证存储创建逻辑 Workspace，并在创建重试、重新选择和刷新后保留工作目录。仍可创建空 Workspace。目录被拒绝后，用户可显式放弃保存的本地确认，重新选择目录或创建空 Workspace，刷新后同样可用。结果不确定的请求仍可使用原 key 重试；放弃不会删除可能已创建的 Workspace。本地目录流程与当前 main 的 SSH 注册流程保留独立的请求类型、浏览器草稿和对话框；SSH/CSI 远端存储不会成为本地目录浏览的根目录。 Hosted 工具调用使用原始模型调用身份公开安全的生命周期元数据，使静默命令显示运行中的工具和耗时，终态在 transcript 刷新后保留，并通过工具步骤分隔连续的助手说明。模型循环遵循已有的 `model.maxSessionTurns` 设置，替代单独写死的 16 轮限制。Java 持久化和保存的模型请求、审批续接校验接受相同的后续轮数，使有效请求可以在推理前保存，并在恢复时重新读取。Managed 聊天复用 daemon WebShell 展示和紧凑状态行，并修正回放后的总耗时。 ## 为什么需要 此前本地 Managed 调试必须从空目录开始。一次用户报告的 Turn 实际执行了 18 个工具，其中静默下载在 300 秒后超时，但没有发布工具进度；最终因私有的 16 轮上限失败，页面仅显示通用错误。用户无法区分命令仍在执行还是 agent 卡住。目录选择和可见的工具状态使已有项目可以直接使用，也让长时间运行的任务更容易诊断。此前目录被拒绝后，创建状态在刷新后仍被冻结，无法更正；显式放弃本地确认可以恢复编辑，同时不把所有拒绝都视为服务端不存在操作的证明。长任务还可能在完成 16 次读取后，因为持久化拒绝下一次模型请求而停止，页面仍显示运行中，但没有在途模型请求。 ## 审阅者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 在已配置的 Linux 部署中打开 Managed → New workspace → Choose existing directory，在自己拥有的 ACTIVE ROOT Workspace 下选择项目并创建命名 Workspace。保存的相对目录应在刷新和重新选择后保留；真实文件读取应在该项目中执行，同时保留已选模型和草稿。 2. 对不确定的创建结果，使用相同 key 和选择重试，应只返回一个 Workspace；修改请求应冲突。让不存在的目录被拒绝，重新打开或刷新草稿，再显式放弃本地确认：改选有效目录或创建空 Workspace 必须使用新 key。成功响应丢失后，用原 key 重试仍应返回同一 Workspace；浏览器存储删除失败时必须保留冻结请求。其他 actor 或 tenant、权限不足、源 generation 改变、路径穿越、符号链接和保留目录必须被拒绝，且不泄露目录内容。选择已有目录仍保留源存储的共享访问与租约范围。确认远端 Workspace 不出现在本地目录候选中，且 SSH 注册仍会选择返回的工作目录。恰好 100 个可选子目录加上被过滤的条目时，不应报告截断；存在 101 个可选目录或超过 1024 个原始条目的扫描预算时，应报告截断。 3. 在一次性 Session 中执行短暂的静默 Shell，然后读取测试文件。确认输出之前已有运行中的工具，耗时持续增长，成功或失败可见，助手说明被工具步骤分隔。完成后刷新：工具身份、终态、最终回答和总耗时应保持稳定。续聊一个重启前的一次性 Session，确认存活 worker 可以继续执行。 4. 在全新的一次性 Session 中运行依赖读取 20 个文件的 prompt，并使用真实验证器检查生成的证明文件。应能持久化第 15 轮之后的模型请求、完成后续 Shell 审批、处理验证失败，并在没有重启或额外用户消息的情况下结束。刷新后应保留结果和工具步骤。受控模型循环与替换所有者测试还覆盖正数配置上限、保存的模型请求和审批轮数计数，以及 Hook 停止优先级。原始参数和结果仍必须遵循已有发布策略。 ### 证据（修改前后） | 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 | | --- | --- | --- | | 已有项目 | New workspace 只接受名称，并创建空目录。 | 选中的 Linux 项目成为持久化默认目录，真实模型读取其中已有的 marker 文件。 | | 更正目录 | 路径被拒绝后，名称输入框被禁用、选择器被隐藏，重新打开或刷新后仍然如此。 | 真实组件 jsdom 与隔离 Java HTTP 测试验证显式放弃、改选有效目录、创建空工作区、重挂载后状态保留、响应丢失后的同 key 重放，以及存储失败时保留冻结状态。这是测试脚本回退验证，不是新的浏览器截图证据。 | | 目录页上限 | 恰好 100 个合格目录后面还有普通文件或保留目录时，错误报告截断。 | 同一 Linux 测试目录返回全部 100 个目录且不报告截断；101 个合格目录仍报告截断。 | | 工具进度 | 18 次已结算执行没有任何公开工具生命周期事件，312 秒无事件区间看起来像卡死。 | 一次性真实模型测试为三个独立工具 Item 生成七次生命周期更新，涵盖失败、静默执行和文件读取。 | | Transcript 与外观 | 助手说明连续拼接，底部使用独立的大状态框；更长的 Turn 在快照回放后可能只显示 3 秒。 | 共享 daemon 的消息和工具展示，使用紧凑状态，说明顺序正确，刷新后总耗时为 4m36s。 | | 长任务续接 | 完成 16 次读取后下一次请求被拒绝，页面仍显示运行中，但没有模型活动。 | 全新真实模型 Turn 持久化第 0–24 轮，完成 24 次工具调用和后续审批，刷新后保留 Completed 和 51s 总耗时。最初阻塞的测试 Turn 也已恢复并完成。 | ![选中的 Linux 项目目录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/directory-selected.png) ![静默工具运行与紧凑状态](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/progress-running.png) ![刷新后已完成的 transcript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/progress-completed.png) 以下截图来自不同 Session：首次阻塞的任务，以及修复后的全新任务。 ![持久化修复前的完整 prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/complete-prompt-blocked.png) ![修复并刷新后的全新完整 prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/3c9f7fed1268ddf76f59e1f248be5ef461592e08/docs/assets/managed-agent-local-debugging/complete-prompt-completed.png) ### 已测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | Node.js 22.22.1、OpenJDK 21.0.12.1 和 MySQL 8.4.11。部署验收沿用已有的 `DeepSeek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` 模型配置，并只对一次性 Shell 调用作单次审批。具体检查结果及其版本边界记录在单独的 E2E 报告评论中。 完整 prompt 验收使用六个隔离 Session，共完成 13 个 Turn，并独立核对文件和测试，覆盖只诊断不改动、金额舍入修复、多轮需求、恢复及全新不间断长链。其中 11 个 Turn 在合入 main 之前执行。合入 main b4614845 后，全新长链持久化第 0–23 轮，在 42s 内完成 23 次工具调用，并通过精确的 CHAIN_OK 20/90 oracle；已有多轮 Session 的第五个 Turn 后，通过整仓 build/typecheck/bundle、496 项 Web、155 项 Core 及 570 项 CLI 测试。完整 Maven verify 报告 4,376 项测试，零失败、零错误，16 项跳过，Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 均为零。受控 25ms 调度探针暴露并修复了仅存在于测试中的 wake worker 闸门竞争，之后重新完成 Turn；这些早期证据仍对应上文明确列出的版本。 最新 main 集成提交 `53913075cdf29195d9e9fe51240b9205e60ae356` 保留 main `809792a198`；main 为 H3 任务取消占用 1.54.0、为 child 任务的 Session 链接占用 1.55.0 后，将目录契约提升至 1.56.0。全部 70 个接口和 173 个 schema prs.title: fix(web-shell): improve favicon contrast on dark browser tabs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Web Shell favicon keeps the original brand blue in light mode and uses a lighter blue of the same hue when the browser prefers a dark color scheme.

## Why it's needed

The original blue is difficult to distinguish against dark browser tab bars. A dark-mode variant improves visibility while preserving the existing light-mode appearance and logo shape.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell with the built-in logo in a light browser theme. The tab icon should retain the original brand blue.
2. Open it in a dark browser theme. The icon should appear as a brighter blue and be easier to distinguish from the tab background.
3. Return to light mode and confirm the original blue returns; reload if the browser caches its tab icon.

### Evidence (Before & After)

![Favicon before and after on light and dark tab-bar backgrounds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/a3c03edfeb224635569e88d51b72ed7445c21b8f/web-shell-favicon/favicon-theme-comparison.png)

Source SVGs rendered on fixed, opaque tab-bar backgrounds. Top: light; bottom: dark. Left: before; right: after.

| Browser color scheme | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Light | Original blue `#082DFF` | Unchanged `#082DFF` |
| Dark | Low-contrast `#082DFF` | Lighter blue `#8B9BFF` |

The exact source SVG was verified in Chromium through light → dark → light transitions without reloading. Native Chrome also displayed the lighter favicon in its dark tab bar. All 42 existing document and branding unit tests passed, as did formatting and whitespace checks.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Static SVG, Chrome, focused tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.22.2, Playwright Chromium, and native Chrome. Browser verification used the exact source favicon in a static fixture; the local bundled CLI could not be built.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: limited to the built-in favicon's dark-mode color; browser-specific favicon caching may delay a theme change.
- Not validated / out of scope: full local daemon E2E, other browser engines, and Windows/Linux. Full build, bundle, and typechecking were attempted but blocked by missing dependencies and stale workspace outputs, including email dependencies, `@pierre/diffs`, and `@a2a-js/sdk`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None; reported directly during local use.

## 为什么需要

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): record Turn input and cancel as durable command operations (D7-1)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Turn input and Turn cancellation become durable command operations, the `submit_input` and `cancel` kinds that the contract's command operation already names. Every submit or cancel admission now saves its operation, carrying the command's idempotency key and request digest, in the same transaction that admits the Turn or the cancellation. The command receipt names that operation, so a retry under the key resolves to the original operation and never creates a second one, and a different payload under the key still conflicts. Both kinds are readable through the existing operation query on the public and WebShell surfaces.

No new delivery path is added. The Turn's own dispatcher already delivers both commands under the Turn's dispatch lease. Each operation is settled from the Turn's own committed facts, inside the transaction that commits them. An input completes `harness_confirmed` once a Harness admitted its Turn. It ends cancelled or failed (`java_durable`, `blocked`, with the Turn's error code) when the Turn ended before that. A cancel completes when its Turn is cancelled: `harness_confirmed` after a Harness admitted the Turn, `java_durable` when Java cancelled it first. It fails with `turn_already_settled` when the Turn ended another way. Cancels of one Turn coalesce, and each keeps its own receipt. The new kinds target the Turn rather than the Session, so they are never Session barriers; an active Turn still blocks close, delete and cwd changes exactly as before. Admission responses deliberately do not return the operation yet — that is the opt-in profile of D7-3.

Schema V8 widens the `ck_ma_operation_kind` CHECK. It starts from the constraint as #14318's V7 left it, so `WORKSPACE_CREATE` stays allowed, and adds the two new kinds; the schema initializer replaces the re-added CHECK through the generalized `extend` that #14318 landed. The contract moves to 1.55.0, after #14318's 1.52.0, #14358's 1.53.0 and #14412's 1.54.0. It describes the operation route's full kind set, the new failure codes, and what input and cancel completion mean in both operation schemas. `contract-known-gaps.txt` still has no entries, and its header now points at the open D7 umbrella #14122 instead of #12867, which is already done.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/d7-1-durable-input-cancel/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-turn-command-operations.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/d7-1-durable-input-cancel/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-turn-command-operations.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Why it's needed

#12380 allows Stage D to expose `java_durable` only with durable command delivery and original-command reconciliation; this is the first half (D7-1 of #14122). Before this change a submit or cancel answered `202` with a Turn id, but no operation recorded the command, so a lost reply had no original operation to resolve through — #12867's D7 exit check. The issue's warning against forking `TASK_CANCEL` and the triage's "don't add a fourth delivery path" are both met: general cancel takes the task cancel's outcome contract (settle from the authority's committed evidence, completed means confirmed with a receipt, failed stays `java_durable`/`blocked` with a reason) but not its coordinator, because a Turn already has a deliverer and its own evidence, and a second driver would race the Turn's dispatch lease.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Submit input to a Session, then cancel the Turn, through either surface. Read the `submit_input` and `cancel` operations (ids are in `ma_operation`, since admission responses do not expose them yet) through `GET …/operations/{id}` and the WebShell operation query. Expect both completed `harness_confirmed` once the Harness cancels the Turn.
- Retry the submit or the cancel with the same key: no new operation row appears and the store's replay names the original one. Reuse the key with different content: `409 idempotency_conflict`.
- Cancel a Turn that has already completed: its operation fails `turn_already_settled` at admission.
- With a Turn's input or cancel pending, close still answers `409 turn_active` (not `session_operation_active`), and close proceeds normally once the Turn has ended.
- Upgrade a V7 catalog that already holds a `WORKSPACE_CREATE` operation: it migrates to V8, the row reads back unchanged, all of `WORKSPACE_CREATE`, `SUBMIT_INPUT` and `CANCEL` insert, and the CHECK rejects unknown kinds.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the contract named `submit_input`/`cancel`, but the store had no such kinds; input and cancel left only a Turn row and a receipt, and the operation route could not read either command.

After, all local (JDK 21, Linux x86_64). The unit suite ran at `cd2513059e`, with main merged at `0f1c32320f`. The database checks ran at `ad49a902c8`; the later merges of main (#14358, #14412) changed only contract text and the generated types on this PR's side.

- Unit suite (`mvn -o clean verify checkstyle:check`): 4385 tests, 0 failures, 17 skipped. All three Checkstyle executions report 0 violations, and SpotBugs reports 0 bugs. `ManagedTurnCommandOperationTest` has 10 cases. `ManagedSchemaTest` inserts every shipped operation kind after the full migration chain, through both the Broker initializer and Flyway. The contract test reads both kinds through both routes and validates them against the OpenAPI schema.
- MariaDB 10.11.18 (CI's engine, fresh catalog, CI's 64 MB `max_allowed_packet`): `ManagedTurnCommandOperationMySqlIT` 13/13, `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` 3/3, `ManagedSchemaMySqlIT` 2/2, `ManagedAgentMySqlIT` 24/24. MySQL 8.4.6: `ManagedTurnCommandOperationMySqlIT` 13/13 and `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` 3/3.
- Cross-Session deadlock witness: without the index pin, `settlesInTwoSessionsDoNotLockEachOthersPendingCancels` fails with `Deadlock found when trying to get lock` on both engines. With the pin it passed 3 of 3 repeated runs on each, together with the two snapshot witnesses.
- Isolation pin: with MySQL's global default set to `READ-COMMITTED`, the IT passes 13/13. Removing the pin makes both snapshot witnesses fail at their premise assertions.
- Mutation checks at this revision:
  - Narrowing the cancel arm to completed Turns, or dropping the `failTurn` settle, fails the new H2 case. The second mutation also fails `failsTheInputWithItsTurnsCodeWhenTheTurnFailsBeforeAdmission`.
  - Dropping the `WORKSPACE_CREATE` arm from V8 fails `ManagedSchemaTest` with a check-constraint violation, and the V7 → V8 Flyway upgrade of a catalog holding that kind fails on MariaDB.
- Mutation checks at the first revision, not re-run after the merge: removing any single settle hook, the receipt link or the read fallback turned at least one test red; making the pending-operation lookup or the Turn read a plain read failed its snapshot witness.
- `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT` (the #13333 same-tenant burst, full Spring stack) on MySQL 8.4.6: every round settles with 0 admission or renewal failures and 0 lock-acquire failures, and lock-wait samples stay at most 6 per burst. At the first revision they matched the base build's.
- At the first revision, real jars on MariaDB upgraded a V6 catalog. At this revision the upgrade is covered by the Flyway ITs above (V7 → V8 with an existing `WORKSPACE_CREATE` row); the jar check was not re-run.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Maven with JDK 21; disposable MySQL 8.4.6 and MariaDB 10.11.18 containers, both with CI's `max_allowed_packet=64M`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every Turn's admission and terminal transactions now also write its command operations. Two reads protect correctness under REPEATABLE READ: a locking read of the Turn, and a locking read of the Turn's own prefix of the operation identity index. Without them, a snapshot taken before the Session lock could miss a cancel committed in between. The second read is pinned to `uq_ma_operation_identity` (`/*! FORCE INDEX */`, which H2 skips). Left to the optimizer, a long settled history steers it to `ix_ma_operation_claim`, whose `(operation_kind, state)` range spans every Session's pending rows, and two Sessions' settles deadlock; a MySQL IT reproduces that on both engines without the pin. No caller inserts into `ma_operation` after those reads, so they cannot form the insert-gap cycle that #13918 removed, and the burst IT shows no lock regression. Input completion follows the Turn's Harness event epoch, the same admission fact the dispatcher already relies on.
- Not validated / out of scope: the packaged-Harness chain (real `qwen serve` plus model). The Hosted ITs drive the Harness client directly rather than the Java Turn routes, so they would not exercise this change; the contract and integration tests use the real coordinator and store with a fixture Harness connector. Out of scope: returning the operation from the admission routes and `durable_operations` (D7-3), cross-kind `recovery_blocked` reconciliation (D7-2), and Turns that no input command creates (initial input, channels, automations).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: schema V8 is a CHECK widening only; it applies through Flyway on the server and through `ManagedSchema.initialize` on the Broker. Turns admitted before the upgrade have no operation; their replays answer as before, without an operation id. Wire responses are unchanged except for contract descriptions. The `StoreModels.Admission.operationId` field has no production reader until D7-3 returns it.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14168. Part of #14122 (D7 umbrella) and #12380 (Stage D). Unblocks #14166 (D7-2).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Turn 输入与 Turn 取消成为持久命令 operation，即契约命令 operation 早已列出的 `submit_input` 与 `cancel` 两个种类。每次提交或取消的准入，都会在准入该 Turn 或该取消的同一事务里保存其 operation，并带上命令的幂等键与请求摘要。命令回执指名这个 operation，因此同键重试会找回原 operation、绝不新建第二个，同键不同载荷仍然冲突。两个种类都可经公开与 WebShell 两个表面上现有的 operation 查询读取。

没有新增投递路径。Turn 自己的派发器本就在 Turn 的派发租约下投递这两种命令。每个 operation 都依据 Turn 自身已提交的事实，在提交这些事实的事务里结算。输入在某个 Harness 准入其 Turn 后以 `harness_confirmed` 完成；若 Turn 在此之前就已结束，则为 cancelled 或 failed（`java_durable`、`blocked`，并带 Turn 的错误码）。取消在其 Turn 被取消时完成：Harness 准入过该 Turn 则为 `harness_confirmed`，由 Java 先行取消则为 `java_durable`；Turn 以其他方式结束时以 `turn_already_settled` 失败。同一 Turn 的多次取消会合并，各自保留自己的回执。新种类以 Turn 而非 Session 为目标，因此从不构成 Session 屏障；活跃 Turn 仍像以前一样阻止 close、delete 与 cwd 变更。准入响应刻意暂不返回该 operation——那是 D7-3 的可选 profile。

Schema V8 放宽 `ck_ma_operation_kind` CHECK。它以 #14318 的 V7 留下的约束为起点，因此 `WORKSPACE_CREATE` 仍被允许，再加入两个新种类；schema 初始化器通过 #14318 合入的一般化 `extend` 替换重建的 CHECK。契约升至 1.55.0，排在 #14318 的 1.52.0、#14358 的 1.53.0 与 #14412 的 1.54.0 之后。它写明 operation 路由的完整种类集合、新的失败码，以及两个 operation schema 中输入与取消"完成"的含义。`contract-known-gaps.txt` 仍无条目，其文件头改为指向仍开放的 D7 伞形 issue #14122，而非已关闭的 #12867。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/d7-1-durable-input-cancel/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-turn-command-operations.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/d7-1-durable-input-cancel/docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-turn-command-operations.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整且同步。

## 为什么需要

#12380 只允许 Stage D 在具备持久命令投递与原命令对账时暴露 `java_durable`；本 PR 是前一半（#14122 的 D7-1）。此前提交或取消以 Turn id 回 `202`，却没有 operation 记录命令，丢失的应答没有原 operation 可找回——这正是 #12867 的 D7 退出检查。issue 中"不要分叉 `TASK_CANCEL`"的警告与 triage 中"不要新增第四条投递路径"的意见都得到满足：通用取消沿用任务取消的结果契约（依据权威方已提交的证据结算；完成即 confirmed 并带回执；失败保持 `java_durable`/`blocked` 并写明原因），但不沿用其 coordinator，因为 Turn 已有投递者与自己的证据，第二个驱动者会与 Turn 的派发租约竞争。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 经任一表面向某个 Session 提交输入，再取消该 Turn。经 `GET …/operations/{id}` 与 WebShell operation 查询读取 `submit_input` 与 `cancel` operation（由于准入响应暂不暴露，id 取自 `ma_operation`）。预期 Harness 取消该 Turn 后两者都以 `harness_confirmed` 完成。
- 以同一键重试提交或取消：不出现新的 operation 行，存储的重放指名原 operation。以不同内容复用该键：`409 idempotency_conflict`。
- 取消一个已完成的 Turn：其 operation 在准入时即以 `turn_already_settled` 失败。
- 某 Turn 的输入或取消待处理时，close 仍回 `409 turn_active`（而非 `session_operation_active`）；Turn 结束后 close 正常进行。
- 升级一个已存有 `WORKSPACE_CREATE` operation 的 V7 目录：它迁移到 V8，该行读回不变，`WORKSPACE_CREATE`、`SUBMIT_INPUT`、`CANCEL` 都能插入，CHECK 拒绝未知种类。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：契约列出了 `submit_input`/`cancel`，但存储没有这些种类；输入与取消只留下 Turn 行与回执，operation 路由读不到任何一条命令。

之后，均为本地（JDK 21，Linux x86_64）。单元测试基于 `cd2513059e`（已合入 main 的 `0f1c32320f`）；数据库检查基于 `ad49a902c8`，其后对 main 的合并（#14358、#14412）在本 PR 一侧只改了契约文本与生成的类型。

- 单元测试（`mvn -o clean verify checkstyle:check`）：4385 个测试，0 失败，17 跳过。三次 Checkstyle 执行均为 0 违规，SpotBugs 为 0 个缺陷。`ManagedTurnCommandOperationTest` 有 10 个用例。`ManagedSchemaTest` 在完整迁移链之后，经 Broker 初始化器与 Flyway 两条路径插入每个已发布的 operation 种类。契约测试经两个路由读取两种 operation，并按 OpenAPI schema 校验。
- MariaDB 10.11.18（CI 所用引擎，全新目录，按 CI 设置 64 MB `max_allowed_packet`）：`ManagedTurnCommandOperationMySqlIT` 13/13，`WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` 3/3，`ManagedSchemaMySqlIT` 2/2，`ManagedAgentMySqlIT` 24/24。MySQL 8.4.6：`ManagedTurnCommandOperationMySqlIT` 13/13 与 `WorkspaceCreationSchemaMySqlIT` 3/3。
- 跨 Session 死锁见证：去掉索引固定后，`settlesInTwoSessionsDoNotLockEachOthersPendingCancels` 在两种引擎上都以 `Deadlock found when trying to get lock` 失败。固定后它与两个快照见证一起，在每种引擎上重复 3 次均通过。
- 隔离级别固定：把 MySQL 全局默认设为 `READ-COMMITTED` 时，该 IT 通过 13/13；去掉固定后，两个快照见证都在前提断言处失败。
- 本版本的变异检查：
  - 把取消分支收窄为仅已完成的 Turn，或去掉 `failTurn` 的结算，都会让新的 H2 用例失败；后者还会让 `failsTheInputWithItsTurnsCodeWhenTheTurnFailsBeforeAdmission` 失败。
  - 从 V8 删掉 `WORKSPACE_CREATE` 一支，`ManagedSchemaTest` 以检查约束违例失败；在 MariaDB 上，对存有该种类的目录做 V7 → V8 的 Flyway 升级也会失败。
- 首个版本的变异检查（merge 后未重跑）：去掉任一结算挂钩、回执链接或读取回退，都会让至少一个测试变红；把待处理 operation 的查找或 Turn 的读取改为普通读，对应的快照见证失败。
- `HostedConcurrentTurnBurstMySqlIT`（#13333 的同租户突发，完整 Spring 栈）在 MySQL 8.4.6 上：每轮都完成结算，准入或续租失败为 0，加锁失败为 0，每次突发的锁等待采样不超过 6。首个版本时它与基线构建一致。
- 首个版本时，真实 jar 在 MariaDB 上升级过一个 V6 目录。本版本的升级由上述 Flyway IT 覆盖（带已有 `WORKSPACE_CREATE` 行的 V7 → V8），未重跑 jar 检查。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Maven 使用 JDK 21；一次性的 MySQL 8.4.6 与 MariaDB 10.11.18 容器，均按 CI 设置 `max_allowed_packet=64M`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：每个 Turn 的准入与终态事务现在还会写其命令 operation。两处读取在 REPEATABLE READ 下保证正确性：对 Turn 的加锁读，以及对该 Turn 在 operation 标识索引中自身前缀的加锁读。没有它们，Session 加锁之前建立的快照可能漏掉其间提交的取消。第二处读固定在 `uq_ma_operation_identity` 上（`/*! FORCE INDEX */`，H2 会跳过）。交给优化器时，很长的已结算历史会把它引向 `ix_ma_operation_claim`，其 `(operation_kind, state)` 范围横跨所有 Session 的待处理行，两个 Session 的结算会死锁；一个 MySQL IT 在去掉固定后于两种引擎上都复现了这一点。没有调用者会在这些读之后向 `ma_operation` 插入，所以它们无法形成 #13918 所消除的插入-间隙环；突发 IT 也未显示锁回退。输入完成取决于 Turn 的 Harness event epoch，即派发器本已依赖的准入事实。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：打包 Harness 的完整链路（真实 `qwen serve` 加模型）。Hosted IT 直接驱动 Harness 客户端，而不经过 Java 的 Turn 路由，因此不会覆盖本改动；契约测试与集成测试使用真实的 coordinator 与存储，配合夹具 Harness 连接器。不在范围内：准入路由返回 operation 以及 `durable_operations`（D7-3）、跨种类的 `recovery_blocked` 对账（D7-2），以及不由输入命令创建的 Turn（初始输入、channel、自动化）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：schema V8 只放宽一个 CHECK；服务端经 Flyway 应用，Broker 经 `ManagedSchema.initialize` 应用。升级前准入的 Turn 没有 operation，其重放照旧应答，只是不带 operation id。除契约描述外，线上响应不变。`StoreModels.Admission.operationId` 字段在 D7-3 返回它之前没有生产读取方。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14168。属于 #14122（D7 伞形）与 #12380（Stage D）。为 #14166（D7-2）解除阻塞。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: feat(managed-agent): record Turn input and cancel as durable command operations (D7-1) (#14404)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(managed-agent): record Turn input and cancel as durable command operations (D7-1)

Every Turn submit and cancel admission now saves a submit_input or cancel
operation in the transaction that admits it, carrying the command's
idempotency key and request digest. The command receipt names the
operation, so a retry under the key resolves to the original operation
and a different payload still conflicts. The operation query serves both
kinds on the public and WebShell surfaces.

The Turn dispatcher stays the only deliverer. Each operation settles from
the Turn's own committed facts in the transaction that commits them: input
completes harness_confirmed once a Harness admits its Turn, and a cancel
completes when its Turn is cancelled or fails turn_already_settled when the
Turn ended otherwise. The new kinds target the Turn, so they are never
Session barriers. Admission responses do not return the operation yet;
that is the D7-3 profile.

Schema V7 widens ck_ma_operation_kind, and the schema initializer now
replaces any CHECK that a migration drops and re-adds. Contract 1.53.0
(provisional: open PRs already claim 1.52.0) documents the operation
route's kinds and the new failure codes, and the
known-gaps header points at #14122.

Closes #14168

* fix(managed-agent): pin the Turn command settle scan and address D7-1 review

- Pin the settle's locking scan to uq_ma_operation_identity with a MySQL
  executable-comment FORCE INDEX (H2 skips it). Left to the optimizer, a
  Turn with a long settled history steers it to ix_ma_operation_claim,
  whose (kind, state) range holds every Session's pending rows, and two
  Sessions' settles deadlock. A new MySQL IT reproduces that on MariaDB
  10.11 and MySQL 8.4 without the pin.
- Pin the snapshot race witnesses to REPEATABLE READ so a server default
  cannot void their premise.
- Add an H2 case for a pending cancel whose Turn the dispatcher fails.
- Pin the operation-kind CHECK union: every shipped kind inserts after the
  full chain (Broker initializer and Flyway), and a V7 catalog holding a
  WORKSPACE_CREATE row upgrades to V8.
- State input and cancel completion consistently in both command operation
  schemas and regenerate the WebShell types.

## What this PR does

Localizes the remaining nine Companion command titles using VS Code's existing English and Simplified Chinese catalogs, and includes both catalogs in the extension package. All twelve resolved English command titles, command IDs, menus, keybindings and settings remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Nine command titles remain English under a Chinese VS Code display language. In addition, the packaging whitelist excludes both existing catalogs: the installed vsce 3.9.2 file list contains neither before this change. Adding translations alone would therefore leave the installed extension untranslated.

This is the manifest-command slice invited by the maintainer in #13967. It leaves notifications, configuration descriptions, additional locales, webview language precedence and shared CLI translation sources for follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With a Simplified Chinese VS Code display language, command titles such as Open, Focus Chat View and New Conversation should resolve to Chinese. With English, the titles should remain exactly as before. Command execution, keybindings and menu visibility should remain unchanged. Confirm that both translation catalogs are present in the packaged VSIX.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: nine titles are hardcoded English; neither NLS catalog appears in `vsce ls --no-dependencies`.
- After: all twelve titles resolve in English and Simplified Chinese; both catalogs are listed and included byte-for-byte in a real vsce-generated VSIX.
- Before/after Command Palette screenshots below use an isolated manifest fixture in real VS Code with no-op activation; they do not show full Companion runtime verification.

| Before (zh-CN) | After (zh-CN) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/verification/issue-13967/before-zh.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/verification/issue-13967/after-zh.png) |

- Actual VS Code 1.142.0 isolated extension-host tests confirm the before/after Chinese labels and unchanged English labels. These tests use copied real manifests/catalogs and a no-op activation stub: they exercise VS Code's own NLS loader, not full Companion activation or command execution.
- Four focused manifest tests pass; the new checks fail against the unmodified manifest. Root build, repository typecheck, bundle, companion build/typecheck/lint, formatting and whitespace checks pass. The complete repository test suite was not run.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ build, types, packaging and isolated VS Code NLS loader |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ not tested |
