macOS arm64, Node 26.8.2, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, vsce 3.9.2, VS Code 1.142.0. The verification VSIX contains the built extension and webview but is not a full release package with the separately prepared bundled CLI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: missing or mismatched NLS keys; manifest tests, actual VS Code loading and archive inspection cover this path.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete extension activation, command execution, full release installation and other operating systems.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; English fallback titles are preserved.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/blob/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/design/2026-10-17-companion-command-localization.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/blob/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/design/2026-10-17-companion-command-localization.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13967. This completes only the manifest command-title slice, not the entire localization request.

prs.title: fix(core): widen the agent workspace lock retry budget (#14028)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the cross-process workspace lock's acquisition retry budget from 10 retries (5–100ms randomized exponential backoff, ~0.65–1.3s worst case) to 30 retries (~5s worst case), matching the budget the Agent Board lock already uses for the same two-tier locking pattern. Everything else about the lock is unchanged: the in-process mutex still serializes same-process writers, and stale-lock breaking (`stale: 10_000`) still recovers a dead holder's lock after 10 seconds.

## Why it's needed

`main` CI failed on `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` (#14028). The test spawns two child processes that each perform 8 read-modify-write roster updates under the store's file lock. On an oversubscribed CI host, one holder's critical section — an fsync-bound atomic JSON write — can outlast the ~1s retry budget, so the competing process exhausted its retries, exited with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`, and failed the test. CI's `--retry=2` does not help because every attempt on a badly placed host hits the same contention. I reproduced this locally: pinned to 2 CPUs with CPU and fsync competitors, the pre-fix code failed 6 of 30 rounds with ELOCKED; with this change, 30 of 30 rounds passed. A longer wait is strictly safer here: the lock guards a low-frequency roster/registry store, so waiting a few seconds for a slow live holder is always preferable to erroring.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the change is confined to the workspace store's lock options and that the concurrency test passes: run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts` and expect 1 passed test. To observe the original failure mode, revert the one-line change (`retries: 30` back to `10`) and run the same test on a heavily loaded machine (or pinned to few CPUs with competing load): the worker processes intermittently exit 1 with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`. With the fix, the waiters simply wait out the slow holder instead of erroring.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible behavior change; the observable difference is CI stability under host contention: before, 6/30 contended probe rounds failed with ELOCKED; after, 0/30 failed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests under `packages/core` (vitest), plus a local contention harness pinning the test scenario to 2 CPUs with busy CPU/fsync competitors.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a waiter now holds on for up to ~5s (was ~1s) before failing lock acquisition when a live holder is slow; a dead holder's lock is still broken after 10s via the unchanged stale detection, so crash recovery latency is unaffected.
- Not validated / out-of-scope: macOS and Windows lanes (left to CI; the change is a platform-independent timing budget). A deeper hardening — aborting a transaction whose lock is compromised mid-flight instead of only warning — is deliberately out of scope for this flake fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14028

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将跨进程 workspace 锁的获取重试预算从 10 次(5–100ms 随机指数退避,最坏约 0.65–1.3 秒)提高到 30 次(最坏约 5 秒),与 Agent Board 锁在相同双层锁模式下已有的预算一致。锁的其他行为完全不变:进程内互斥锁仍然串行化同进程写入者,过期锁打破机制(`stale: 10_000`)仍然会在 10 秒后回收已崩溃持锁者留下的锁。

## 为什么需要

`main` 分支 CI 在 `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` 上失败(#14028)。该测试派生两个子进程,各自在存储的文件锁下执行 8 次 roster 读-改-写更新。在超额订阅的 CI 主机上,持锁者的一次临界区——带 fsync 的原子 JSON 写入——可能超过约 1 秒的重试预算,导致竞争进程重试耗尽后以 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held` 退出,测试失败。CI 的 `--retry=2` 帮不上忙,因为在被调度到繁忙主机时,每次尝试都会遇到同样的争用。我已在本地复现:固定到 2 个 CPU 并加入 CPU 与 fsync 竞争负载时,修复前的代码在 30 轮中有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;应用本改动后,30 轮全部通过。此处更长的等待严格更安全:该锁守护的是低频的 roster/注册表存储,为一个缓慢的活跃持锁者多等几秒永远优于直接报错。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认改动仅限于 workspace 存储的锁参数,且并发测试通过:运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts`,预期 1 个测试通过。若要观察原始失败模式,可将这一行改动回退(`retries: 30` 改回 `10`),并在负载较重的机器上(或绑定到少量 CPU 并施加竞争负载)运行同一测试:worker 进程会间歇性地以退出码 1 失败,报 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`。应用修复后,等待者会等待缓慢的持锁者完成,而不是报错。

### 前后对照证据

N/A(无用户可见的行为变化;可观察的差异是主机争用下的 CI 稳定性:修复前,30 轮带载探测有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;修复后,30 轮无一失败)。

### 已测试平台

|     系统    |  状态  |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

`packages/core` 下的单元测试(vitest),以及一个将测试场景固定到 2 个 CPU 并施加 CPU/fsync 竞争负载的本地争用 harness。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:当活跃持锁者较慢时,等待者现在最多坚持约 5 秒(原来约 1 秒)才会放弃锁获取;已崩溃持锁者的锁仍会通过未改动的过期检测在 10 秒后被打破,因此崩溃恢复延迟不受影响。
- 未验证 / 超出范围:macOS 与 Windows 通道(交由 CI 覆盖;本改动是平台无关的计时预算)。更深一层的加固——在锁中途被夺时中止事务而不是仅告警——刻意不纳入本次抖动修复的范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14028

prs.title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one read-only request for complete live-session snapshots from 1–20 explicitly selected registered workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own canonical identity, catalog version, and independent success or error result. The new request shares the existing single-workspace snapshot and catalog-cache reconciliation logic. A distinct capability and TypeScript SDK method let clients opt in with cancellation and timeout support.

## Why it's needed

Clients showing several workspaces currently make one live-state HTTP request per workspace on every refresh. The recently added batch session catalog can read persisted history, so it is not a suitable high-frequency execution-state endpoint. This API lets clients fetch the same authoritative in-memory state in one request, while preserving the existing single-workspace route and per-session SSE.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a local daemon with a primary workspace, register a trusted secondary workspace, then send one batch request containing both IDs and an unknown selector. Expect two full snapshots and one explicit `workspace_not_found` member in input order, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Confirm malformed bodies fail with HTTP 400, an untrusted or transitioning workspace fails only its own member, and the capability is advertised. Change a live session between running, waiting, and idle without advancing its catalog version; every batch snapshot should still reflect the current state. Confirm the SDK makes one authenticated native REST request and preserves abort and timeout behavior. Older daemons should continue to use the single-workspace route after callers preflight capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (HTTP and SDK change; no TUI change). The local daemon returned two workspace snapshots and one explicit unknown-workspace error in a single POST.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, and local HTTP E2E passed; the large server test file showed unrelated intermittent failures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64: frozen install/build/bundle, typecheck, focused tests, and daemon HTTP E2E passed |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1 on macOS arm64 and `dev` Linux x86_64, each with an isolated daemon on a dynamically assigned loopback port. The global `qwen` binary was unavailable for the pre-change CLI dry-run; the absence of this route was confirmed in the current base source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A batch is not atomic across workspaces. Each successful member is capped at 512 KiB and an oversized member gets an explicit error.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell still polls workspaces separately until a client migration adopts the new capability; no model-driven live session was created in the HTTP E2E. Windows was not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Clients preflight `workspace_session_live_state_batch` and retain the existing single-workspace path for older daemons.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #12511

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 为什么需要

同时展示多个 workspace 的客户端目前每次刷新都要逐 workspace 发起运行状态 HTTP 请求。近期增加的批量会话目录可能读取持久历史，不适合高频查询执行状态。新接口让客户端通过一次请求获取同样的权威内存状态，保留原单 workspace 路由和逐会话 SSE。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

### 前后证据

不适用（HTTP 与 SDK 改动，无 TUI 变化）。本地 daemon 实测一次 POST 返回两个 workspace 快照及一个未知 workspace 的明确错误。

| 🪟 Windows | 本地未测试 |

- 主要风险或取舍：批量结果不保证跨 workspace 原子性；每个成功成员上限为 512 KiB，超限会返回明确错误。
- 未验证或范围外：Web Shell 在后续客户端迁移前仍逐 workspace 轮询；HTTP E2E 未创建由模型驱动的运行会话；未在本地运行 Windows 测试。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。客户端预检 `workspace_session_live_state_batch`，旧 daemon 保留现有单 workspace 路径。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: fix(cli): Make interactive questions answerable from standard ACP hosts
prs.body:
## What this PR does The interactive question tool (`ask_user_question`) is projected onto the Agent Client Protocol as a permission request, but the real per-question choices only ever travelled in a Qwen-specific metadata field that the protocol tells conforming clients to ignore. A standard ACP host therefore rendered a raw JSON payload, and the user could not actually answer: the single visible button submitted an empty answer. This PR makes the question answerable everywhere by projecting the question text and every choice into the standard tool-call content, and — for clients that do not opt in to the Qwen question payload — by offering real per-choice options in the permission request, exactly like an ordinary approval prompt, with the answer recovered from the option the user picks. Clients that do understand the Qwen payload keep their existing rich flow unchanged. ## Why it's needed Today the question tool is unusable through any ACP host that does not implement Qwen's private contract: the user sees "Raw Input", and even pressing the one available button returns nothing, because the answer was read from a response field the protocol does not define. This is the bug reported in the linked issue. The fix also has to avoid regressing the Qwen-owned surfaces — the VS Code companion, the web shell, channel cards, the daemon bridge, and the voice client — all of which consume the rich payload today. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify A reviewer can confirm the behavior with the focused test suites; no IDE is required: ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` Expected outcomes to check in the tests: - With the capability absent, a single question produces one option per choice, followed by `Other…` and `Cancel`; picking one returns the matching label. - With the capability advertised (as the in-repo Qwen clients do), the generic `Submit`/`Cancel` pair is preserved. - A multi-question request is not flattened — the questions and choices still appear as readable content. - The question text and every choice are present in the standard tool-call content regardless of capability. ### Evidence (Before & After) Zed end-to-end, same prompt (one question, two options: `Day.js` / `date-fns`). **Before** — the question arrives as a raw JSON payload and the only actions are `Submit` and `Cancel`; submitting returns nothing, so the tool reports "No valid answers were provided.". **After** — the question is readable and every choice is a real selectable option, alongside `Other…` and `Cancel`. **After, round-trip** — picking `Day.js` is delivered to the model as the answer, and the agent continues with it. Focused suites and checks: ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment (optional) Unit tests and type checks, plus a Zed end-to-end run against a local build of this branch (Zed custom agent launching `--acp`). No sandbox was used. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the new flat option list only applies when a client does not advertise the Qwen question capability, so the blast radius is limited to non-Qwen ACP hosts. The content projection is additive and ignored by clients that render their own question card. - Not validated / out of scope: a multi-question request (2–4 questions) is intentionally not flattened, because the protocol has no multi-form primitive and interleaving choices from different questions would be ambiguous; those questions are shown as text and remain fully answerable only from the Qwen-compatible surfaces. `multiSelect` questions degrade to a single choice. Sequential per-question permission requests are not implemented. The Zed run above covers a single, single-select question; the multi-question and `multiSelect` cases were not exercised in Zed. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the Qwen-owned clients, which keep the same option set. One behaviour change for third-party ACP hosts and external harnesses that auto-approve by selecting the first `allow_once` option: on a flattened question that is now the first choice, where it previously hit `proceed_once` and produced a visible "No valid answers were provided." — worth a release note. ## Linked Issues Fixes #11361 Design document (both language versions): - [English](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.md) - [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.zh-CN.md)
中文说明 ## What this PR does（本 PR 做了什么） 交互式提问工具（`ask_user_question`）目前被投影为 Agent Client Protocol 的一次权限请求，但真正的逐题选项只通过 Qwen 专有的元数据字段传递，而协议要求符合规范的客户端忽略该字段。因此标准 ACP 宿主只能渲染原始 JSON，用户实际上无法作答：唯一可见的按钮提交的是空答案。本 PR 让问题在所有宿主上都能作答：始终把问题文本与每个选项投影进标准工具调用内容；对于未声明支持 Qwen 问题载荷的客户端，直接在权限请求中给出真实的逐选项选项（与普通审批提示完全一致），并从用户所选的选项恢复答案。理解 Qwen 载荷的客户端保持原有丰富流程不变。 ## Why it's needed（为什么需要） 目前，任何未实现 Qwen 私有契约的 ACP 宿主都无法使用该提问工具：用户看到的是 "Raw Input"，而且即使按下唯一可用的按钮也不会返回任何内容，因为答案是从协议未定义的响应字段读取的。这正是所链接 issue 报告的问题。该修复还必须避免回退 Qwen 自有界面——VS Code 伴侣、Web Shell、渠道卡片、daemon bridge 以及语音客户端——它们目前消费的是丰富载荷。 ## Reviewer Test Plan（评审测试计划） ### How to verify（如何验证） 评审者可用聚焦测试套件确认行为，无需 IDE： ```bash cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/permissionUtils.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/SubAgentTracker.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.review-lease.test.ts src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false cd packages/qwen-live && npx vitest run src/adaptor/acp-adaptor.test.ts src/adaptor/acp-permission-mode.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false ``` 测试中应确认的结果： - 未声明能力时，单个问题为每个选项给出一个选项，其后是 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`；选择其一即返回对应标签。 - 声明能力时（仓库内 Qwen 客户端即如此），保留通用的 `Submit`/`Cancel` 按钮对。 - 多问题请求不会被扁平化——问题与选项仍以可读内容呈现。 - 无论能力如何，问题文本与每个选项都出现在标准工具调用内容中。 ### Evidence (Before & After)（证据） Zed 端到端，同一提示词（一个问题，两个选项：`Day.js` / `date-fns`）。 **Before**——问题以原始 JSON 形式到达，仅有的操作是 `Submit` 与 `Cancel`；提交后不会返回任何内容，因此工具报告 "No valid answers were provided."。 **After**——问题可读，每个选项都是真正可选的选项，另有 `Other…` 与 `Cancel`。 **After，往返**——选择 `Day.js` 会作为答案传回模型，agent 随之继续。 聚焦测试套件与检查： ``` packages/cli : 6 files, 2122 passed packages/qwen-live: 2 files, 26 passed typecheck (core, cli, acp-bridge, channels/base, vscode-ide-companion, qwen-live): exit 0 build (packages/cli, tsc --build): exit 0 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: lockfile unchanged eslint + prettier on all changed files: clean ``` ### Tested on（测试平台） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ | | 🪟 Windows | N/A | | 🐧 Linux | N/A | ### Environment（环境） 单元测试与类型检查，外加使用本分支本地构建的 Zed 端到端运行（Zed 自定义 agent 启动 `--acp`）。未使用 sandbox。 ## Risk & Scope（风险与范围） - 主要风险或取舍：新的扁平选项列表仅在客户端未声明 Qwen 问题能力时生效，影响范围限于非 Qwen 的 ACP 宿主。内容投影为增量改动，会渲染自有问题卡片的客户端会忽略它。 - 未验证 / 范围之外：多问题请求（2–4 个问题）有意不扁平化，因为协议没有多表单原语，把不同问题的选项交错会产生歧义；这些问题以文本呈现，且仅在 Qwen 兼容界面中可完整作答。`multiSelect` 问题降级为单选。未实现逐题顺序权限请求。上文的 Zed 运行仅覆盖单个单选问题；多问题与 `multiSelect` 情形未在 Zed 中验证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对 Qwen 自有客户端无破坏性，选项集合保持不变。对通过「选择第一个 `allow_once` 选项」自动批准的第三方 ACP 宿主与外部测试框架：扁平化问题现在会把该第一个选项记录为答案，而此前会命中 `proceed_once` 并产生可见的 "No valid answers were provided."——建议在 release notes 中说明。 ## Linked Issues（关联 Issue） Fixes #11361 设计文档（中英双版本）： - [英文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.md) - [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-10-acp-structured-question-projection.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: test(managed-agent): ground the FG8a/FG8b/FG8d gate choreography in Linux truth
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #14334, which merged before its last review round and a Linux run were handled. That PR's FG8a/FG8b/FG8d letters had only been exercised cgroup-free on macOS. On a real Linux + cgroup v2 host with MySQL 8.4 the merged head fails in three letters, and one letter that #14120 landed earlier fails intermittently. This PR fixes the gate choreography and assertions so each case drives and checks what production actually does. It is test-only: the fault driver, the IT class, and the FG8a/FG8b/FG8d design doc in both languages. No production code changes.

- **dispatch-reply (FG8a).** The Broker answers `:start` as soon as the dispatch committed, which can be before the worker has started the producer. The driver looked for the producer's start marker once, found nothing, and never opened the gate, so the run could never settle (180 s timeout on the rig). It now waits until the run has either started or settled as never-started.
- **Commit log scope (FG8a).** The store proxy's commit log was the one arm not reset between cases, so the page commit dropped by capture-commit-reply surfaced in observation-advance-reply's dropped operations. It is now reset per case like every other arm.
- **page-envelope-commit (FG8b).** A refused page envelope does not "poison only the capture". The 24-block capture fills no page before the stream seals. Its single page rides the next output-advance commit, and every later manifest still names it. So the run is blocked exactly like manifest-commit and never exits naturally. The two publication cases now share the blocked expectations: the record stays `running`, with no stop proof, `stopRequested: false`, and no re-execution. The witness for the page case is a refused advance that carried the page. The zero-page assertion applies to the page case only, because in the manifest case the page lands with the seal-time advance.
- **cancel-reply-lost (FG8d).** Every shell revision is committed under the same operation name. Dropping "the next `commitChildRunRecord`" therefore hit an output advance, and "exactly one" counted admit, dispatch, attach and output commits too. The arm now drops only the revision that first sets `stopRequested`, read from the record body the commit carries. The IT asserts that exactly one distinct command ever set the stop mark.
- **cancel-status-unavailable (FG8d).** The driver's captive status read went to a route the Broker does not serve, and a 404 counted as recovery. It now issues the Harness's own process status read through the paused proxy. The proxy must report that read as parked, and after the restore the read must answer 200 for the same execution.
- **Release timing (FG8d).** Driver releases, routine or drain, now wait until the dispatching turn has handed the Runtime Session back: every invocation row terminal, and the Harness's own turn-end routine release answered. Before that point the Broker answers `runtime_session_busy` for the foreground work. A driver release that arrives while the Harness's routine release is in flight joins that attempt and receives its answer, `runtime_session_held`, even when the driver asked for a drain.
- **receipt-drop-after-watermark (FG8f).** The "drop the next commit of any kind" arm was taken by the Session's periodic activation renewal instead of the manifest commit the IT pins. The arm is now keyed to the manifest commit's operation, and the unkeyed arm is removed.
- **Reply-loss arms (FG8a, FG8d, FG8f).** A store reply-loss arm now fires only on a commit the store accepted. A refused commit never landed, so it is relayed and the arm stays armed for the commit that does land. Every dropped-reply witness is therefore "committed, reply lost", never a failed commit.

## Why it's needed

#14334 merged with these letters red on Linux, which is the only platform where most of them can run. The `hosted-harness-mysql` lane never reached them before the merge: its last run aborted in the unit phase on a main-side failure, since fixed by #14382. The next lane run on main would have gone red on the FG8 class itself. The review round at `7f6449684b` had flagged four P1s and one P2 in exactly these spots, and they were still open when the PR merged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On a Linux host with cgroup v2, delegate a cgroup root the way the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane does. Then run the class with `-Phosted-monitor-run-gates`, a MySQL 8.4 URL, `-Dnode.executable`, `-Dqwen.cli.entry` pointing at a freshly bundled `dist/cli.js`, and `QWEN_MANAGED_HOOK_CGROUP_ROOT` set. Running one letter at a time with `-Dit.test='HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT#fg8d*'` keeps each turnaround to a few minutes.
2. Expect every letter green. The fault witnesses show in each case's `driver.log` under `target/fg8-cases/<letter>/`:
   - `FG8_DROPPED commit commitChildRunRecord <id>:<n>` for cancel-reply-lost and for receipt-drop-after-watermark;
   - `the status read is really held` followed by `the held status read was answered after the restore`;
   - `the settle commit was refused` followed by `still blocked after the stable window` for both publication cases.
3. A maintainer can dispatch `sdk-java.yml` on this branch to get the same verdict from the `hosted-harness-mysql` lane.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Lane-equivalent runs on an aarch64 Linux rig: Orange Pi, Docker with a privileged container on a private cgroup namespace, MySQL 8.4, Temurin 21, and the bundle built from the tree under test.

| Letter | Merged head `56606a5d6c` | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fg8a | ❌ dispatch-reply: the reply was dropped, the gate was never opened, 180 s timeout | ✅ 4/4 |
| fg8b | ❌ page-envelope-commit: no natural settle in 120 s, drain, then 180 s timeout | ✅ 4/4 |
| fg8d | ❌ cancel-status-unavailable: the drain joined the Harness's routine release and got `runtime_session_held` (later cases not reached; routine-release-refusal, unchanged from the merged head, answered `runtime_session_busy` on an intermediate run) | ✅ 6/6 |
| fg8e | — | ✅ 4/4 |
| fg8f | ❌ intermittently: receipt-drop dropped `renewActivation` | ✅ 3/3 |

All five letters ran in one pass on this PR's exact tree: fg8e 143 s, fg8f 96 s, fg8a 85 s, fg8b 127 s, fg8d 166 s. A second pass of fg8f and fg8d, the two letters with timing-sensitive arms, was also green. After merging main (which brought #14318 and #14358) and adding the review follow-ups, all five letters ran again on head `5e6eb43456`: fg8e 149 s, fg8f 91 s, fg8a 81 s, fg8b 130 s, fg8d 167 s, all green. `tsc -p integration-tests` on a fresh install is clean. After #14407 (FG8c) landed on main and was merged in, all six letters ran on head `45e7bf9106`: fg8e 150 s, fg8f 90 s, fg8a 85 s, fg8b 129 s, fg8d 167 s, fg8c 194 s, all green, with `tsc` clean. `checkstyle:check` on the module is clean. The fault witnesses named above appear in every case's `driver.log`. One example: routine-release-refusal answered `409 runtime_session_held` while the producer was at block 16 of 24, then exited on its own.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (aarch64 rig, cgroup v2, MySQL 8.4) |

### Environment (optional)

Rig: `maven:3.9.11-eclipse-temurin-21` (arm64), privileged with `--cgroupns private`, `mysql:8.4` with `--disable-log-bin`, Node 22.23, and `pnpm install` building the bundle. A container needs a non-empty `/etc/machine-id`, otherwise the storage guard refuses the mount registration.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: driver releases now wait for the turn's handback, so each FG8d case gives up a few seconds of overlap. The letters stay far inside the 600 s per-letter ceiling (fg8d ran in about 3 minutes on the rig).
- Not validated / out of scope: `cancel-status-unavailable` still faults only the Harness→Broker link. The Broker's own `shell-status`/`shell-terminate` calls to the worker never cross the driver's proxy, and faulting them needs a production seam. That case is deferred to a follow-up issue (#14399), as recorded on #14334's review thread. One production behavior surfaced along the way and is not changed here: a drain release that arrives while a routine release attempt is in flight joins it and answers `runtime_session_held` without draining.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test and design-doc changes only.
- Design doc, updated in both languages: [English](docs/design/2026-10-15-monitor-run-fault-gates-abd.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-15-monitor-run-fault-gates-abd.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

- Follow-up to #14334; see #14163.
- Deferred Broker→Worker status fault: #14399.

## 本 PR 做了什么

这是 #14334 的后续。#14334 在最后一轮评审和 Linux 实跑处理完之前就合入了，它的 FG8a/FG8b/FG8d 字母此前只在 macOS 上跑过不需要 cgroup 的那几例。在真实 Linux + cgroup v2 + MySQL 8.4 上，合入时的 head 有三个字母会红，另外 #14120 更早落地的一个字母会偶发红。本 PR 修正门禁的编排与断言，让每个用例驱动和检查的都是生产代码实际的行为。纯测试改动：只动故障 driver、IT 类，以及 FG8a/FG8b/FG8d 设计文档的中英两版，不改任何生产代码。

- **dispatch-reply（FG8a）。** Broker 在派发提交后就回 `:start`，这时 worker 可能还没启动 producer。driver 只看了一次 producer 的启动标记，没看到，就再也不开 gate，于是 run 永远无法结算（rig 上 180 秒超时）。现在改为先等到 run 要么已启动、要么已按未启动结算，再做判断。
- **提交日志的作用域（FG8a）。** store 代理的提交日志是唯一没有按用例重置的臂，capture-commit-reply 丢掉的那笔 page 提交会出现在 observation-advance-reply 的丢弃列表里。现在和其他臂一样按用例重置。
- **page-envelope-commit（FG8b）。** 被拒的 page envelope 并不是"只毒化 capture"。24 块的 capture 在流封口前填不满一页，它唯一的 page 搭封口后的下一次输出推进提交，之后的每个 manifest 也都仍然引用它。所以 run 和 manifest-commit 一样被阻塞，永远不会自然退出。两个发布用例现在共用阻塞期望：记录保持 `running`，没有停止证据，`stopRequested: false`，也不会重执行。page 用例的见证是一笔携带 page 且被拒的推进提交。"零 page 行"只对 page 用例断言，因为 manifest 用例里 page 会随封口时的推进正常落库。
- **cancel-reply-lost（FG8d）。** 每个 shell 修订都用同一个操作名提交。"丢下一笔 `commitChildRunRecord`"因此先命中了输出推进，"恰好一次"也把 admit、dispatch、attach 和输出推进的提交一起算了进去。现在这条臂只丢首次置 `stopRequested` 的那个修订，判断依据是提交里携带的记录体。IT 断言恰好只有一个不同的命令置过停止标记。
- **cancel-status-unavailable（FG8d）。** driver 自己发的 captive 状态读取走的是 Broker 根本没有的路由，404 也被当成了恢复成功。现在改发 Harness 自己的进程状态读取，经过暂停中的代理。代理必须报告这次读取被泊住，恢复之后它必须对同一个 execution 应答 200。
- **release 时机（FG8d）。** driver 的 release（无论 routine 还是 drain）现在都要等派发它的那一轮把 Runtime Session 交还之后才发：所有调用行都已终态，并且 Harness 自己在轮末发的 routine release 已经得到应答。在这之前，Broker 会因前台工作答 `runtime_session_busy`。如果 driver 的 release 赶上 Harness 的 routine release 还在飞，它会被并入那次尝试并拿到同一个应答 `runtime_session_held`，哪怕 driver 要的是 drain。
- **receipt-drop-after-watermark（FG8f）。** "丢下一笔任意提交"这条臂被 Session 周期性的激活续期抢先命中了，而不是 IT 钉住的那笔 manifest 提交。现在这条臂按 manifest 提交的操作名匹配，不带键的那条臂已删除。
- **丢回复臂（FG8a、FG8d、FG8f）。** store 侧的丢回复臂现在只对 store 已接受的提交生效。被拒的提交从未落库，照常转发，臂保持待命，留给真正落库的那次提交。因此每个丢回复见证都是“已提交、回复丢失”，不会落在一次失败的提交上。

## 为什么需要

#14334 合入时这些字母在 Linux 上是红的，而大部分字母只能在 Linux 上跑。合入前 `hosted-harness-mysql` 车道一直没跑到它们：最后一次车道死在单元测试阶段，原因是 main 侧的一个失败，后来已由 #14382 修复。main 上下一次车道运行就会在 FG8 这个类本身上变红。`7f6449684b` 那一轮评审正好在这些位置提了 4 个 P1 和 1 个 P2，PR 合入时它们都还没有处理。

auto_merge.commit_message:
* test(managed-agent): ground the FG8a/FG8b/FG8d gate choreography in Linux truth (#14163)

Follow-up to #14334. That PR's letters had only been run cgroup-free on
macOS; on a Linux + cgroup v2 rig with MySQL 8.4 (Orange Pi, aarch64) the
merged head fails fg8a (dispatch-reply), fg8b (page-envelope-commit), fg8d
(cancel-status-unavailable, cancel-reply-lost, the release arms) and,
intermittently, fg8f (receipt-drop-after-watermark).
Each fix below closes a review finding left open on #14334 or a failure
the rig reproduced; none touches production code.

- dispatch-reply: the Broker answers :start once beginDispatch
  committed, before the worker necessarily wrote the producer's marker.
  A single look at bg-started.txt left the run-gate shut and the case
  timed out at 180 s on the rig; wait until the run started or settled
  never-started first.
- The store proxy's commit log resets per case like every arm, so
  capture-commit-reply's dropped page commit no longer surfaces in
  observation-advance-reply's droppedCommitOps.
- page-envelope-commit: the refused page rides the first output-advance
  commit after the stream seals, and every later manifest still names
  it, so the run is blocked exactly like manifest-commit — never a
  natural exit. Both arms now share the blocked branch; the witness is a
  refused advance that carried the page. The zero-page assertion is
  kept for the page arm only (the manifest arm's page lands with the
  seal-time advance).
- cancel-reply-lost: every shell revision commits as
  commitChildRunRecord, so the arm now drops only the revision that
  first sets stopRequested, read from the staged managed-child_run
  resource, and the IT asserts one distinct stop-revision command id.
- cancel-status-unavailable: the captive read was GET :status, a route
  the Broker does not serve (404 passed as a recovery). It is now the
  Harness's own GET /executions/<call>:process, the proxy names it as
  parked, and it must answer 200 after the restore. The Broker's own
  shell-status to the worker never crosses this proxy; faulting that
  link needs a production seam and is left to a follow-up.
- Every driver release (routine or drain) waits until the dispatching
  turn handed the Runtime Session back: before that the Broker answers
  runtime_session_busy, or joins the release to the Harness's in-flight
  turn-end routine release and answers it runtime_session_held, even
  for a drain.
- fg8f receipt-drop-after-watermark: the bare next-commit drop arm was
  taken by the Session's activation renewal on the rig (droppedOp
  renewActivation instead of the manifest commit the IT pins); the arm
  is now keyed to commitChildRunRecord and the unkeyed arm is gone.

Design doc (EN + zh-CN) rows updated to match.

* test(managed-agent): drop only accepted commit replies in the FG8 store proxy

A reply-loss arm now fires only on a commit the store accepted, so a
refused commit relays and the arm stays armed for the one that lands.
The stop-revision arm is consumed by its own condition rather than by
the page-envelope branch, and the cancel-status-unavailable case names
a missing :process row instead of throwing a TypeError.

* docs(design): note that FG8 reply-loss arms fire only on accepted commits

prs.title: fix(qqbot)!: restore per-group session isolation under thread scope
prs.body:
> **Update (round 5)** — head is now `87a6b5ff76fcb521ab8026b33c5c67aadf4d0281`: **2 commits** on top of `bc534b3adf` (`f8dff632bb`, `87a6b5ff76`), touching only `packages/channels/qqbot/src/QQChannel.ts` (+59/−17), `cron.test.ts` (+306/−0) and `stream.test.ts` (+39/−0). The failure-exit P2 raised by @wenshao and independently confirmed by @qqqys is fixed there, with 9 new regression cases; see the [review reply](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13882#issuecomment-6220957169) for the per-exit behaviour, the mutation evidence, and the residuals that are disclosed rather than fixed. `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` shows as failing only because the job was **cancelled at 29m07s** (fork lane cap), not because a test failed.

---

> **Migrated from #13250 on 2026-10-11 — identical code, identical head SHA.**
>
> `#13250` was stuck on a GitHub-side artifact, not a code problem: an invisible `CHANGES_REQUESTED` left behind by the now-deleted `qwen-code-ci-bot` account. That PR reports `reviews: 0`, `reviewThreads: 0` and zero review comments, its timeline contains no `reviewed` / `review_dismissed` event, and the account itself returns 404 — yet `reviewDecision` stayed `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, and because the `main` ruleset sets `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push: false`, 90+ pushes never cleared it. A review that no longer exists cannot be dismissed by the author.
>
> Everything else on `#13250` was healthy: content CI was green (25 pass / 7 skipped; the only three failures were `CI_BOT_PAT` 403s from that suspended account), the branch was conflict-free against `main`, and the `main` ruleset declares no required status checks.
>
> This PR carries the **same commit** — `0851c08947d57c9323da7f518cbaafe3723ac5a3` — re-pointed through a new fork branch so it can start from a clean review state. Nothing was rebased, squashed or changed in the move, so the maintainer round-4 verification (`merge-ready` on correctness, 2554/2554 scripted assertions, head `0851c08947` against base `43a6e1e5e4`) still refers to exactly this code.

## What this PR does

Restores per-group session isolation for the QQ Bot channel. Removes the forced `sessionScope: 'single'` override that the constructor applied to its own copy of the config whenever `groupAllPolicy` was `keyword` or `all` (introduced during PR #6457 review); the channel now respects the configured scope and warns when a non-shared scope is combined with full-message group mode. Reply streaming keeps a per-session anchor and carries it across seal and cancel boundaries, so a cancelled or superseded turn still flushes against its own `msg_id` (per-message wire anchoring itself landed on `main` in #10145; what this change owns is the boundary machinery around it). Orphaned persisted routing entries from the old single-scope layout are purged on startup, and the QQ channel now declares `thread` as its default session scope so zero-config deployments get per-group shared context by default.

## Supersedes #8241

This is the same change as #8241, carried to a fresh PR after 22 review rounds and 83 blocker-signalling threads. The pipeline's own reports said each round re-read the entire diff (its incremental anchor was lost), so rounds spent their budget re-deriving earlier findings and the thread never converged; the newest round posted zero new findings, and every Critical posted across all rounds is fixed here with a pinning test and a mutation proof. No code changed in the move.

The branch is merged up to `main` at `1a933f7b5e`, which includes the QQ Bot inbound-media PR (#12850) that landed while #8241 was open. The only conflict was an additive stub in a test double in `events.test.ts` (`getResponseMessageId` from this change, `prepareThenHandleInbound` from the media work); both were kept. The package's suite is 692 tests green at this head — the merge base `543f03e5b1` runs 357, so this change adds 335 tests to that baseline (the 41 the inbound-media PR brought are included in those 357). On the previous head, `Qwen Code CI` was fully green, including `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`, which had been red for every head since round 18 over `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts` (#10490), a host-gate flake that `main` fixed in #13094 and that merging `main` cleared.

## Why it's needed

The forced scope never reached the router. `start.ts` and `daemon-worker.ts` call `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)` with the *parsed* config, before `QQChannel`'s constructor rewrites its own copy — so the override changed what `QQChannel` believed, not how sessions were actually routed. That split brain produced two defects on `main`:

1. **Full-message group mode never actually got shared group context.** Routing stayed `user`-scoped, so group traffic was fragmented into one session per sender — the opposite of what the override existed to guarantee.
2. **`QQChannel` still believed it was `single`**, so every `sessionScope === 'single'` gate inside it fired against user-scoped routing — for example, a DM was treated as a shared session and `/clear` demanded an extra `confirm`.

The "everything collapsed into one `__single__` session, with context leaking across groups and into DMs" symptom is real, but it requires `sessionScope: "single"` to be set explicitly — which is what the docs recommended for `groupAllPolicy` users. The `replyMsgId` concurrency issue that motivated the override was never actually resolved by it, only hidden.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the unit suite: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 8 files, 692 tests pass (357 at the merge base `543f03e5b1`, so this change adds 335; the inbound-media work's 41 are already inside those 357).
- Config-level behavior: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and no explicit `sessionScope`, the channel must not emit the scope-forcing WARNING and must route group messages per group (`<channel>:<group_openid>`) and DMs per user (`<channel>:<user_openid>`).
- Concurrent streaming: two users messaging in the same group while the bot is mid-stream must keep their replies anchored to their own `msg_id` (no cross-threading) — covered by the new stream tests.
- Cancel behavior: interrupting a turn (`/cancel` or steer) must flush the buffered partial reply before tearing down stream state — partial output is not dropped (regression test pins this).
- The streaming-ownership invariants the review rounds converged on have their own acceptance block: a settling flush chain must not write shared per-session state once the session was torn down or the turn was superseded (`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal routing/session behavior, no user-visible UI change. Before: with `groupAllPolicy: "all"`, group traffic was fragmented per sender while `QQChannel` believed it was running one shared session. After: per-group shared sessions with cross-group isolation, and the channel's belief matches the router.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` — 692 passed; `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` (in the package) — clean; `eslint` on changed source — clean; `prettier --check` — clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Beyond the QQ channel this diff also touches two shared surfaces, both of which were needed to make the scope default usable: `parseChannelConfig` and the daemon's channel-settings store now share one `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)` helper, so saving a `multiSession` channel without a stored scope resolves `"user"` instead of tripping `ChannelBase`'s construction-time invariant; and the Web Shell channel editor no longer pre-fills a plugin's non-`user` default for a `multiSession` instance, which otherwise made that save fail (`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`). An explicitly stored or submitted non-`user` scope on a `multiSession` channel is still rejected.
- Main risk or tradeoff: the effective session scope for any QQ deployment that omitted `sessionScope` changes from the global `user` default to this plugin's `thread` default (`config-utils.ts` fills `rawConfig.sessionScope || plugin.defaultSessionScope || 'user'`). This applies to **every** such config — not just `groupAllPolicy: keyword/all` users — including plain `groupPolicy: "allowlist"` + `requireMention` deployments, which go from per-sender contexts to per-group shared context. The tradeoff is deliberate (per-group context is what full-message group mode was always supposed to mean), and `sessionScope: "user"` restores the old behaviour per deployment.
- Not validated / out of scope: live end-to-end verification needs real QQ credentials and was not run in CI; macOS and Windows were not exercised in CI (Linux lanes only).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no config-format change. A group thread session is a shared session, so the commands that act on it (`/clear`, `/who`, `/status`, `/loop`, `/btw`) and the permission answers (`/approve`, `/approve-always`, `/deny`) are restricted to the members listed in the channel's `operators` (`ChannelBase.isSharedSessionOperator` reads only `operators`; `allowedUsers` and `senderPolicy` do not grant them). `operators` is unset by default, so a zero-config QQ group has no member who can run those commands and no one who can answer a permission request raised in it; set `operators` to the QQ user ids that should steer the group's session — the channel now warns at startup when group access is enabled on a shared scope with `operators` empty. Measured consequence of leaving it unset: a tool call that needs approval has no one who can answer it, so the requester and every other member are refused, the tool never runs, and the group's session is held by that pending prompt until `AcpBridge` times it out (300 s) — `/cancel` queues behind it too. Deployments that never show a permission prompt (for example `yolo`) are unaffected. (`!` host-shell stays disabled in every QQ group chat regardless of scope.) On startup the channel reports unroutable persisted routes: the `<channel>:__single__` entries left over from the forced single-scope era, and — whenever the effective scope is not `user` — this channel's own three-part `<channel>:<sender>:<chat>` keys, which under `thread`/`chat_thread` can never resolve again and count against the bridge's per-workspace session cap on every restart. Deleting them is opt-in: with `purgeLegacySessions` unset (its default, `false`) the channel logs the count and removes nothing; with `purgeLegacySessions: true` it writes a rescue copy of the routes about to be removed (`qq-sessions-purged.json`) before the first deletion, so a legacy conversation can be rebuilt by hand. History behind them is not migrated in either mode (it cannot be split per group). Ownership is decided by each entry's recorded target channel, never by key prefix, so a sibling channel's routes are untouched, and the purge runs after restore so the first boot still re-attaches the entries once before releasing them. Cancelled turns now flush their buffered partial reply before the stream state is torn down, so partial output is no longer lost. Release note: the effective default session scope for QQ deployments that omit `sessionScope` changes from `user` to `thread`; group sessions are shared sessions, so `operators` must be configured for members to answer permission prompts or run session-control commands; the legacy-route purge is opt-in and removes nothing by default.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8238

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

修复 QQ Bot channel 的会话隔离：删除 `groupAllPolicy=keyword/all` 时构造器对自己那份配置强制写入 `sessionScope='single'` 的逻辑（PR #6457 review 期间引入），改为尊重配置，并在"非共享 scope + 全量群消息模式"组合下发出 WARNING。流式回复按 session 锚定 `msg_id`，同群并发用户不再互相串线。启动时清理旧的 single-scope 布局遗留的、已无法解析的持久化路由条目；QQ channel 声明默认 `sessionScope` 为 `thread`，零配置部署默认获得"每群共享上下文"。

与 #8241 是同一份改动，迁移到新 PR：原线程已经历 22 轮评审、累计 83 个未决阻塞线程，而流水线自己的报告说明每轮都在重读整个 diff（增量锚点丢失），预算被用于反复重推既有发现，始终没有收敛；最新一轮已零新发现，而历轮提出的所有 Critical 在本树中均已修复，每一条都有固定行为的测试与变异证明。迁移过程未改动任何代码。

分支已与 `main`（`1a933f7b5e`）合并，其中包含 #8241 还开着时合入的 QQ Bot 入站媒体 PR（#12850）。唯一的冲突是 `events.test.ts` 里测试替身上的一处新增（本改动的 `getResponseMessageId` 与媒体改动的 `prepareThenHandleInbound`），两侧都保留。合并后该包 692 个测试全绿 —— merge base `543f03e5b1` 为 357，故本改动相对该基线新增 335 个（媒体 PR 带入的 41 个已含在这 357 内）。上一个 head 上 `Qwen Code CI` 已全绿，包括 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`：它自第 18 轮起一直红，原因是 `packages/core/src/memory/recall-scan-latency.test.ts`（#10490）的 runner 门禁，`main` 已在 #13094 修复，合并 `main` 后即转绿。

## 为什么需要它

强制 scope 从未真正传到 router。`start.ts` 与 `daemon-worker.ts` 用**解析后的**配置调用 `router.setChannelScope(name, config.sessionScope)`，而 `QQChannel` 的构造器只是改写了自己那份副本 —— 于是这个强制改变的是 `QQChannel` 的认知，而不是真实路由。这一"两个真相"在 `main` 上产生两个缺陷：

1. **全量群消息模式从未真正获得共享群上下文。** 路由仍是 `user` scope，群消息按发送者碎片化 —— 与该强制想要保证的完全相反。
2. **`QQChannel` 自认为 `single`**，于是它内部所有 `sessionScope === 'single'` 判定都作用在 user 路由上 —— 例如私聊被当成共享会话，`/clear` 会多要一次 `confirm`。

"所有群/私聊折叠进一个 `__single__` 会话、上下文互相泄漏"这个现象确实存在，但前提是显式设置 `sessionScope: "single"`（文档当时正是这样向 `groupAllPolicy` 用户推荐的）。当年为掩盖 `replyMsgId` 并发问题而引入的强制从未真正解决该问题，只是把它藏了起来。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 跑单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 8 个文件、692 个测试通过（merge base `543f03e5b1` 为 357，故相对该基线新增 335 个）。
- 配置层行为：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 且未显式设置 `sessionScope` 时，不得出现"强制 scope"的 WARNING，且群消息按群路由（`<channel>:<group_openid>`）、私聊按用户路由（`<channel>:<user_openid>`）。
- 并发流式：同群两个用户在 bot 流式输出期间发消息，各自回复必须锚定到自己的 `msg_id`（不串线）—— 由新增 stream 测试覆盖。
- 取消行为：中断一个 turn（`/cancel` 或 steer）必须先 flush 已缓冲的部分回复再清理流状态 —— 部分输出不丢（有回归测试固定）。
- 各轮评审收敛出的流式归属不变量有独立验收块：会话已被拆除或 turn 已被后继取代后，正在收尾的 flush 链不得再写共享的 per-session 状态（`R21 acceptance: ownership gates for a settling flush chain`）。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 属内部路由/会话行为，无用户可见的 TUI 变化。改动前：`groupAllPolicy: "all"` 下群消息按发送者碎片化，而 `QQChannel` 自认为在跑一个共享会话。改动后：每群共享会话且跨群隔离，channel 的认知与 router 一致。

| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |

仅单元测试：`cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run` —— 692 通过；包内 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 npx tsc --build` —— clean；改动源码 `eslint` —— clean；`prettier --check` —— clean。

## 风险与范围

- 除 QQ channel 外，本 diff 还触及两个共享面，都是让新的 scope 默认值可用所必需的：`parseChannelConfig` 与 daemon 的 channel-settings store 现共用同一个 `effectiveSessionScope(rawConfig, multiSession, plugin)`，因此保存一个未存 `sessionScope` 的 `multiSession` channel 会解析为 `"user"`，不再触发 `ChannelBase` 的构造期不变量；Web Shell 的 channel 编辑器也不再为 `multiSession` 实例预填插件的非 `user` 默认值（此前会使保存失败：`requires sessionScope "user" when multiSession is enabled`）。显式存储或提交的非 `user` scope 在 `multiSession` channel 上仍会被拒绝。

- 未验证或超出范围：真实端到端验证需要真实 QQ 凭据，CI 未跑；CI 只在 Linux 通道跑，macOS 与 Windows 未覆盖。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #8238

prs.title: fix(ci): stop re-running the H2 unit suite in every Hosted job step
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Hosted process fault gates job runs three Maven invocations — the Hosted integration tests, the admission-gate witnesses, and the O4 filesystem gates — and each one ran the module's full H2 unit suite again before its own integration tests. This PR turns surefire off in those three profiles, the same way the RocketMQ broker and multi-node gate profiles already do, so the unit suite runs once per workflow run, in the MariaDB job, where it already ran on Java 21. A workflow meta-test pins the split: the three Hosted-job profiles must skip surefire and the MariaDB profile and step must not.

## Why it's needed

Each of those repeats is roughly 4,200 tests and about 11 minutes on a hosted runner. On #14391's head (run 38925581548) every Hosted integration test passed (53 run, 0 failures, 0 errors), yet the Hosted verify step was killed by its 45-minute ceiling while the final Checkstyle goal was running: about 11 minutes went to the unit suite, 32 to the integration tests. The O4 step spends 11 of its 20 minutes on the same repeat. #14334 has since raised the Hosted step ceiling to 75 minutes, which removes that particular kill, but the job still pays for up to three redundant unit runs per run, and the O4 step's margin is still thin. Removing the duplicate work is cheaper than raising every ceiling again as gates are added.

The unit classes do not depend on anything only the Hosted job provides: the only MySQL-backed variant is an integration-test subclass, and the cgroup, probe and storage-registration inputs are read only by integration and gate classes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the `test` phase under each profile: the three Hosted-job profiles print "Tests are skipped." for surefire, while `-Pmysql-integration` still runs unit tests.
- Run `-Po4-mysql-gates verify` without a MySQL server: failsafe still starts `O4MySqlGate` (it fails for the missing database), so the integration tests are not skipped along with the unit suite.
- `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` and `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` pass; flipping any one profile's skip back to false fails the new assertion.
- After merge, a dispatched SDK Java run should show the Hosted job's three Maven steps without a surefire test run and the MariaDB job unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI configuration). Before: run 38925581548, Hosted verify step 15:55→16:40, unit suite 15:55→16:06, integration tests 16:06→16:38, killed at the 45-minute ceiling; O4 step unit suite 16:40→16:52.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Maven 3.9 / JDK 21, offline; Linux is exercised by CI only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a unit test whose result differed between the Hosted runner and the MariaDB runner would now only run in the MariaDB job. No unit class reads the Hosted job's inputs, so the two runs exercised the same code on the same JDK.
- Not validated / out of scope: the step ceilings are left as they are; the Hosted shell lifecycle failure (#14361) and the FG8f in-flight-cap measurement race (#14400) are separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Running `-Phosted-harness-mysql`, `-Phosted-harness-gates` or `-Po4-mysql-gates` locally no longer runs the unit suite; run `mvn verify` for that.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14392, #14361, #14400

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Hosted 进程故障门禁作业里的三个 Maven 调用——Hosted 集成测试、准入门禁见证、O4 文件系统门禁——每一个都会先完整跑一遍模块的 H2 单元套件再跑自己的集成测试。本 PR 在这三个 profile 内部关闭 surefire（与 RocketMQ broker、multi-node gate profile 的既有做法一致），使单元套件每次工作流运行只跑一次：仍在 MariaDB 作业里跑，Java 21 不变。一个工作流元测试钉住这个拆分：三个 Hosted 作业 profile 必须跳过 surefire，MariaDB profile 与其步骤不得跳过。

## 为什么需要

每重复一次约 4,200 个测试、托管 runner 上约 11 分钟。在 #14391 的 head（run 38925581548）上，全部 Hosted 集成测试通过（53 run，0 failures），但 Hosted verify 步骤在最后一个 Checkstyle goal 运行时被 45 分钟上限杀掉：约 11 分钟花在单元套件、32 分钟在集成测试。O4 步骤 20 分钟里有 11 分钟花在同一份重复上。#14334 已把 Hosted 步骤上限提到 75 分钟，消除那次具体被杀，但每次运行仍最多多付三次冗余单元跑，O4 步骤余量依旧很薄。去掉重复工作比再次抬高所有上限更划算。

单元类不依赖 Hosted 作业独有的任何输入：唯一 MySQL 支撑的变体是集成测试子类，cgroup、probe、storage-registration 输入只被集成与门禁类读取。

## 如何验证

- 在每个 profile 下运行 `test` 阶段：三个 Hosted 作业 profile 的 surefire 打印 "Tests are skipped."，而 `-Pmysql-integration` 仍运行单元测试。
- 无 MySQL 服务器运行 `-Po4-mysql-gates verify`：failsafe 仍会启动 `O4MySqlGate`（因缺数据库而失败），说明集成测试没有随单元套件一起被跳过。
- `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 与 `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` 通过；把任一 profile 的 skip 改回 false 会使新断言变红。
- 合并后，一次派发的 SDK Java 运行应显示 Hosted 作业的三个 Maven 步骤没有 surefire 测试运行、MariaDB 作业不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：若某个单元测试的结果在 Hosted runner 与 MariaDB runner 之间可能不同，它现在只在 MariaDB 作业里跑。没有单元类读取 Hosted 作业的输入，两次运行在同一 JDK 上执行的是同一份代码。
- 未验证/范围外：步骤上限保持原样；Hosted shell 生命周期失败（#14361）与 FG8f in-flight-cap 测量竞态（#14400）另行处理。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。本地运行 `-Phosted-harness-mysql`、`-Phosted-harness-gates` 或 `-Po4-mysql-gates` 不再跑单元套件；需要时运行 `mvn verify`。

关联 #14392、#14361、#14400
</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): link a child task to its child Session (#13746 F2)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A `child_agent` or `workflow` task now names the child Session that runs it. The public task view gains `child_session_id` and the WebShell task view gains `childSessionId`, present once the run's committed record names its child (from the attach on, or on a terminal verdict that names a minted child) and absent for every other kind. A caller reads the child's output through the Session, Turn, Item and event routes that already serve it.

The view reads the id from the run's latest committed record, the only place that fact lives, so there is no new column, migration or backfill. Only the two task view paths read it; the cancel admission's task lookup stays a pure projection read. The contract moves to 1.55.0 (provisional; main is at 1.54.0 since #14412), with a schema conditional on both task schemas that forbids the field for any other kind, and the WebShell types are regenerated.

## Why it's needed

Since H4b a child run is a real task: a caller can list it, watch it and, since H4f, cancel it, but cannot read what it produced. A child task has no output events and no Artifacts, while its output already exists as the child Session's own transcript; nothing on the task said which Session that is. #13746 F2 asked for the children's output; of the two options the H4f note left (link the task to its child Session, or relay the child's output as task events), this takes the link, which needs no new journal, retention or authorization.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Start a child agent from a parent Session and read the parent's task list: before the child attaches the task carries no `child_session_id`; once it attaches the task names a Session id.
- Read that Session through the public Session route as the same caller: it answers, because a child Session lives in the parent's Workspace and is readable by exactly the parent's readers.
- Read any other kind of task (a background Shell, a Monitor): it carries no `child_session_id`, and the schema refuses one there.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: a child task's view has no reference to its child Session, and nothing in the public contract names one.
- After, real stack (FG9, `HostedSessionRelayFaultGatesIT`, MySQL 8.4, packaged Harness, on the head rebased onto `b4614845f0`): all four letters (FG9a, FG9f, and FG9d/FG9e from #14402) pass, 11 cases. In the seven cases that run a team member to its command chain (the six of FG9a and FG9f, and FG9d `cancel-during-handover`) the member runs as a `child_agent` task of its lead; the lead's public task view names the member's child Session in `child_session_id` — the same Session the member's committed record attached — and that Session reads through the public Session route.
- Unit and contract suites: the real-record child chain names no child before the attach and names it on both surfaces after it (workflow too; Shell and Monitor never); the served routes validate against their schemas; the schema cases accept the field for both child kinds and refuse it for the others. Removing the schema's kind conditional, or returning no id, fails them. A reader's task list is pinned to serve the child task through its committed body (mutation-checked). 0 failures across the touched suites; Checkstyle clean; the WebShell types pass their freshness test and the package typechecks.
- The full MariaDB lane (JDK 21, `-Pmysql-integration clean verify`) on the combined tree of this PR and its sibling #13746 PRs, rebased onto main `b4614845f0`: 4,357 unit tests, 0 failures; 731 integration tests with one error, `ManagedAgentMySqlIT#admitsHookExecutionsWithoutReadingTheirHistoryOnMySql` ("writer grant is stale"), an environment failure of that host that fails the same way on main; SpotBugs 0.
- After merging main `7834280810` (#14358, #14411), and again `0f1c32320f` after #14412 landed: compile, the touched suites plus `HarnessCoordinatorTest` and `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` (436 tests, then 508 with the H4f-c suites; 0 failures) and Checkstyle pass again; the real-stack gates and the lane above ran on `b4614845f0`, and the merge brings no change to their paths.

Linux x86_64, JDK 25 for unit tests, MySQL 8.4.6 in Docker, the packaged `dist/cli.js`.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`child_agent` 或 `workflow` 任务现在会给出运行它的 child Session。公开任务视图增加 `child_session_id`，WebShell 任务视图增加 `childSessionId`：当 run 已提交的记录给出其 child 时出现（从 attach 起，或在给出已创建 child 的终态 verdict 上），其他任何类型都不带。调用者经已有的 Session、Turn、Item 与事件路由读取 child 的输出。

* feat(managed-agent): link a child task to its child Session (#13746 F2)

A child_agent or workflow task now names the child Session that runs
it: PublicTask.child_session_id and WebShellTask.childSessionId, present
once the run's committed child_run record names the child (its attach,
or a terminal verdict that names a minted child) and absent for every
other kind. The child is a plain Session in the parent's Workspace, so
the callers that can read the task already read the child's Turns,
items and events; the link adds no authorization rule, route or event
type.

The task view reads the id from the record's committed body rather
than a new projected column, so there is no migration or backfill. The
cancel admission's task lookup stays a pure projection read.

Contract 1.54.0 (provisional) adds the optional field with a kind
conditional on both task schemas; the WebShell types are regenerated.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): add the FG9b/FG9c session relay store-failure and crash fault gates (#14164)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds slice 3, the last slice of the Stage F FG9 round (#14164): store-failure (FG9b) and process-crash (FG9c) fault gates for the two cross-Session relay domains, `session_message` and `session_command`. They run on the same real stack as slices 1 and 2: an in-JVM Spring control plane on MySQL, the embedded Runtime Broker, the packaged Hosted Harness and a scripted model. Two letters / five cases join the existing gate class. No production code changes.

FG9b refuses one journal write of the relay pass at the store, using a test-only trigger on the journal's record table that is scoped to the case tenant and one record shape. The three writes are the sender's outbound command, the lead's inbound receipt, and the copy-back of the receipt's reply onto the sender's entry.

The draft's one-shot trigger turned out to be unreachable: the store client retries an ambiguous 5xx commit three times, so the gate keeps each trigger armed until the case drops it, and asserts that it fired exactly three times. After the third refusal the Session latches its writes, and nothing but a cold Harness heals it. Each case therefore drops the trigger, restarts the Harness, and pins that the healing runs through the original command:

- **Refused outbound:** the sender's parked call is answered once from the journal as "not sent", and the command is never minted afresh. No entry, no ledger row and no store-accepted commit of it exist anywhere.
- **Refused receipt:** the re-execution on the cold lead finds the position it had already minted (one mint commit in the whole case) and commits the one receipt.
- **Refused copy-back:** the retry re-executes into the stored receipt (no second receipt, no second mint) and copies the same bytes back once, at revision 4.

FG9c SIGKILLs the Harness at the sharpest point of two steps: a commit the store accepted whose reply the store proxy holds, so the dead process never learned the commit landed.

- **Mid-fanout:** with a broadcast's first position minted and no receipt yet, the re-execution reports that position `sent.` from the journal and mints only the second (two mint commits for two positions).
- **Right after the outbound landed:** the takeover resumes the parked wait from the journal. The entry the dead process never acknowledged stays the one command, with one commit across the case, and the answer arrives once.

Fixture changes:

- The scripted lead's closing round now answers with text. Before, it returned an empty response, which the model client retries for about 20 s, so the lead's Turn stayed open long enough to collide with the arms. A lead Turn open across a latch or a kill leaves the cold lead churning on `workspace_unavailable` and executing nothing.
- FG9b and FG9c wait for the lead's Turn to settle before arming.
- The store proxy logs each commit's operation and upstream status, which is the "never minted twice" witness.

The healthy allowance for the shared Hosted fork moves 2640→3060 s with the measured six-letter class. That no longer fits one 600 s ceiling inside 3600 s, so the fork moves 3600→3720 s. The Verify step's 75 minutes still wrap it, so the step and the job ceiling stay as they are.

The bilingual design document marks FG9b/FG9c delivered, records the mechanics learned at landing, and adds five mutation checks.

## Why it's needed

The relay's replay-stability rule (one inbound receipt answered again byte for byte, already-minted positions probed and never re-sent, the sender's entry never duplicated) matters most when a write fails or a process dies halfway through a pass. A duplicate member message cannot be retracted, and a sender told "not sent" for a message that went out re-sends it. Before this PR those windows had only functional tests. This is the last of #14164's three slices, so the tracker closes with it.

Landing it also surfaced a real defect, filed as #14419. The Harness answers the relay's `answered` verb with 400 `invalid_command_operation` when the copy-back fails in the store, because that arm's catch also takes the store's own error classes. Delivery is unaffected, and the gate pins the outcome, not the code.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Build and bundle the CLI, and install the sibling Java SDK.
2. Run the focused `hosted-session-relay-gates` profile (or the Hosted lane) against a disposable MySQL 8.4 schema. The database user needs `CREATE TRIGGER`, as FG8b's does.
3. Expect six letters and zero failures. A per-letter selector (`-Dqwen.fg9b.case=…`, `-Dqwen.fg9c.case=…`) runs one case.

The fault-fired witnesses:

- the `fg9b_fire` count (3 per FG9b case);
- the Harness log's `recovery blocked: ManagedSessionWritesStoppedError` and `failed in its store` lines;
- `holding first-mint` / `holding outbound` in the letter's store-proxy log;
- a new writer generation on the Session under test after each restart.

To see the gates' teeth, apply any slice-3 mutation listed in the design document and run its case alone.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change.

Local results on the final code: three full-class runs green (556.8 s, 548.5 s, 527.8 s; FG9b 129–137 s, FG9c 100–109 s, the four earlier letters unchanged at about 310 s), and a fourth green on the tree rebased onto the latest main (533.7 s). The four bundle-side mutations were re-run red on the rebuilt bundle. The class ran 310 s with four letters on main's lane run 38957583765, matching local.

Mutations, each run against its case alone, each source restored and the gate green again:

- The cold load answers a never-committed outbound as "reached the leader" → `outbound-commit-refused` red at the answer.
- The receipt-commit failure is swallowed → `receipt-commit-refused` red: the execute answers 202 with no receipt behind it.
- The relay classifies the command done when its copy-back failed → `answered-commit-refused` red: the sender's wait ran out into `unknown`.
- Message ids are not replay-stable → `lead-kill-mid-fanout` red: three `msgc_` for two positions.
- The cold load reads a parked entry as never committed → `member-kill-after-mint` red: the reply is never consumed.
- Neutralizing only the send loop's probe is an equivalent mutant at the mid-fanout kill point, because the re-driven send of the same id answers `sent` without a commit. The design document records why.

The CI meta-tests that parse the Java workflow and pom pass (342 passed, 1 skipped). The module's `mvn verify` passes: 4342 surefire tests with 0 failures, 0 Checkstyle violations, 0 SpotBugs bugs.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, JDK 21 (Zulu 21.0.10), Maven 3.9, Node 22, MySQL 8.4.6 in a throw-away container; the CI lane is MySQL 8.4 on ubuntu-latest.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:**
  - The shared Hosted fork grows by about 250 s of healthy runtime and moves to 3720 s. The Verify step keeps its 600 s wrap with 180 s of margin.
  - FG9b/FG9c restart the packaged Harness mid-letter, a POSIX-only kill like FG6c/FG7c/FG8c; the lane is Linux.
  - The lead's closing-text change touches the shared fixture. The three full-class runs above include the earlier four letters, all green at their slice-2 timings.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - The `answered` error-code mislabel is filed, not fixed (#14419).
  - Whether a dead owner's workspace mount should outlive it as long as the probes saw is #13986's held-Runtime territory. FG9 sidesteps it by settling the lead's Turn first.
  - macOS was not run locally.
  - The hosted lane on main is currently red in the FG8 class (`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT`, #14163), unrelated to FG9.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none; test, CI-budget and design-document changes only.

Design document (English and Chinese, synchronized): `docs/design/2026-10-15-session-relay-fault-gates.md`, `docs/design/2026-10-15-session-relay-fault-gates.zh-CN.md`.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14164 — slice 3 of 3. Follow-up: #14419.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

落地 Stage F FG9 轮次（#14164）的第 3 片，也是最后一片：为两个跨 Session 的 relay 域 `session_message` 与 `session_command` 补上存储故障（FG9b）与进程崩溃（FG9c）故障门禁。它们跑在与第 1、2 片相同的真实栈上：in-JVM Spring 控制面 + MySQL、内嵌 Runtime Broker、打包的 Hosted Harness、脚本化模型。两个字母、五个用例加入已有门禁类。不改任何生产代码。

FG9b 在 store 处拒绝 relay 流程中的一次 journal 写入。手段是在 journal 记录表上建测试专用 trigger，限定到用例 tenant 和一种记录形态。三次写入分别是：发送方的出站命令、lead 的入站回执、把回执 reply 回写到发送方条目上。

草稿里的一次性 trigger 实际上到不了 Session：store 客户端对不确定的 5xx 提交会重试三次。所以门禁让每个 trigger 一直生效，直到用例主动拆掉，并断言它恰好点火三次。第三次被拒之后 Session 锁存写入，除了冷启动 Harness 没有任何东西能治愈它。因此每个用例都拆掉 trigger、重启 Harness，并钉住"治愈经由原命令完成"：

- **出站被拒：** 发送方 park 的调用从 journal 得到恰好一次「未发送」应答，命令绝不另铸；任何地方都没有条目、台账行，也没有被 store 接受的它的提交。
- **回执被拒：** 冷启动的 lead 上重新 execute 时，找到它此前已铸的位置（整个用例只有一次铸造提交），并提交唯一的回执。
- **回写被拒：** 重试重新 execute，落到已存的回执上（没有第二份回执、没有第二次铸造），把同样的字节回写一次，revision 4。

FG9c 在两个步骤最尖锐的点上 SIGKILL Harness：store 已接受、但应答被 store proxy 扣住的那次提交，所以死去的进程从未得知它已落地。

- **广播中途：** 广播第一个位置已铸、还没有回执时被杀。重执行从 journal 把该位置报为 `sent.`，只铸第二个（两个位置共两次铸造提交）。
- **出站刚落地：** 接管从 journal 恢复 park 的等待。死去的进程从未确认的那个条目仍是唯一的命令，整个用例只有一次提交，应答恰好到达一次。

夹具变更：

- 脚本化 lead 的收尾轮现在回文本。原先回空响应，模型客户端会重试约 20 s，lead 的 Turn 因此一直开着，和布防撞在一起。锁存或 kill 时如果 lead 的 Turn 还开着，冷启动的 lead 会在 `workspace_unavailable` 上打转，什么也不执行。
- FG9b 与 FG9c 在布防前等 lead 的 Turn 结束。
- store proxy 记录每次提交的 operation 与上游状态码，作为「绝不铸两次」的见证。

共享 Hosted fork 的健康配额随实测的六字母全类从 2640 s 改为 3060 s。这样一个 600 s 上限加上它已放不进 3600 s，于是 fork 改为 3720 s。Verify 步骤的 75 分钟仍能包住它，所以该步骤与 job 上限保持不变。

双语设计文档标记 FG9b/FG9c 已交付，记录落地时学到的机制，新增五个变异检查。

## Why it's needed

relay 的重放稳定性规则（入站回执逐字节再答、已铸位置先探测且绝不重发、发送方条目绝不重复），恰恰在一次写入失败或进程在流程中途死掉时最要紧。重复的成员消息无法撤回；对一条已经发出的消息说「未发送」，会诱发重发。在本 PR 之前，这些窗口只有功能测试覆盖。这是 #14164 三片中的最后一片，跟踪 issue 随它关闭。

落地过程中还发现了一个真实缺陷，已提为 #14419：回写在 store 中失败时，Harness 对 relay 的 `answered` 动词回 400 `invalid_command_operation`，因为该分支的 catch 也接住了 store 自己的错误类。投递不受影响，门禁钉住的是结果而不是错误码。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 构建并打包 CLI，安装兄弟 Java SDK。
2. 对一次性 MySQL 8.4 schema 运行聚焦的 `hosted-session-relay-gates` profile（或 Hosted 车道）。数据库用户需要 `CREATE TRIGGER` 权限，与 FG8b 相同。
3. 预期六个字母、零失败。按字母选择子（`-Dqwen.fg9b.case=…`、`-Dqwen.fg9c.case=…`）可只跑一个用例。

故障点火见证：

- `fg9b_fire` 计数（每个 FG9b 用例为 3）；
- Harness 日志里的 `recovery blocked: ManagedSessionWritesStoppedError` 与 `failed in its store`；
- 该字母 store-proxy 日志里的 `holding first-mint` / `holding outbound`；
- 每次重启后被测 Session 上出现新的 writer generation。

要看门禁的牙齿，可应用设计文档列出的任一切片 3 变异，并单独运行其用例。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A —— 仅测试变更。

最终代码的本地结果：三次全类运行全绿（556.8 s、548.5 s、527.8 s；FG9b 129–137 s、FG9c 100–109 s，此前四个字母仍约 310 s），rebase 到最新 main 后第四次全绿（533.7 s）。四个 bundle 侧变异也在重建后的 bundle 上重跑变红。main 的 lane run 38957583765 上本类四个字母用时 310 s，与本地一致。

变异（每个只对其用例运行；每次源码都已还原、门禁复绿）：

- 冷加载把从未提交的出站答成「已到达 leader」→ `outbound-commit-refused` 在作答处红；
- 回执提交的失败被吞掉 → `receipt-commit-refused` 红：execute 回 202，背后没有回执；
- 回写失败时 relay 仍把命令归为 done → `answered-commit-refused` 红：发送方的等待超时成 `unknown`；
