prs.title: fix(core): report a defunct session pid as dead instead of active
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the worktree session runtime-status probe zombie-aware. `getRuntimeStatusPathState` decides whether a session recorded in `runtime.json` is still running by calling `process.kill(status.pid, 0)` and, on success, returning `'active'`. A zombie answers that call — an exited-but-unreaped child still occupies its process-table slot — so the session was reported as live for as long as its parent stayed around.

This PR asks the existing shared zombie check (`/proc/<pid>/stat` field 3) on both paths where `kill` established that the pid exists: the success path and the `EPERM` path (the kernel permission-checks signal 0 regardless of the target's state, so a cross-user zombie reaches the catch too). A defunct pid now yields `'dead'`, which makes `isSessionRuntimeActive` report the session inactive and sets `sawDeadRuntimeStatus`.

`isZombie` is exported from `packages/core/src/utils/process-liveness.ts` rather than reusing the binary `isPidAlive`, because this probe owes its caller a third answer. `isPidAlive` folds "could not tell" into "dead"; here that would feed `sawDeadRuntimeStatus` and could flip the aggregate to `'inactive'` for a session that is in fact alive. The `'unknown'` fall-through for any other errno is unchanged, and `EACCES` still lands there — only the confirmed false positive moves.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #14288: a 48-day-old `[node] <defunct>` zombie whose still-live parent kept it unreaped, and a session-detection script that reported that dead session as **live** because `runtime.json` liveness said `'active'`. Anything downstream that trusts this verdict — session sweeps, worktree restore decisions, the CLI's own startup paths — keeps a dead session in the live set indefinitely.

The unreaped-child situation itself is POSIX-inherent (a suspended parent cannot reap) and is not what this PR changes. The defect is that the probe mislabels the result.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

A real zombie cannot be produced from a child the Node test process itself spawns: libuv reaps its own children on SIGCHLD, so a spawned child that exits without being waited on goes `R` and then disappears (`ENOENT`) within milliseconds instead of parking in `Z`. (A separate holder process that never waits can park a real zombie — the sandboxed verification run did exactly that with a Python holder — but that shape is not portable across CI runners.) The new tests therefore serve `/proc/<pid>/stat` from a fake, the same technique as `withFakeProc` in `packages/core/src/utils/process-liveness.test.ts`, and force `process.platform` to `'linux'` so the parser is exercised on every CI runner rather than only the Linux one.

Four cases added to `describe('isSessionRuntimeActive')` in `packages/core/src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts`:

1. **zombie → inactive** — the recorded pid is `process.pid`, so `kill(pid, 0)` genuinely succeeds, and the fake `/proc` line says `Z`. Asserts `getSessionRuntimeLiveness === 'inactive'` and `isSessionRuntimeActive === false`. Fails on unfixed main with `expected 'active' to be 'inactive'`.
2. **live → active** — same harness, field 3 is `S`. Guards the harness itself: it is not vacuously passing.
3. **cross-user zombie → inactive** — `process.kill` is spied to throw `EPERM` while the fake `/proc` says `Z`, covering the second defective path.
4. **unexpected errno → unknown** — `process.kill` throws `EIO`; asserts `'unknown'`, not `'dead'`. This is the tri-state guard: collapsing `unknown` into `dead` is the direction that declares a live session inactive.

The pre-existing `'treats EPERM from the local pid probe as active'` case is untouched and still green — the non-zombie `EPERM` answer is unchanged.

Locally, on the unfixed base (`1989a7b7`), the two zombie cases fail:

```
 FAIL  src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts > isSessionRuntimeActive > reports a defunct (zombie) pid as inactive instead of active
AssertionError: expected 'active' to be 'inactive' // Object.is equality
 FAIL  src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts > isSessionRuntimeActive > reports a defunct pid owned by another user as inactive
AssertionError: expected 'active' to be 'inactive' // Object.is equality
 Tests  2 failed | 49 passed (51)
```

After the fix:

```
 ✓ src/utils/process-liveness.test.ts (30 tests) 86ms
 ✓ src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts (51 tests) 298ms
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  81 passed (81)
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non–user-visible (core liveness probe): N/A for Before/After screenshots. Test output above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

`isZombie` returns `false` off Linux by design, so the macOS/Windows behaviour is exactly what it is today — the change is Linux-only, matching the platform the report and the `/proc` parser both concern.

### Environment

Unit tests only: `node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts src/utils/process-liveness.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` from `packages/core`. Also ran `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json`, eslint and `prettier --check` on the three changed files — all exit 0.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an extra `/proc/<pid>/stat` read per runtime-status probe on Linux — two reads per `getSessionRuntimeLiveness` call, since enumeration probes the direct runtime-status path and then the `projects/` scan (a pre-existing double probe; the sandboxed verification measured ~7 µs/call on top of a ~66 µs baseline). `isZombie` degrades to "not a zombie" when `/proc` is unreadable (e.g. `hidepid`), so the worst case there is today's behaviour, not a new one.
- Not validated / out of scope: the suspended-parent-cannot-reap behaviour is POSIX-inherent and deliberately untouched. No doctor/status command, no sidecar cleanup, no reaping. `EACCES` handling is unchanged and still resolves to `'unknown'`. Call sites (`worktreeSessionService.ts` enumeration paths) and external consumers (`worktreeStartup.ts`, `AppContainer.tsx`, `exit-worktree.ts`) are not modified — they inherit the corrected verdict through the existing `RuntimeStatusState` type.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `isZombie` gains an `export`; no signature or type changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14288

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 worktree 会话的 runtime-status 探测具备僵尸进程感知能力。`getRuntimeStatusPathState` 通过 `process.kill(status.pid, 0)` 判断 `runtime.json` 里记录的会话是否还活着，成功就返回 `'active'`。但僵尸进程同样能响应这个调用——已退出但未被回收的子进程仍然占着进程表槽位——于是只要它的父进程还在，这个会话就一直被判为存活。

本 PR 在 `kill` 已经证明该 pid 存在的两条路径上都补上现有的共享僵尸检查（读 `/proc/<pid>/stat` 第 3 个字段）：成功路径，以及 `EPERM` 路径（内核对信号 0 的权限检查与目标状态无关，所以跨用户的僵尸也会走到 catch 里）。现在 defunct 的 pid 会得到 `'dead'`，`isSessionRuntimeActive` 因此正确报告会话不活跃，并置上 `sawDeadRuntimeStatus`。

这里从 `packages/core/src/utils/process-liveness.ts` 导出 `isZombie`，而不是复用二值的 `isPidAlive`，因为这个探测对它的调用方欠着第三个答案。`isPidAlive` 把「判断不了」折进「dead」；在本处那样做会喂给 `sawDeadRuntimeStatus`，可能把聚合结果翻成 `'inactive'`，从而把一个其实活着的会话判死。其它 errno 仍然落到 `'unknown'`，`EACCES` 也照旧走那条路——只有这个已确认的误报被改掉。

## 为什么需要

#14288 报告的现象：一个 48 天前的 `[node] <defunct>` 僵尸进程，其仍然存活的父进程一直没回收它，而报告者的会话检测脚本把这个已死会话报成 **live**，因为 `runtime.json` 的活性说是 `'active'`。任何信任这个判定的下游——会话清扫、worktree 恢复决策、CLI 自己的启动路径——都会把一个死会话无限期留在活跃集合里。

未被回收这件事本身是 POSIX 固有行为（被挂起的父进程无法回收），不是本 PR 要改的。缺陷在于探测把结果判错了。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

Node 测试进程自己 spawn 的子进程造不出真僵尸：libuv 会通过 SIGCHLD 回收自己的子进程，所以一个退出后没被 wait 的子进程会先是 `R`，然后在几十毫秒内直接消失（`ENOENT`），而不是停在 `Z`。（一个从不 wait 的外部持有者进程确实能造出真僵尸——沙箱验证就用 Python holder 实测过——但这种形态无法在各 CI runner 间移植。）因此新测试从假的 `/proc/<pid>/stat` 供数据，手法与 `packages/core/src/utils/process-liveness.test.ts` 里的 `withFakeProc` 一致，并把 `process.platform` 强制为 `'linux'`，让这段解析在每个 CI runner 上都被执行，而不只是在 Linux 上。

在 `worktreeSessionService.test.ts` 的 `describe('isSessionRuntimeActive')` 里新增四个用例：

1. **僵尸 → inactive**——记录的 pid 就是 `process.pid`，所以 `kill(pid, 0)` 是真的成功，假 `/proc` 行给 `Z`。断言 `getSessionRuntimeLiveness === 'inactive'`、`isSessionRuntimeActive === false`。在未修复的 main 上以 `expected 'active' to be 'inactive'` 失败。
2. **存活 → active**——同一套装置，第 3 字段给 `S`。这一条守住装置本身：它不是恒真通过。
3. **跨用户僵尸 → inactive**——把 `process.kill` spy 成抛 `EPERM`，同时假 `/proc` 给 `Z`，覆盖第二条有缺陷的路径。
4. **意外 errno → unknown**——`process.kill` 抛 `EIO`；断言得到 `'unknown'` 而不是 `'dead'`。这是三态守卫：把 `unknown` 塌成 `dead` 正是会把活会话判死的方向。

既有的 `'treats EPERM from the local pid probe as active'` 用例没有改动，仍然通过——非僵尸的 `EPERM` 答案保持不变。

本地在未修复基线（`1989a7b7`）上，两个僵尸用例失败：

```
 FAIL  src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts > isSessionRuntimeActive > reports a defunct (zombie) pid as inactive instead of active
AssertionError: expected 'active' to be 'inactive' // Object.is equality
 FAIL  src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts > isSessionRuntimeActive > reports a defunct pid owned by another user as inactive
AssertionError: expected 'active' to be 'inactive' // Object.is equality
 Tests  2 failed | 49 passed (51)
```

修复后：

```
 ✓ src/utils/process-liveness.test.ts (30 tests) 86ms
 ✓ src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts (51 tests) 298ms
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  81 passed (81)
```

### 证据（前后对照）

非用户可见改动（core 活性探测）：Before/After 截图 N/A，见上面的测试输出。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

`isZombie` 在非 Linux 上按设计返回 `false`，所以 macOS/Windows 的行为与今天完全一致——本改动只影响 Linux，与报告及 `/proc` 解析所针对的平台一致。

### 环境

只跑单元测试：在 `packages/core` 下执行 `node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/services/worktreeSessionService.test.ts src/utils/process-liveness.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false`。另外对三个改动文件跑了 `tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json`、eslint 与 `prettier --check`，退出码均为 0。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：Linux 上每次 runtime-status 探测多一次 `/proc/<pid>/stat` 读取——每次 `getSessionRuntimeLiveness` 调用是两次读取，因为枚举会先探测直接 runtime-status 路径、再扫 `projects/`（既有的双重探测；沙箱验证实测调用级开销约 +7 µs/次，基线约 66 µs）。`isZombie` 在 `/proc` 不可读时（如 `hidepid`）退化为「不是僵尸」，所以那种情况下最差就是今天的行为，不会引入新行为。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：被挂起的父进程无法回收子进程是 POSIX 固有行为，刻意不动。不加 doctor/status 命令，不加 sidecar 清理，不做回收。`EACCES` 处理保持不变，仍落到 `'unknown'`。调用点（`worktreeSessionService.ts` 的枚举路径）与外部消费者（`worktreeStartup.ts`、`AppContainer.tsx`、`exit-worktree.ts`）均未修改——它们通过既有的 `RuntimeStatusState` 类型继承修正后的判定。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`isZombie` 只是多了 `export`，签名与类型都没变。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14288

</details>

prs.title: fix(daemon): preserve active work when deleting scheduled tasks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Deleting a scheduled task now removes the schedule immediately but closes its task-owned session only through the existing active-work safety boundary. The session is retained when the daemon has admitted work, a restore is in progress, negotiated hold coverage is incomplete, the owner is unavailable, or the owning child reports a hold. Existing automatic cleanup reclaims the unattached session after its work clears.

Explicit user close, kill, shutdown, and same-request rollback keep their current force semantics. The HTTP response and persisted schemas do not change.

## Why it's needed

Before this change, deleting a scheduled task force-closed its bound session. A task that had started a background agent, shell, workflow, notification turn, or queued prompt could be aborted silently through session disposal.

After this change, task deletion revokes future scheduling and delivery while already-admitted work is allowed to finish.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create a task-owned scheduled-task session and start work that holds the session.
2. Delete the task and confirm the task is gone while the session remains live and no cancellation is sent.
3. Clear the hold and confirm the existing automatic cleanup closes the unattached session.
4. Confirm an idle session still closes and explicit close/kill paths remain forceful.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Controlled behavior evidence is included in a separate PR comment. The test harness reproduces the old unconditional close and verifies task deletion, child hold retention, daemon-owned work retention, incomplete capability retention, condemned-owner retention, and cleanup after holds clear.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Controlled in-process HTTP and ACP harness on Darwin arm64. Repository build, typecheck, focused and full bridge tests, lint, formatting, and diff checks passed locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a retained session can temporarily keep the deleted task's name until active work clears and the existing cleanup path removes it.
- Not validated / out of scope: no provider-backed long-running agent was exercised through a real `qwen serve` process; restoring paused background agents is tracked separately in #14273.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-14266-preserve-background/docs/design/2026-10-15-scheduled-task-safe-delete.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-14266-preserve-background/docs/design/2026-10-15-scheduled-task-safe-delete.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14266

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

删除定时任务时，调度定义仍会立即移除，但任务自有会话只会通过现有的活动工作安全边界关闭。如果守护进程已经接纳工作、会话正在恢复、已协商的持有类别覆盖不完整、持有方不可用，或持有会话的子进程报告仍有工作，会话都会保留。工作结束后，现有自动清理路径会回收这个未附着会话。

用户显式关闭、kill、shutdown 和同请求回滚继续保持强制语义。HTTP 响应和持久化 schema 均不变化。

## 为什么需要

修改前，删除定时任务会强制关闭绑定会话。任务已经启动的后台 agent、shell、workflow、通知轮次或排队 prompt 可能在会话销毁时被静默中止。

修改后，任务删除会撤销后续调度和投递，但已经接纳的工作可以继续完成。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 验证方式

1. 创建任务自有的定时任务会话，并启动会持有会话的工作。
2. 删除任务，确认任务已经移除，同时会话仍然存活且没有发送取消。
3. 清除持有，确认现有自动清理会关闭未附着会话。
4. 确认空闲会话仍会关闭，显式 close/kill 路径继续保持强制语义。

### 前后证据

受控行为证据会通过单独的 PR 评论提供。测试 harness 复现了原来的无条件关闭，并验证任务删除、子进程 hold 保留、守护进程已接纳工作保留、能力覆盖不完整保留、持有方不可用保留，以及持有清除后的自动回收。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境

Darwin arm64 上的受控进程内 HTTP 与 ACP harness。仓库 build、typecheck、聚焦测试、完整 bridge 测试、lint、格式和 diff 检查均已在本地通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：活动工作清除并由现有清理路径回收前，保留会话会暂时沿用已删除任务的名称。
- 未验证或范围外：没有通过真实 `qwen serve` 进程运行带 provider 的长时后台 agent；后台 agent 恢复后停在 paused 状态的问题由 #14273 单独跟踪。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-14266-preserve-background/docs/design/2026-10-15-scheduled-task-safe-delete.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-14266-preserve-background/docs/design/2026-10-15-scheduled-task-safe-delete.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14266

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): respect enableLoadingPhrases and customWittyPhrases in browser shell (#14324)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR enables Web Shell to properly read and honor `ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases` and `ui.customWittyPhrases` from workspace settings:
- Allows `ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases` in Web Shell daemon settings by removing it from the `TUI_ONLY_SETTINGS` filter.
- Whitelists `ui.customWittyPhrases` in `WEB_SHELL_SETTINGS` so custom loading phrases can be provided to Web Shell clients.
- Connects `enableLoadingPhrases` directly to `<StreamingStatus showPhrase={enableLoadingPhrases} />` so witty phrases and phrase-rotation timers are cleanly disabled when configured off.
- Merges `configuredCustomWittyPhrases` into `effectiveChatCustomization.loadingPhrases` so custom phrases are displayed during streaming when no explicit embedder override is provided.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14324 reported that configuring `"ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases": false` or custom witty phrases in workspace settings had no effect in the browser-based Web Shell. Web Shell continued to display rotating witty phrases and arm 15-second interval timers regardless of user settings. This ensures full parity between the TUI and Web Shell accessibility and customization settings.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run unit test in `packages/cli`:
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @qwen-code/cli test packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts
   ```
   Confirm `getAllowedKeys()` returns `ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases` and `ui.customWittyPhrases`.
2. Run test in `packages/web-shell`:
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell test client/components/StreamingStatus.test.tsx
   ```
   Confirm all streaming status behaviors and phrase rendering tests pass.
3. Configure settings with `"ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases": false`:
   Observe that Web Shell streaming status hides the witty phrase and suppresses the 15-second rotation timer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

prs.title: fix(core): end post-compact history on a model turn after /compress
prs.body:
## What this PR does

After compression, the post-compact attachments (file restoration blocks, restored images, plan-mode reminder, running-subagent snapshot) are now folded into the summary's own user entry instead of being sent as a separate user entry after the ack. The composed history therefore always ends on a model entry: `[user(summary + attachments?), model(ack)]`, or `[user(summary + attachments?), model(ack + trailing turn)]` when a trailing function call is preserved. In that second shape the ack text stays `parts[0]`, followed by the trailing model turn's `functionCall` parts (original ids kept) and its plain, non-thought text parts in their original order; thought parts are not carried over. The degraded fallback in `chatCompressionService.ts` (used when restoration assembly throws) keeps the same parts. Rewind indexing still recognizes the older 3–4 entry compressed prefix that sessions saved by earlier builds carry.

Because the attachments no longer sit in separate entries, the post-compact token accounting in `chatCompressionService.ts` now measures them where they are: on the usage-reported path, `newTokenCount` adds the local estimate of every part of the summary entry after the summary text, plus any entries after the ack. Previously it summed `extraHistory.slice(2)`, which is always empty with the 2-entry output, so restored files/images were not counted and the inflation guard could not fire for them. The usage-missing path already estimated the whole composed history and is unchanged.

The `composePostCompactHistory` JSDoc is rewritten for the new output shape and now sits on the function.

## Why it's needed

Manual `/compress` strips the trailing model function call before composing, so whenever there was anything to restore the snapshot ended `[user(summary), model(ack), user(attachments)]`. `detectTurnInterruption` reads that trailing user entry as `interrupted_prompt`, so the idle session showed the "previous request was interrupted" banner after every `/compress`, and "Continue execution" re-sent the attachment tail as a new prompt. The same snapshot is installed as live history and recorded as the `chat_compression` record, so both the live and the resume classification paths were affected. This follows the approach doudouOUC recommended in the issue: fold the attachments into the summary entry so the tail is a model entry, which also avoids two consecutive user entries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From the repo root:

```
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/services/postCompactAttachments.test.ts src/services/chatCompressionService.test.ts src/core/environmentContext.test.ts src/services/session-api-history.test.ts src/core/turn-interruption.test.ts
```

i.e. `packages/core/src/services/postCompactAttachments.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/services/chatCompressionService.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/core/environmentContext.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/services/session-api-history.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/core/turn-interruption.test.ts`.

- `post-/compress history is not classified as interrupted (#14325)` (in `postCompactAttachments.test.ts`) composes a manual-`/compress`-shaped history with a restorable file and asserts `detectTurnInterruption` returns `none`, both directly (live path) and after rebuilding it from a recorded `chat_compression` record via `buildSessionHistoryFromConversation` (resume path). It also asserts `getStartupContextLength(composed, { includeCompressed: true }) === 2` with plan mode on, with and without a folded trailing function call.
- `ChatCompressionService.compress — folded post-compact shape (#14325)` (in `chatCompressionService.test.ts`) runs the real `compress` on the usage-reported path with a restorable file inside the workspace: `newTokenCount` equals the summary-only figure plus `ceil(restorationChars / CHARS_PER_TOKEN)`, and when that pushes the total past `originalTokenCount` the result is `COMPRESSION_FAILED_INFLATED_TOKEN_COUNT` with `newHistory === null`. A second case pins that an auto compaction with no pending tool result keeps the trailing `model[text + functionCall]` turn's text in the ack while the side-query does not see it.
- Composer-shape tests pin the ack text at `parts[0]` of the model entry and the trailing text/functionCall order.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so no screenshots.

- With `postCompactAttachments.ts` reverted to `main` (c24e99e9cb), the classification tests get `interrupted_prompt` instead of `none`, and the composed-shape test gets 3 entries instead of 2.
- With the restoration estimate put back to `extraHistory.slice(2)`, both new token-accounting tests fail (the inflated case comes back `COMPRESSED`).
- With the trailing turn reduced to its `functionCall` parts only, the two trailing-text tests fail.
- With the ack built as `[...trailing parts, ack]`, the positional ack test and the `getStartupContextLength` test fail.
- On this branch the 5 suites above pass (399 tests); `llm-chat.test.ts` and `sessionService.test.ts` also pass (833 tests).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests only)   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A, unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: When a trailing function call is preserved, the ack entry now also carries that turn's plain text parts (thought parts are dropped). With a pending tool result the summary already saw that turn, so its text can appear in both the summary and the ack; this is a small duplication rather than a loss. Without a pending tool result (auto compaction after a restored `ask_user_question` or an aborted call), the side-query excludes that turn; on `main` without attachments, and in the earlier revision of this PR in all cases, its text ended up in neither the summary nor the composed history.
- Token accounting now also counts the plan-mode reminder and subagent snapshot parts in the summary entry, including on the degraded fallback path, so `newTokenCount` can be slightly higher than before for those sessions.
- Not validated / out of scope: No manual run in the CLI or Web Shell; macOS and Windows not run locally. The classifier and recovery code are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Sessions recorded by older builds still carry the `[user(summary), model(ack), user(attachments), model(fc)?]` prefix, and rewind's compressed-prefix detection still recognizes it.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14325

`composePostCompactHistory` 的 JSDoc 已按新的输出形状重写，并移到该函数上。

- 组合形状测试固定 ack 文本位于 model 条目的 `parts[0]`，以及末尾文字/functionCall 的顺序。

非 UI 改动，无截图。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): project channel deliveries as tasks and serve their cancel (#13746 F3)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A channel delivery now projects as a task of its route Session (kind `channel_delivery`), so the one public task cancel path serves it, with no new route, operation type or failure code. The task is `pending` while the delivery is planned, `running` while an adapter sends it, `waiting` while its outcome is unknown, and `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled` at its end; it has no runtime state. Cancel is advertised, and a new cancel admitted, only while the delivery is `pending`, that is, before any adapter has claimed it.

The delivery arm sends the existing Hosted `cancel_delivery` verb through the route Session's channel operation route. The operation's outcome is read from the delivery's committed record, where the `cancelRequested` flag is the stop request: a planned delivery settles `cancelled` with it and is never sent; one an adapter claimed between the admission and the send keeps sending to its natural outcome with the flag recorded, as a completion that wins keeps its outcome under the task contract; one that ended without the flag fails the operation with `task_already_settled`. Deliveries planned before this change keep projecting no task: a row's kind is fixed at its insert, and every later revision follows the kind the row stores, so such a row writes no task state and journals no task event.

The projection change lands in both languages and the shared projection fixtures. The contract moves to 1.56.0 (provisional; main is at 1.54.0 since #14412, and the sibling #14413 takes 1.55.0), adding `channel_delivery` to `TaskKind`. It builds on #14412 (H4f-c, background Shell and Monitor cancel, now on main), whose cancellable-kind rule and delivery switch it extends.

## Why it's needed

A channel reply waits in the outbox as a planned delivery until the adapter pulls it — possibly for a long time if the adapter is offline — and a caller who sees it should not go out had no way to stop it: the public channel routes are read-only, they cannot even see a delivery before it is claimed, and the Hosted cancel verb had no caller outside the fault gates. #13746 F3 asks that one cancellation path serve both a child task and a channel delivery without either growing its own vocabulary; making the delivery a task meets that literally.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Admit a channel input whose reply is planned but not yet pulled by the adapter. List the route Session's tasks: the reply is a `channel_delivery` task, `pending`, advertising `cancel`.
- Cancel it through the public task cancel route with an Idempotency-Key: expect `202`, then the operation `completed` (and its key replaying), the task `cancelled`, and a later adapter pull sending nothing.
- Let the adapter claim another reply first: its task reads `running` with no action, a cancel answers `409 task_action_unavailable`, and the reply is delivered once.
- The FG7d letter covers both on the real stack: `mvn -Phosted-channel-gates failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dit.test=HostedChannelFaultGatesIT#fg7dChannelCancellationsSettlePhysicallyOnMySql` with the usual MySQL and packaged-CLI properties.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: a planned reply is invisible on the public surface (`404 delivery_not_found` until claimed) and cannot be cancelled by any public route.
- After, real stack (MySQL 8.4.6, packaged Harness, the email reference adapter): FG7d's new `task-cancel-planned` and `task-cancel-claimed` cases pass beside its four internal-verb cases; the cancelled reply's outbox pull sends nothing and the delivery ledger stays empty; the claimed one is refused with `409` and delivered once. The whole FG7 class (5 letters) and the channel crash IT pass, re-run on the head rebased onto `b4614845f0`.
- Unit, store and contract suites in both languages: the shared projection fixtures, both channel record contract tests, the TS authority's delivery chain and reopen, the real-record delivery task test, admission (pending only), and delivery (the channel route, the claimed race, a delivered one) — Java suites 0 failures; `packages/core` managed-runtime (3,453 tests after the merge) and the cli channel suites (14 files, 510 tests) pass; core, cli and web-shell typecheck; eslint and prettier are clean on the changed files. A legacy row stored without a kind stays a non-task on its next revision (mutation-checked).
- The full MariaDB lane (JDK 21, `-Pmysql-integration clean verify`) on the combined tree of this PR and its sibling #13746 PRs, rebased onto main `b4614845f0`: 4,357 unit tests, 0 failures; 731 integration tests with one error, `ManagedAgentMySqlIT#admitsHookExecutionsWithoutReadingTheirHistoryOnMySql` ("writer grant is stale"), an environment failure of that host that fails the same way on main; SpotBugs 0.
- After merging main `7834280810` (#14358, #14411) through #14412's branch, and again after #14412 merged (main `0f1c32320f`; the merge result is this PR plus #14391 exactly): compile, the touched suites plus `HarnessCoordinatorTest` and `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` (268 tests, then 305 with the H4f-c suites; 0 failures) and Checkstyle pass again; the real-stack gates and the lane above ran on `b4614845f0`, and the merge brings no change to their paths.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, JDK 25 for unit tests, MySQL 8.4.6 in Docker, the packaged `dist/cli.js`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every reply of a channel Session is now one task of it, and every delivery revision one task event; the journal's bounds and retention floor apply unchanged. The claim race is visible: a cancel admitted while pending can complete while the reply still goes out, if the adapter claimed it first — the operation's `completed` is the recorded request, the task's `completed` the physical outcome.
- Not validated / out of scope: a public resend; stopping the remaining segments of a `partial` delivery (no adapter produces one today); listing deliveries in the WebShell panel; providers beyond the email fixture.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `TaskKind` gains a value, so a strict client enum must tolerate it (the contract already says clients tolerate unknown values across minors). Deliveries planned before the upgrade never become tasks. Rollback floor: a server older than this change would keep listing delivery tasks inserted meanwhile with a null state and an unknown kind, so roll back below it only after those Sessions are closed. Renumber the contract at merge if another PR takes 1.56.0 first.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-17-managed-delivery-task-cancel.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-17-managed-delivery-task-cancel.zh-CN.md). It replaces decision 10 of the H4f note; the H4f, H4f-c and workflow-cancel follow-up rows point at it.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13746 (F3). Stage H of #12380 under #12827. Built on #14412 (merged); retargeted to `main` after it landed, with main merged in — the diff against main is unchanged.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

channel 投递现在投影为其路由 Session 的一个任务（kind `channel_delivery`），于是唯一的公开任务取消路径就能服务它，不需要新路由、新操作类型或新失败码。投递 planned 时任务为 `pending`，适配器发送时为 `running`，结果未知时为 `waiting`，结束时为 `completed`、`failed` 或 `cancelled`；它没有 runtime state。只有当投递为 `pending`——也就是任何适配器认领它之前——才公布取消并准入新的取消。

投递分支经路由 Session 的 channel operation 路由发送已有的 Hosted `cancel_delivery` 动词。操作结果从投递已提交的记录读取，其中 `cancelRequested` 标志就是停止请求：planned 投递连同该标志结算为 `cancelled`，永远不会被发送；在准入与发送之间被适配器认领的投递带着已记录的标志继续发送到其自然结果——正如任务契约中先完成者保留其结果；没有该标志就已结束的投递使操作以 `task_already_settled` 失败。本变更之前已 planned 的投递继续不投影任务：行的 kind 在插入时确定，之后每次修订都遵循该行存储的 kind，所以这样的行不写任务状态、不记任务事件。

投影改动在两种语言与共享投影 fixtures 中同步落地。契约升到 1.56.0（暂定；#14412 合入后 main 为 1.54.0，兄弟 PR #14413 占用 1.55.0），在 `TaskKind` 中增加 `channel_delivery`。本变更建立在 #14412（H4f-c，后台 Shell 与 Monitor 取消，已合入 main）之上，扩展其可取消类型规则与投递分支。

## 为什么需要

channel 回复在适配器拉取之前以 planned 投递的形式留在 outbox 中——如果适配器离线，可能留很久——而看到它、认为它不该发出的调用者此前无法阻止它：公开 channel 路由只读，在投递被认领前甚至看不到它，Hosted 的取消动词除故障门禁外也没有调用方。#13746 F3 要求一条取消路径同时服务 child 任务与 channel 投递，两者都不另长词汇；把投递变成任务字面满足这一点。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 准入一个 channel 输入，其回复已 planned 但尚未被适配器拉取。列出路由 Session 的任务：该回复是一个 `channel_delivery` 任务，状态 `pending`，公布 `cancel`。
- 带 Idempotency-Key 经公开任务取消路由取消它：应得到 `202`，随后操作 `completed`（其 key 可重放）、任务 `cancelled`，之后适配器的拉取什么也不发送。
- 让适配器先认领另一条回复：其任务读为无动作的 `running`，取消回 `409 task_action_unavailable`，回复只投递一次。
- FG7d 字母在真实栈上覆盖两者：`mvn -Phosted-channel-gates failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify -Dit.test=HostedChannelFaultGatesIT#fg7dChannelCancellationsSettlePhysicallyOnMySql`，配上常规的 MySQL 与打包 CLI 属性。

### 证据（前后对比）

- 之前：planned 回复在公开面上不可见（被认领前回 `404 delivery_not_found`），也没有任何公开路由能取消它。
- 之后，真实栈（MySQL 8.4.6，打包的 Harness，email 参考适配器）：FG7d 新增的 `task-cancel-planned` 与 `task-cancel-claimed` 用例与其四个内部动词用例一起通过；被取消回复的 outbox 拉取什么也不发送，投递台账保持为空；已认领的那条被 `409` 拒绝并只投递一次。整个 FG7 类（5 个字母）与 channel 崩溃 IT 均通过，已在 rebase 到 `b4614845f0` 后的 head 上重跑。
- 两种语言的单元、store 与契约套件：共享投影 fixtures、两种语言的 channel 记录契约测试、TS authority 的投递链及其重开、真实记录的投递任务测试、准入（仅 pending）以及投递（channel 路由、认领竞争、已投递）——Java 套件 0 失败；`packages/core` managed-runtime（合入后 3,453 个测试）与 cli channel 套件（14 个文件、510 个测试）通过；core、cli 与 web-shell 类型检查通过；改动文件的 eslint 与 prettier 干净。以无 kind 方式存储的旧行在下一次修订时仍是非任务（经变异检验）。
- 在本 PR 与 #13746 其他兄弟 PR 的组合树（rebase 到 main `b4614845f0`）上跑完整 MariaDB 车道（JDK 21，`-Pmysql-integration clean verify`）：4,357 个单元测试 0 失败；731 个集成测试中 1 个错误，即 `ManagedAgentMySqlIT#admitsHookExecutionsWithoutReadingTheirHistoryOnMySql`（"writer grant is stale"）——这是该主机的环境性失败，在 main 上同样失败；SpotBugs 0。
- 经 #14412 的分支合入 main `7834280810`（#14358、#14411）之后，以及 #14412 合入后再次合入 main `0f1c32320f`（合并结果恰好等于本 PR 加 #14391）之后：编译、所涉套件加 `HarnessCoordinatorTest` 与 `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest`（268 个测试，之后加上 H4f-c 套件共 305 个；0 失败）以及 Checkstyle 再次通过；上面的真实栈门禁与车道跑在 `b4614845f0` 上，此次合入没有改动它们经过的路径。

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux x86_64，单测用 JDK 25，Docker 中的 MySQL 8.4.6，打包的 `dist/cli.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：channel Session 的每条回复现在都是它的一个任务，每次投递修订都是一条任务事件；日志的上限与保留下限照常适用。认领竞争可见：pending 时被准入的取消，在适配器先认领的情况下可能完成而回复仍然发出——操作的 `completed` 是已记录的请求，任务的 `completed` 是物理结果。
- 未验证 / 范围外：公开重发；停止 `partial` 投递的剩余分段（目前没有适配器会产生它）；在 WebShell 面板中列出投递；email fixture 之外的提供方。

属于 #13746（F3）。#12380 的阶段 H，在 #12827 下跟踪。建立在 #14412（已合入）之上；它合入后本 PR 已改指 `main` 并合入 main，相对 main 的 diff 不变。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): open inline rename on single click of a session title
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In the Web Shell sidebar, clicking anywhere on a session row opens that session, while renaming a session was only reachable through a double-click on the row. This change makes the session name itself a separate click target: a single click on the session title now opens the same inline rename form the row double-click uses — the input is prefilled with the current name, Enter saves the new name, and Escape or blur cancels. A single click on the rest of the row (status, time, menu, empty area) still opens the session, and double-click behavior and keyboard handling are unchanged. When a session cannot be renamed (no rename permission or the `workspace_session_metadata` capability is absent), the title click falls through to the regular open behavior, so rows that previously opened on click keep doing so.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14327 reports that a single click on the session name opens the session instead of letting the user rename it; the double-click rename affordance is hard to discover. Making the title a direct entry point to the existing inline rename form matches user expectations (the name is what you want to change) while keeping the rest of the row's behavior intact.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

I added a component test file `packages/web-shell/client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.session-rename.test.tsx` (11 cases) covering: single-click on the title label opens the prefilled rename form without opening the session; form submit saves the new name via `updateSessionMetadata` and closes the form; Escape cancels without saving or opening; double-click on the title still opens rename; double-click on the row outside the title still opens rename; single-click on the row outside the title opens the session; Enter with the row focused opens the session; a session without rename capability falls through to open on title click; single-click on the title container's blank area opens the session; single-click on the content-search snippet opens the session; and a click that finishes a text selection opens the session without renaming.

- Run the new tests: from the repo root, `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/sidebar/WebShellSidebar.session-rename.test.tsx` — all 11 tests pass.
- Manual check: start a daemon with the Web Shell (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve --workspace <dir>`), open the Web Shell, and in the sidebar: (1) single-click a session title → the inline rename form appears prefilled with the current name; (2) type a new name and press Enter → the sidebar shows the new name; (3) single-click elsewhere on the row → the session opens; (4) double-click the row → the rename form opens; (5) Escape in the form cancels it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (upstream behavior): a single click on the session title opened the session; renaming required a double-click on the row (see issue #14327).

After: a single click on the title opens the inline rename form, prefilled with the current name (screenshot below; the session was renamed via this form in the same run).

![Single click on the session title opens the inline rename form](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4ekuct25/qwen-code/15a1124fd569ab2536c314b45929fb63091bef3c/assets/session-rename-20261016/rename-form-single-click.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

- macOS: local daemon built from this branch plus the real user Chrome (via CDP) — single click on the title opened the rename form prefilled with the current name; submitting renamed the session in the sidebar ("Renamed via E2E"); single click on the rest of the row opened the session (`aria-current="page"`); double-click on the row opened the rename form; Escape cancelled it; Enter with the row focused kept the session open. 6/6 scripted steps passed.
- Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm` container on head `2f240d710e` — all 11 tests in `WebShellSidebar.session-rename.test.tsx` pass, the full web-shell client suite passes (12094 tests, 449 files), `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` (packages/web-shell) reports 0 errors, eslint reports 0 issues, prettier is clean on the changed files.
- Windows: UTM Win11 ARM (WinOnArm x64 emulation) — the 8 new component tests pass (`vitest run` → `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`), and `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` in packages/web-shell reports 0 errors.

### Environment

- macOS E2E: daemon `node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve --port 8137 --workspace /tmp/e2e-ws-14327` (built from this branch in a `node:22-bookworm` container), driven in the user's real Chrome over CDP.
- Linux: `node:22-bookworm` container with the full repo (pnpm `--frozen-lockfile` install).
- Windows: UTM Win11 ARM VM, WinOnArm x64 emulation (×2–4 slower), node v22.23.3, pnpm 11.24.0, source from the fork codeload archive, 4 GB RAM; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and both check commands ran to completion.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a single click on the title now opens rename instead of opening the session — this is the intended behavior change requested in #14327. When rename is unavailable the click falls through to open, preserving the old behavior for those rows.
- Not validated / out of scope: archived rows and the Session Overview table are intentionally untouched; all other sidebar surfaces (flat list, channel/group views, pinned, standalone recents) share the same row renderer, so the title click applies there too — I verified the shared renderer path but did not exercise every surface individually. The TUI and other packages are unaffected.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No API, config, or data changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14327

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): log the check behind a refused internal request
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Managed Agent control plane sometimes refuses a request on an internal route (`/internal/…`) because the request is invalid. Only the control plane's own components call these routes: the Hosted Harness, Runtime workers and channel adapters. When it refuses one, it now logs one WARN line that names the route and the check that refused, without quoting the request. Three handlers are involved:
- the one for an `IllegalArgumentException` raised while serving a request ("The request is invalid.");
- the one for an unreadable or invalid body ("The request body is invalid.");
- the one for a header or parameter that did not bind ("A request parameter is missing or invalid.", or a message naming the parameter).

The line holds:
- the method, and the raw request URI, cut at 256 characters;
- the exception type;
- for a body that failed validation: up to five failing `field:constraint` entries, each with its count, most frequent first, for example `resources[].resourceId:NotBlank x500`. List indices and map keys are dropped, so repeats collapse into one entry, and the total error count follows;
- for an `IllegalArgumentException`: its first six application frames (class, method and line). These run from the helper that threw, often a shared `require`, up to the check that called it;
- for a header or parameter that did not bind: the name the controller declares for it, for example `MissingRequestHeaderException for X-Qwen-Managed-Writer-Token`.

It never holds an exception message, a cause, a stack trace or a field value, because those can quote body content. Whether a route is internal is decided by `PublicSurface.internal(request)`, the same predicate the routing filter uses to keep internal routes on their own listener, so the log and the router cannot disagree. Public routes are unchanged: their 400 answers stay out of the log, and no status or response body changes on any route.

## Why it's needed

#14361: `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` failed in about 13% of its cases in `SDK Java` runs from 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-16. In every failing case the Harness log shows `Hosted Harness turn … is recovery blocked: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`, and nothing else names the cause. The control plane answered with the generic 400 and kept no record of which route or check refused it, so none of the 23 failing cases could be diagnosed from their artifacts. With this change, the next occurrence names the route and the check in the Spring log that the fault-gate job already uploads (`l4-shell-lifecycle/<case>/spring-*.log`).

An internal route's caller is one of the control plane's own components, so a 400 there points to a protocol fault and is worth a line. These routes still carry content that must stay out of the log: forwarded end-user messages on the channel inbound route, and transcripts and tool output on the Store routes. Their body checks also run before the writer credential is checked. That is why the line keeps no content and is bounded in size.

The issue also suggested keeping the Harness daemon log. That turned out not to be needed: it repeats the `[DAEMON]` lines that `harness.log` already holds, apart from one start-up line.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Dtest='ApiExceptionHandlerTest,InternalSurfaceConfigurationTest' test checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle` passes 15 + 6 tests, and both Checkstyle executions report no violations. The seven new cases are:
- `logsWhereAnInternalRefusalCameFromWithoutQuotingTheRequest`. It refuses three internal requests: an `IllegalArgumentException` whose message holds a secret, an unreadable body whose parse error quotes it, and a validation failure whose rejected values, map key and global error carry it. It expects three single-line WARNs with no throwable, no trace of the secret, and the exact normalized field list. The field errors carry the code array a real validation run resolves, whose most specific code holds the client's map key.
- `boundsTheLineWhateverTheRequestHolds`. 1,007 validation errors log five entries and the count, and the entry behind 1,000 of them comes first although its name sorts last. A 6,060-character URI is cut at 256 characters, and the line stays under 1,000 characters.
- `marksATruncationOnlyPastItsBound`. Five distinct entries log whole and six get the `, …` marker; a 256-character URI logs whole and a 257-character one is cut.
- `namesTheFramesFromTheThrowingHelperUpToItsCaller`. On a synthetic stack, JDK and Spring frames are skipped, exactly six application frames are kept, and a stack with none says so.
- `classifiesTheRoutedPathButLogsTheRawOne`. Public routes stay silent, including one whose path merely contains `/internal/` and `/internals/…`. Encoded (`/%69nternal/…`) and matrix (`/internal;x=1/…`) spellings, which reach internal handlers, are logged raw, so a `%0A` stays encoded.
- `logsAnInternalBindingFailureByItsParameterNotItsValue`. A missing header, a type mismatch, a missing request parameter and another binding failure on an internal route each log the type and the declared name (the last, the type alone), never the secret value or message; the same failure on a public route stays silent.
- `logsExactlyTheRoutesTheRouterKeepsInternal`. Seven spellings go through the real `RoutingFilter` on the internal listener and through the handler; the routes the listener serves and the routes that get a line are the same three.

Mutation check: all 40 mutants are killed. The first 23:
- drop either log call;
- change the route classification (raw URI, URL-decoded, `contains`, no trailing slash, one prefix only);
- log the decoded or unbounded URI;
- add the exception message or attach the throwable;
- drop the frame filter or the frame limit, or cut the limit to 3;
- give unparsed bodies frames, or drop the "no application frame" text;
- keep indices, drop the dedupe, sort, cap or count, log the rejected value, or ignore global errors.

The 17 added with the review fixes:
- drop the binding-failure log call, any of its three parameter names, or log its message or value instead;
- let the handler's and the router's internal predicates drift apart in either direction, or define internal as "not public";
- order entries by name, reverse the tie-break, or drop the counts;
- move either bound by one in either direction;
- log the most specific code instead of the bare constraint.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: logging only. Before, an internal 400 left no trace in the Spring log. After, a refused publication grant logs a line like `Managed Agent refused an internal request: POST /internal/managed-tool-publications/v1/sessions/<id>/grants (ContractViolationException at ToolPublicationContract.require:<line> < ToolPublicationContract.id:<line> < ToolPublicationContract.token:<line> < ToolPublicationContract.request:<line> < …)`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, with Maven offline against a private repository. Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: anyone who can reach an internal route can cause these lines. Internal routes are served on the public connector when no separate internal port is set. Each line is bounded (a few hundred characters at most, whatever the request holds), so the volume is one short line per refused request. No internal caller treats a 400 from these routes as a routine answer or retries on it.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - This does not fix #14361. Its trigger was not reproduced: 120 local cases and 32 cases on a CI diagnostic run all passed. Every run after 2026-10-16 07:20Z has passed so far (44 cases), and no commit in that window explains why.
  - The embedded Runtime Broker serves its own `/internal/runtime-broker/…` routes outside Spring MVC, so its 400s are not covered.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Before commit, the change went through three audit rounds. Each round paired an undirected auditor (diff only) with an adversarial one, and both ran the tests, probes and mutants.
- **Round 1** found that logging the exception put request content in the log: rejected values and parse errors quoting the body, up to a 1.4 MB line for an oversized tool result. It also found a 12–22 KB stack trace per refusal, and a route check on the raw URI.
- **Round 2** found that the field list was still unbounded: 5,000 empty array elements gave a 676 KB line before the credential check. It also found that three frames could all be shared helpers, and four test gaps.
- **Round 3**, Critical only: no Critical. Both auditors ran the tests, SpotBugs, and live probes against the real controllers with a bad writer token. They raised four deferred notes. (a) A validated `Map` key containing `]` would leave part of the key on the line; no internal DTO has one today. (b) There is no rate limit: each refused internal request logs one line of about 0.5 KB, including a client that disconnects mid-upload. (c) The raw URI keeps matrix parameters such as `;jsessionid=…`, up to 256 characters, and keeping CR/LF out relies on Tomcat rejecting control characters in the request line. (d) The normalizing regex is compiled per error.

The automated review of `7a47682562` raised five suggestions. All five are addressed in `fb34eb74ce`:
- `invalidParameter` now logs too;
- the internal predicate is shared with the router;
- entries are ranked by frequency;
- the bounds are pinned on both sides;
- the fixture uses real code arrays.

That commit went through three more audit rounds:
- **Round 1** asked that a binding failure name its parameter, since two missing headers on one route logged the same line.
- **Round 2** corrected two comments and a test whose declared name equalled the Java parameter name. Its auditors drove the real internal controllers with 23 crafted binding failures (CR/LF, U+2028, 200,000-character values, encoded routes) and checked where Spring builds these exceptions: the names are always the declared ones.
- **Round 3**, Critical only: no Critical. Both auditors ran the tests and their own mutants (24 in all, every one killed). One sent raw HTTP to a real Tomcat; the other drove the real router through MockMvc and compared 28 responses before and after the change, byte for byte. Two notes are deferred. (e) The comment "never the value the client sent" is too broad: on a path-variable type mismatch, the bad value is already in the raw URI the line logs, at most 256 characters, as designed. (f) The pairing test checks only the internal listener, not the complement on the public one.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14361

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Managed Agent 控制面有时会在内部路由（`/internal/…`）上以"请求无效"拒绝请求。只有控制面自己的组件会调用这些路由：Hosted Harness、Runtime worker 和渠道适配器。现在拒绝时，它会记一条 WARN 日志，写明路由和拒绝它的检查，但不引用请求内容。涉及三个处理器：
- 处理请求时抛出 `IllegalArgumentException` 的那个（返回 "The request is invalid."）；
- 请求体无法读取或无效的那个（返回 "The request body is invalid."）；
- header 或参数绑定失败的那个（返回 "A request parameter is missing or invalid."，或写明参数名的消息）。

这一行包括：
- 方法，以及截断到 256 个字符的原始请求 URI；
- 异常类型；
- 请求体校验失败时：最多五个 `字段:约束` 项，每项带上出现次数，次数多的排在前面，例如 `resources[].resourceId:NotBlank x500`。列表下标和 map key 被去掉，重复项合并为一项，后面附上错误总数；
- `IllegalArgumentException` 时：它的前六个应用栈帧（类、方法和行号），从抛出的 helper（通常是共用的 `require`）一直到调用它的那项检查；
- header 或参数绑定失败时：controller 为它声明的名字，例如 `MissingRequestHeaderException for X-Qwen-Managed-Writer-Token`。

它从不包含异常消息、cause、堆栈或字段值，因为这些都可能引用请求体内容。路由是否属于内部，由 `PublicSurface.internal(request)` 判断；路由过滤器也用这同一个判断把内部路由留在自己的监听端口上，所以日志和路由器的判断不会不一致。公开路由的行为不变：它们的 400 仍然不记日志，所有路由的状态码和响应体都没有变化。

## 为什么需要

#14361：2026-10-14 到 2026-10-16 期间，`HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` 在 `SDK Java` 运行中约有 13% 的用例失败。每个失败用例的 Harness 日志里都有 `Hosted Harness turn … is recovery blocked: ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: The request is invalid.`，此外再没有任何信息能说明原因。控制面只返回了通用的 400，没有记录是哪条路由、哪项检查拒绝的，所以 23 个失败用例都无法从产物中诊断。有了这个改动，下次再出现时，fault-gate job 本来就会上传的 Spring 日志（`l4-shell-lifecycle/<case>/spring-*.log`）里会写明路由和检查。

内部路由的调用方是控制面自己的组件，所以那里的 400 意味着协议故障，值得留一行日志。但这些路由承载的内容仍然不能进日志：渠道入站路由上是转发来的终端用户消息，Store 的路由上是会话记录和工具输出。而且它们的请求体校验发生在 writer 凭证校验之前。所以这一行不含任何内容，大小也有上限。

issue 里还建议保存 Harness 的 daemon 日志。核实后发现不需要：除了一行启动日志，它和 `harness.log` 里已有的 `[DAEMON]` 行完全重复。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

`mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Dtest='ApiExceptionHandlerTest,InternalSurfaceConfigurationTest' test checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle` 通过 15 + 6 个测试，两套 Checkstyle 都没有违规。新增的七个用例是：
- `logsWhereAnInternalRefusalCameFromWithoutQuotingTheRequest`：拒绝三个内部请求，分别是消息里带有秘密值的 `IllegalArgumentException`、解析错误里引用了它的无法读取的请求体，以及被拒的值、map key 和类级错误里都带有它的校验失败。它要求三条单行 WARN，都不附带异常对象，都不含秘密值，并且字段列表按规范化后的结果逐字匹配。字段错误使用真实校验产生的 codes 数组，其中最具体的那个 code 带有客户端的 map key。
- `boundsTheLineWhateverTheRequestHolds`：1,007 个校验错误只记五项加总数，占了其中 1,000 个的那一项排在最前，尽管它的名字按字母序排在最后；6,060 字符的 URI 截断到 256 字符，整行不超过 1,000 字符。
- `marksATruncationOnlyPastItsBound`：五个不同的项完整记录，六个时加上 `, …` 标记；256 字符的 URI 完整记录，257 字符的被截断。
- `namesTheFramesFromTheThrowingHelperUpToItsCaller`：在人为构造的栈上，跳过 JDK 和 Spring 的栈帧，正好保留六个应用帧；没有应用帧的栈会如实说明。
- `classifiesTheRoutedPathButLogsTheRawOne`：公开路由不记日志，包括路径中间只是含有 `/internal/` 的路由和 `/internals/…`。会到达内部处理器的编码写法（`/%69nternal/…`）和 matrix 写法（`/internal;x=1/…`）按原始 URI 记录，所以 `%0A` 保持编码。
- `logsAnInternalBindingFailureByItsParameterNotItsValue`：内部路由上缺 header、类型不匹配、缺请求参数和其他绑定失败，分别记下类型和声明的名字（最后一种只记类型），从不记秘密值或消息；同样的失败发生在公开路由上则不记日志。
- `logsExactlyTheRoutesTheRouterKeepsInternal`：七种写法分别经过内部监听端口上的真实 `RoutingFilter` 和异常处理器；监听端口放行的路由与记日志的路由是同样的三条。

变异检查：40 个变异全部被抓住。最初的 23 个是：
- 去掉任一处日志调用；
- 改变路由分类（原始 URI、URL 解码、`contains`、去掉末尾斜杠、只认一个前缀）；
- 记录解码后的或不截断的 URI；
- 加上异常消息或附带异常对象；
- 去掉栈帧过滤或上限，或把上限减到 3；
- 让无法解析的请求体也带栈帧，或去掉 "no application frame" 文案；
- 保留下标，去掉去重、排序、上限或计数，记录被拒的值，或忽略类级错误。

随 review 修复新增的 17 个：
- 去掉绑定失败的日志调用，去掉三个参数名中的任一个，或改记它的消息或值；
- 让异常处理器和路由器的内部判断朝任一方向偏离，或把"内部"定义成"非公开"；
- 按名字排序、把次序键反过来，或去掉计数；
- 把任一边界向任一方向移动一位；
- 记录最具体的 code 而不是裸约束名。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用：只涉及日志。改动前，内部路由的 400 在 Spring 日志里不留任何痕迹。改动后，一次被拒的 publication grant 会记下类似 `Managed Agent refused an internal request: POST /internal/managed-tool-publications/v1/sessions/<id>/grants (ContractViolationException at ToolPublicationContract.require:<line> < ToolPublicationContract.id:<line> < ToolPublicationContract.token:<line> < ToolPublicationContract.request:<line> < …)` 的一行。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21，Maven 离线模式加私有仓库。只跑了单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：任何能访问内部路由的人都能触发这些日志行。没有单独配置内部端口时，内部路由就挂在公开端口上。每一行都有上限（无论请求里有什么，最多几百个字符），所以日志量是每个被拒请求一行短日志。没有任何内部调用方把这些路由返回的 400 当作常规应答，或在 400 时重试。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - 这个 PR 不修复 #14361。它的触发条件没能复现：本地 120 个用例、CI 诊断运行 32 个用例都通过了。2026-10-16 07:20Z 之后的每次运行目前都通过了（44 个用例），而这段时间内没有哪个提交能解释原因。
  - 内嵌的 Runtime Broker 在 Spring MVC 之外提供它自己的 `/internal/runtime-broker/…` 路由，所以它的 400 不在覆盖范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

提交前，这个改动经过了三轮审计。每轮都配一个无方向审计员（只看 diff）和一个对抗审计员，两人都实际跑了测试、探针和变异。
- **第 1 轮**发现：记录异常会把请求内容带进日志，包括被拒的值和引用请求体的解析错误，一个超大的工具结果能产生 1.4 MB 的一行。还发现每次拒绝会打出 12–22 KB 的堆栈，以及判断路由时用的是原始 URI。
- **第 2 轮**发现：字段列表仍然没有上限，5,000 个空数组元素在凭证校验之前就能产生 676 KB 的一行。还发现三个栈帧可能全是共用 helper，以及四处测试缺口。
- **第 3 轮**（只看 Critical）：没有 Critical。两位审计员都跑了测试和 SpotBugs，并用假的 writer token 对真实 controller 做了探针。他们提出四条延后项。(a) 如果带校验的 `Map` 的 key 含有 `]`，key 的一部分会留在日志里；目前没有任何内部 DTO 用到这种 Map。(b) 没有限流：每个被拒的内部请求记一行，约 0.5 KB，包括上传到一半断开的客户端。(c) 原始 URI 会保留 `;jsessionid=…` 之类的 matrix 参数，最多 256 个字符；日志里不出现 CR/LF，依赖 Tomcat 拒绝请求行中的控制字符。(d) 归一化用的正则每个错误都要重新编译一次。

对 `7a47682562` 的自动评审提出了五条建议，`fb34eb74ce` 全部处理：
- `invalidParameter` 也记日志；
- 内部判断与路由器共用；
- 字段项按出现次数排序；
- 边界两侧都有测试钉住；
- 测试 fixture 使用真实的 codes 数组。

这个提交又经过了三轮审计：
- **第 1 轮**要求绑定失败写出参数名，因为同一路由上缺两个不同的 header 会记成同一行。
- **第 2 轮**修正了两处注释，以及一个声明名与 Java 参数名相同的测试。审计员用 23 种构造的绑定失败（CR/LF、U+2028、20 万字符的值、编码后的路由）驱动真实的内部 controller，并核对了 Spring 构造这些异常的位置：名字始终是声明的名字。
- **第 3 轮**（只看 Critical）：没有 Critical。两位审计员都跑了测试和自己的变异（共 24 个，全部被抓住）；其中一位用真实 Tomcat 发送原始 HTTP 请求，另一位用 MockMvc 驱动真实路由器，并对比改动前后 28 个响应，逐字相同。延后两条备注：(e) "never the value the client sent" 这句注释说得过宽：路径变量类型不匹配时，错误的值本来就在原样记录的 URI 里（最多 256 字符，与原有设计一致）；(f) 配对测试只检查内部监听端口这一侧，没有检查公开端口上的补集。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14361

</details>

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): stop saying no lifecycle operation sets failure_code
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes one sentence in section 4.1 of the durable lifecycle design, in both the English and the Chinese copy. Section 4.1 records the v1.18 contract and says `failure_code` stays `planned` because no lifecycle operation sets it. The sentence now says that this held at v1.18. It adds that v1.25 implemented the field with the permission Action responses (D6b), and that a lifecycle operation now sets it once its retry budget is spent or while it is `recovery_blocked`, pointing at 4.5 and 4.6.

## Why it's needed

As written, 4.1 contradicts 4.6 in the same document. The 4.6 table and the paragraph after it say a budget-terminated operation reads `failed` with its `failure_code`, and that a `recovery_blocked` close carries the refusal's code. The contract agrees with 4.6: `PublicCommandOperation.failure_code` carries no `planned` marker and enumerates the lifecycle codes (v1.49, v1.53). The round-14 review of #13219 raised this contradiction. #14358 listed it among the items it left out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read 4.1 next to 4.6 in [the English design](docs/design/2026-09-28-managed-agent-durable-lifecycle.md) and [the Chinese design](docs/design/2026-09-28-managed-agent-durable-lifecycle.zh-CN.md). They should no longer disagree. The v1.25 claim can be checked against #13101 (D6b), which dropped the `planned` marker from `failure_code` in the contract. `npx prettier --check` passes on both files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (docs only).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none. The change is wording only; no code, contract or schema changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other 13 items #14358 left out (tests, `HarnessCoordinator.fail()` and `HostedHarnessClient`) are tracked separately.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents touched: [durable lifecycle (EN)](docs/design/2026-09-28-managed-agent-durable-lifecycle.md) / [(zh-CN)](docs/design/2026-09-28-managed-agent-durable-lifecycle.zh-CN.md). Both copies change at the same place.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #14358 and #13219.

prs.title: fix(ci): assemble the reference distribution into a fresh directory
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The reference distribution job now clears its output directory under the runner's temp directory before the packager writes into it, so every run assembles, verifies, and uploads from a fresh directory. A routing meta-test pins that the clear runs immediately before the packager.

## Why it's needed

Trusted PR dry runs of this job run on the shared ECS pool, and a pool runner can keep its temp directory from one job to the next. The packager creates its output directory if needed and replaces only the files for its own version. Everything else an earlier job left there survives. Two things then go wrong:

- The verify step creates an `extracted` directory to unpack the archive. When a previous run's `extracted` is still there, that step fails with `mkdir: cannot create directory ‘extracted’: File exists` before any real verification happens. The job has gone red this way for unrelated PRs since about 19:15Z on 2026-10-16, on several pool runners: job 117248347124 in run 38983127681 (`ecs-qwen-hk4-12`), run 38980434420 (actions-runner-26), run 38953627049 (actions-runner-12), and run 38983229590.
- The upload step collects every archive and manifest in that directory by wildcard. A stale archive or manifest from another PR's dry run would be uploaded with this PR's artifact. The publish path is not affected: the dispatch build that feeds a real release runs on a fresh hosted VM.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. This PR changes the workflow file, so its own CI runs the reference distribution job on the pool. On a pool runner that holds a stale directory, that job should get past the verify step's unpack instead of failing at `mkdir`.
2. The routing meta-test now asserts that the output directory is removed right before the packager runs. To check that the assertion is not vacuous, revert only the workflow line: the "build is safe on a shared pool host" case then fails.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI-only change). Locally, on this branch:

- `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`: 41/41 pass. With the workflow change reverted, 40 pass and 1 fails (the new assertion).
- `node --test scripts/tests/package-managed-agent-reference.test.mjs`: 8/8 pass.
- `vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`: 60/60 pass.
- `.github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`: within the gate and the recorded baseline.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ meta-tests (the pool job itself is validated only by this PR's own CI run) |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none expected. The directory is private to this job and is rebuilt in full by the packager. If the removal itself fails, the step fails loudly instead of building on stale contents.
- Not validated / out of scope: the same job also fails on the pool when the MySQL 8.4 service container cannot start, with `io_setup() failed with EAGAIN` (jobs 117251983494 on `ecs-qwen-hk4-6` and 117253753090 on `ecs-qwen-hk1-12`). That is a host-side asynchronous I/O limit on the pool machines, which no workflow change can fix, and this PR does not address it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None. Noticed while working on #14398, whose reference distribution check went red for this reason.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Reference distribution 这个 job 现在会在打包脚本写入之前，先清空它放在 runner 临时目录下的输出目录。这样每次运行都在一个全新的目录里组装、校验和上传。路由元测试会钉住这一点：清空必须紧挨在打包脚本之前执行。

## 为什么需要

这个 job 的可信 PR 演练跑在共享的 ECS 池上，而池里的 runner 可能把临时目录从上一个 job 留到下一个 job。打包脚本只在需要时创建输出目录，并且只替换属于本次版本的文件；之前 job 留下的其他东西都会原样保留。于是会出两种问题：

- 校验步骤要创建一个 `extracted` 目录来解包归档。上一次运行的 `extracted` 如果还在，这一步会在真正的校验开始之前就报 `mkdir: cannot create directory ‘extracted’: File exists` 并失败。从 2026-10-16 19:15Z 左右起，无关 PR 的这个 job 已经在多个池 runner 上这样变红：run 38983127681 里的 job 117248347124（`ecs-qwen-hk4-12`）、run 38980434420（actions-runner-26）、run 38953627049（actions-runner-12），以及 run 38983229590。
- 上传步骤用通配符收集该目录里的所有归档和 manifest。别的 PR 演练留下的旧归档或旧 manifest 会混进本 PR 的 artifact 一起上传。发布路径不受影响：真正用于发布的 dispatch 构建跑在全新的托管 VM 上。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 本 PR 改动了这个 workflow 文件，所以它自己的 CI 会在池上跑 reference distribution 这个 job。如果分到的池 runner 上有残留目录，这个 job 应该能越过校验步骤的解包，而不是卡在 `mkdir` 上失败。
2. 路由元测试现在断言输出目录会在打包脚本运行之前被删除。要确认这条断言不是空转，可以只撤掉 workflow 里的那一行：这时 "build is safe on a shared pool host" 这个用例会失败。

### Evidence（前后对比）

无（仅 CI 改动）。在本分支本地运行：

- `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`：41/41 通过。撤掉 workflow 改动后，40 个通过、1 个失败（就是新加的断言）。
- `node --test scripts/tests/package-managed-agent-reference.test.mjs`：8/8 通过。
- `vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`：60/60 通过。
- `.github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`：在门槛和记录的基线之内。

### 实测平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 元测试（池上的 job 本身只能由本 PR 自己的 CI 运行来验证） |

### 环境（可选）

无

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：预计没有。这个目录只属于本 job，打包脚本会完整地重建它。如果删除本身失败，这一步会直接报错，而不是在残留内容上继续构建。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：同一个 job 在池上还会因为 MySQL 8.4 服务容器起不来而失败，报错是 `io_setup() failed with EAGAIN`（`ecs-qwen-hk4-6` 上的 job 117251983494、`ecs-qwen-hk1-12` 上的 job 117253753090）。那是池主机侧的异步 I/O 上限问题，任何 workflow 改动都修不了，本 PR 不处理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

无。是在处理 #14398 时发现的，它的 reference distribution 检查正是因此变红。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): paste clipboard text with Ctrl+V on Linux
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On Linux, `Ctrl+V` now reads the clipboard's **text** when the clipboard holds no image. Previously the only clipboard reader in the TUI was the image path, so pressing `Ctrl+V` with text or a link on the clipboard either printed "未找到受支持的剪贴板工具" (no supported clipboard tool found) or did nothing at all, and users had to fall back to their terminal's own paste binding.

Reads are driven by what the clipboard itself reports. `wl-paste --list-types` (Wayland) and the `TARGETS` atom (X11) are enumerated, and each reported name is classified from the standards rather than from a list of types this code has heard of: ICCCM's text atoms (`TEXT`, `STRING`, `UTF8_STRING`) plus `text/plain` are the preferred read, any other `text/*` the source lists is the fallback, and ICCCM's selection bookkeeping properties (`TARGETS`, `MULTIPLE`, `SAVE_TARGETS`, `DELETE`, `INCR`, `TIMESTAMP`, `VERSION`) are never requested. Each read asks for the exact name the tool reported, so `text/plain;charset=utf-8` is requested under that name rather than a guessed one.

A paste too large for the input buffer is still collapsed into a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, but on both collapse routes — `Ctrl+V` read through the clipboard tool, and a large bracketed paste from the terminal — its expanded form is now described to the model: attributed to the clipboard, given the standing of a file the user asked to open rather than a message from them, and closed from outside so a forged end marker inside the pasted data cannot promote what follows it. Shell mode is the exception, because there the expanded placeholder is the command that gets recorded and run. Selections are normalised to LF line endings, which a `text/uri-list` never has on its own. Anything the clipboard tool cannot answer — no display server, tool missing, spawn failure, timeout, empty or whitespace-only selection — resolves to "nothing to paste" instead of an error. macOS and Windows behavior is untouched.

## Why it's needed

Reported in our user group: on Ubuntu, pasting text into the input box was impossible via `Ctrl+V` — the client only tried to read an image, and when none was found it told the user to install `wl-clipboard`, which does not help with text at all. The same gesture already handles images and file paths, so text is the missing branch of an existing feature rather than a new surface.

## Review round 1

The first cut read the clipboard from inside the image branch with hardcoded per-tool type names, and its tests only proved that a stubbed spawn returned its stub. Addressed as follows:

- **Structure**: `Ctrl+V` is one dispatcher (`handleClipboardPaste`) that resolves an image into an attachment and everything else into text; the insert path is its own callback. This also fixed a real defect in the first cut, which read `buffer` and `nextLargePastePlaceholder` without declaring them as dependencies.
- **Type handling**: the per-tool candidate lists are gone. Enumeration and a single type table decide what is readable, and each read asks for the exact name the tool reported (so `text/plain;charset=utf-8` is requested under that name, not a guessed one).
- **Provenance**: a collapsed paste is submitted inside `<clipboard-paste>` markers with a trailing line stating it came from the clipboard and must be treated as untrusted data — on both collapse routes, since a large bracketed paste from the terminal is no more the user's own writing than a selection read back through `wl-paste`. Shell mode is the deliberate exception: there the expanded placeholder is the command that gets recorded to history and executed, so it stays raw, and the existing shell-history case pins that carve-out. The markers are provenance for the model, not a sandbox — content can contain a closing marker, which is why the note says "treat as data" rather than claiming containment.
- **Tests**: the clipboard is now simulated as a tool that lists its types and answers reads per type, and each case asserts both the result and the exact sequence of types requested. Coverage is one table: a charset-parameterised text offer, text preferred over a co-offered URI list, a CRLF URI list, X11 atoms mapped to text without `TARGETS` ever being read back as content, fallthrough to the next atom when the first is empty, an image-only clipboard requesting nothing, unknown types requesting nothing, and a whitespace-only selection. The simulator is withdrawn after each case because the file's `beforeEach` clears call history but not implementations.

## Review round 2

- **Was the hand-written type table sound?** No, and it is gone. It carried rows no standard defines — `UNICODE` (an XFT-era atom) and a bare `uri-list` — and it named `text/uri-list` explicitly when the enumeration already says what is offered. Classification now comes from the names the standards define: ICCCM's three text atoms plus `text/plain` are the preferred tier, any other `text/*` is the fallback tier, and ICCCM's bookkeeping properties are excluded by name. Nothing is requested that the clipboard did not list.
- **Verified against a real clipboard?** Not possible from this environment, and I am not going to imply otherwise: the authoring machine is macOS arm64 with no `wl-paste`, `xclip`, `xsel`, `xvfb-run` or container runtime available, and the reader is Linux-only by design, so no live Wayland/X11 enumeration can be produced here. What I could check locally is that no other part of this repository maintains a clipboard type list to borrow (it does not — `getWlPasteImageTypes`'s `image/png`/`image/bmp` pair was the only one, and it is kept as-is). A real `wl-paste --list-types` and `xclip -t TARGETS -o` dump from an Ubuntu session would be worth attaching to this PR; the tier rule is written so that any such dump is accepted without code changes.
- **Why `text/uri-list` at all?** It is no longer a case in the code — it falls out of the `text/*` fallback tier, which is the general rule rather than a named exception. The reason a fallback tier exists is that a source may list nothing but a non-plain `text/*` type, and without the tier `Ctrl+V` would silently do nothing there. The visible trade-off is that a selection offered only as `text/html` now pastes markup instead of nothing; that is stated in a test case rather than hidden.
- **The description was too thin.** Rewritten along injection-defence lines: it attributes the block to the clipboard and says the user may not have read it; it gives the content the standing of a file the user asked to open rather than a message from them; it keeps telling the model to act on pasted material that matches the user's actual request, because refusing pasted content would defeat the feature; it names the shapes it must not swallow (a system message, a permission or policy change, a confirmation the user gave); and it closes the block from outside, so a forged `</clipboard-paste>` inside the data cannot promote whatever follows it. One case pins those properties.

## Final diff

- `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.ts`: `readStdout()` (buffered stdout, timeout kill, empty string for anything that is not a successful read), `classifyClipboardType()` over the ICCCM text and bookkeeping sets, `listClipboardTypes()` on top of the Wayland/X11 enumeration, and `readClipboardText()` which requests only listed types — plain tier first — and normalises line endings. The wl-paste enumeration the image path already had is generalised into `listWlPasteTypes()` with one cache, and the image filter reads from that same list, so a single `Ctrl+V` costs one enumeration.
- `packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx`: `handleClipboardImage` becomes `handleClipboardPaste` — image resolves to an attachment, anything else to text — with the insert path split into `insertClipboardText`. `describeClipboardPaste()` frames a collapsed paste for the model and is applied on both collapse routes, skipped in shell mode.
- Tests: 9 table cases driving a clipboard that lists its types and answers reads per type, plus 4 component cases (text paste, collapsed paste described on submit, image wins over text, and the description's own properties).

## Evidence

<details>
<summary>Verification</summary>

Verified by unit tests rather than a live screenshot — this change needs a Wayland/X11 session, which the authoring environment does not have:

```
npx vitest run src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.test.ts        → 70 passed
npx vitest run src/ui/components/InputPrompt.test.tsx     → 230 passed, 1 skipped
npx eslint <4 changed files>                              → clean
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (packages/cli)          → 172 errors, identical to
                                                             the same count on the
                                                             pre-change tree; none in
                                                             the changed files
```

</details>

## Contribution & Risk

- **Type**: Contribution Type 3 — optimization / user-facing feature
- **Scope**: Only `packages/cli/src/ui` (TUI input handling). No core, auth, provider, config, tools, or service modules; no daemon or channel code.
- **Linked Issues**: N/A — reported directly by users in the group chat; no GitHub issue filed.
- [x] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), the code of conduct, and the PR instructions.
- [x] I have searched open PRs for a similar change and confirmed none exists.
- [ ] Not applicable — this PR does not change or add any UI component.
